words.enDefinition: a marked parking space arranged for vehicles used by people with accessibility needs

examples.en: The map marked an accessible parking bay near the venue's step-free entrance.
examples.zh: 地图在场馆的无台阶入口附近标了一个「无障碍停车位」。

examples.en: I asked which accessible parking bay was nearest the door to the reception area.
examples.zh: 我问哪个「无障碍停车位」离接待区入口最近。

collocations: use a designated accessible parking bay

words.enDefinition: Design details helping guests with access needs use a room

examples.en: The booking page listed accessible room features beside a bathroom photo.
examples.zh: 预订页面在一张浴室照片旁列了「无障碍客房设施」。

examples.en: I asked which accessible room features were available on the ground floor.
examples.zh: 我问一楼有哪些「无障碍客房设施」。

collocations: a list of accessible room features

words.zhGloss: 提供无障碍安排的导览
words.enDefinition: a tour planned to accommodate particular access needs
acceptedZhAnswers: 提供无障碍安排的导览

examples.en: I checked what was included in the accessible tour before sending the link to my group.
examples.zh: 我先查了「提供无障碍安排的导览」包括哪些服务，再把链接发给小组。

examples.en: Our accessible tour included printed notes for visitors who wanted to follow the commentary.
examples.zh: 我们参加的「提供无障碍安排的导览」有印好的讲解资料，方便有需要的游客跟上。

words.enDefinition: To add one bag for the hold to a booking

examples.en: I used the airline's app to add a checked bag before our airport bus arrived.
examples.zh: 机场公交到站前，我用航空公司的应用「加购了一件托运行李」。

examples.en: Can I add a checked bag at the counter after doing online check-in?
examples.zh: 我办完网上值机后，可以在柜台「加购一件托运行李」吗？

collocations: choose to add a checked bag
use an app to add a checked bag
add a checked bag to a booking

words.enDefinition: a person listed to drive the rented vehicle in addition to the main driver

examples.en: We asked whether an additional driver could be added at the rental counter.
examples.zh: 我们问能不能在租车柜台增加一名「附加驾驶人」。

examples.en: The agreement listed the fee for an additional driver below the rental rate.
examples.zh: 协议在租车费率下方列出了「附加驾驶人」的费用。

words.enDefinition: An extra check beyond the initial screening

examples.en: An officer told me my bag needed additional screening and showed me where to wait.
examples.zh: 安检员说我的行李需要「进一步安检」，并指给我等待的位置。

examples.en: I stayed near the marked area while my classmate waited for additional screening.
examples.zh: 同学等候「进一步安检」时，我留在标出的区域附近。

words.enDefinition: Seats directly next to each other

examples.en: We asked whether adjacent seats were available for the two of us.
examples.zh: 我们问有没有两个「相邻座位」给我们。

examples.en: The seat map showed two adjacent seats near the front of the plane.
examples.zh: 座位图显示飞机前部有两个「相邻座位」。

words.enDefinition: Guest rooms situated side by side in the same building

examples.en: We requested adjoining rooms so we could knock on each other's doors.
examples.zh: 我们想住得近一点，方便敲门，就要了「相邻客房」。

examples.en: Our adjoining rooms shared a wall, but each had its own entrance.
examples.zh: 两间「相邻客房」共用一面墙，但各有自己的入口。

collocations: two adjoining rooms on one floor

words.enDefinition: To change the position of a bicycle seat

examples.en: I asked the rental worker whether I could adjust the saddle on this bicycle.
examples.zh: 我问租车工作人员能不能「调整这辆自行车的车座」。

examples.en: My classmate took a moment to adjust the saddle beside the station before leaving.
examples.zh: 出发前，同学在停靠点旁花了点时间「调整车座」。

collocations: ask how to adjust the saddle
take time to adjust the saddle
adjust the saddle before a ride

words.enDefinition: the price charged for entering a site or attraction

examples.en: I checked the admission fee before adding the museum to our weekend plans.
examples.zh: 把博物馆加进周末计划之前，我查了「门票费用」。

examples.en: The leaflet listed the admission fee beside a map showing the visitor entrance.
examples.zh: 宣传单在标有游客入口的地图旁边列了「门票费用」。

words.enDefinition: Arranging a travel reservation before the intended day or time

examples.en: I made an advance booking for the coach after my exam timetable arrived.
examples.zh: 考试时间表下来后，我给长途大巴「提前订票」。

examples.en: The rail website explained where to find my advance booking.
examples.zh: 铁路网站说明了在哪儿可以找到我「提前订票」的记录。

collocations: an advance booking for a train

words.enDefinition: A British rail ticket bought in advance for a specified service

examples.en: I checked which train was printed on my Advance ticket.
examples.zh: 我核对了「英国指定班次预售票」上写的是哪趟列车。

examples.en: The rail website listed an Advance ticket beside the flexible fare.
examples.zh: 铁路网站在灵活票价旁列出了「英国指定班次预售票」。

collocations: an Advance ticket for a specific train
check the details on an Advance ticket

words.enDefinition: Checking in when the regular reception desk is closed

examples.en: We arranged after-hours check-in because reception would close before our train arrived.
examples.zh: 火车到达前前台就会关门，所以我们安排了「前台关门后入住」。

examples.en: I asked who to contact about after-hours check-in at the guesthouse.
examples.zh: 我问这家小旅馆「前台关门后入住」应该联系谁。

words.enDefinition: returning a rented vehicle when the rental location is closed or unstaffed

examples.en: The booking included instructions for an after-hours return on Sunday evening.
examples.zh: 预约里附有周日晚上「非营业时间还车」的说明。

examples.en: I asked the agent where to leave the vehicle for an after-hours return.
examples.zh: 我问代理，「非营业时间还车」时该把车停在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: the airline's replacement of the plane assigned to a flight

examples.en: The airline announced an aircraft change, then posted a revised seating plan in the app.
examples.zh: 航空公司宣布「更换执飞飞机」，随后在应用里公布了新的座位图。

examples.en: I noticed the aircraft change because my window seat was now in another row.
examples.zh: 我发现「执飞飞机换了」，因为靠窗座位挪到了另一排。

collocations: notify passengers of an aircraft change

words.enDefinition: the model or design of aircraft used for a flight

examples.en: The aircraft type changed, and the seat layout on my reservation looked different afterwards.
examples.zh: 「飞机机型」变了，后来我看到预订里的座位布局也不同了。

examples.en: I noticed the aircraft type on the itinerary while comparing two flights home for the break.
examples.zh: 我比较假期回家的两个航班时，注意到行程单写了「飞机机型」。

words.enDefinition: A staffed airport counter operated by an airline

examples.en: I showed the email to the agent at the airline counter before checking in.
examples.zh: 值机前，我把邮件给「航空公司柜台」的工作人员看。

examples.en: The airline counter for our flight was at the end of the row.
examples.zh: 我们这趟航班的「航空公司柜台」在整排柜台的尽头。

words.enDefinition: a counter where an airline helps passengers with travel issues

examples.en: I went to the airline service desk after the airport screen showed my flight had changed.
examples.zh: 机场信息屏显示航班变更后，我去了「航空公司服务柜台」。

examples.en: The line at the airline service desk moved quickly once a second agent arrived.
examples.zh: 第二位工作人员来了以后，「航空公司服务柜台」的队伍走得很快。

collocations: go to the airline service desk
queue at the airline service desk
ask at the airline service desk

words.enDefinition: a switch to a different airport between flights on one journey

examples.en: The itinerary included an airport change, so we checked how far apart the airports were.
examples.zh: 这份行程需要「转机途中更换机场」，所以我们查了两个机场相距多远。

examples.en: I avoided an airport change because I wanted to keep the entire trip simple.
examples.zh: 我想让行程简单一点，所以避开了「转机途中更换机场」的路线。

collocations: an itinerary with an airport change
allow time for an airport change

words.enDefinition: A place for dropping passengers off at the airport

examples.en: My roommate waited at the airport drop-off area with both of our suitcases.
examples.zh: 室友带着我们两个人的行李箱在「机场下客区」等我。

examples.en: The airport drop-off area was just outside the doors for departures at this terminal.
examples.zh: 「机场下客区」就在这座航站楼出发区的大门外面。

collocations: arrive at the airport drop-off area
signs for the airport drop-off area
an airport drop-off area near departures

words.enDefinition: Security checks for passengers and baggage at an airport

examples.en: We met on the other side of airport security before walking toward our gate.
examples.zh: 我们通过「机场安检」后在另一边碰面，再一起往登机口走。

examples.en: The airline counter pointed us toward airport security after we checked in the suitcases.
examples.zh: 我们托运完行李箱后，航空公司柜台的工作人员给我们指了「机场安检」的方向。

words.enDefinition: On the secured side of an airport terminal

examples.en: The map showed an airside café near the gate where my classmate was waiting.
examples.zh: 地图标着登机口附近有一家「安检后候机区内的」咖啡馆，同学就在那边等。

examples.en: The airport map showed an airside walkway between the lounge and our gate.
examples.zh: 机场地图标出了「安检后区域内」一条连接候机厅和登机口的步行通道。

words.enDefinition: a transfer between flights while staying within the airport's restricted area

examples.en: The signs for the airside transfer led us towards a bus between the terminals.
examples.zh: 「机场管制区内转机」的路牌指向了往返两座航站楼的巴士。

examples.en: I asked whether an airside transfer was possible for the flights in my booking.
examples.zh: 我问我订的这几个航班能不能「在机场管制区内转机」。

words.enDefinition: A passenger seat located immediately next to the aisle

examples.en: My friend chose an aisle seat on the train to the coast.
examples.zh: 朋友在去海边的列车上选了「靠过道的座位」。

examples.en: One aisle seat was available in the same carriage as mine.
examples.zh: 和我同一车厢里，还有一个「靠过道的座位」空着。

words.enDefinition: A call telling passengers to enter a train before it leaves

examples.en: The conductor called "All aboard!" just before we stepped onto the train.
examples.zh: 我们上车前，列车长喊了声「请各位上车！」

examples.en: I heard "All aboard!" while standing near the front of the train.
examples.zh: 我站在靠近车头的位置时，听到有人喊「请各位上车！」

words.enDefinition: Accommodation combining meals and other specified services in one booking

examples.en: I checked what the all-inclusive stay covered before making a decision.
examples.zh: 作决定之前，我先核对了「全包式住宿」包含哪些服务。

examples.en: The email listed the services provided with our all-inclusive stay.
examples.zh: 邮件列出了我们的「全包式住宿」提供的服务。

words.enDefinition: a transport service scheduled to call at every regular stop on the route

examples.en: The sign showed that this was an all-stops service to the city centre.
examples.zh: 牌子显示，这是去市中心「各站都停的班次」。

examples.en: I chose the all-stops service because the express skipped the student residence.
examples.zh: 快车跳过了学生公寓站，所以我选了「各站都停的班次」。

words.enDefinition: To schedule enough time to reach and board a later service

examples.en: The guide reminded us to allow time for the connection at the larger station.
examples.zh: 指南提醒我们，在较大的车站要「给换乘留出时间」。

examples.en: I checked the walking distance to allow time for the connection at the next station.
examples.zh: 我核对了下一站的步行距离，好「给换乘留出时间」。

collocations: allow time for the connection at the station
allow time for the connection between trains
remember to allow time for the connection

words.enDefinition: Following the edge of a developed area beside water

examples.en: The directions took us along the waterfront before turning inland toward the gallery.
examples.zh: 指引让我们先「沿着滨水地带」走，再往里拐去美术馆。

examples.en: We found a place to sit along the waterfront near the old warehouse.
examples.zh: 我们在旧仓库附近「沿水一带」找了个地方坐下。

words.enDefinition: a different route used when the usual route is unavailable or less suitable

examples.en: The app showed an alternate route after the bus stop closed near campus.
examples.zh: 学校附近站点关闭后，应用显示了一条「备选线路」。

examples.en: I compared an alternate route with walking the entire way to the library.
examples.zh: 我把一条「备选线路」和全程步行到图书馆作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A different train service available in place of the planned one

examples.en: The website listed an alternative rail service after showing the original train.
examples.zh: 网站先显示原来的列车，然后列出一个「可改乘的铁路班次」。

examples.en: I asked where the alternative rail service would stop along the route.
examples.zh: 我问那个「可改乘的铁路班次」沿途会停在哪里。

collocations: look for an alternative rail service

words.enDefinition: A revised schedule showing changed times or services

examples.en: I checked the amended timetable after the station announced weekend works.
examples.zh: 车站发布周末施工通知后，我查看了「调整后的时刻表」。

examples.en: Our coach appeared later on the amended timetable than we expected.
examples.zh: 「调整后的时刻表」上，我们那趟大巴比预想的晚。

words.enDefinition: A British rail fare without peak-time restrictions on valid travel

examples.en: I asked which route was shown on the Anytime ticket.
examples.zh: 我问「英国不限时段车票」上写的是哪条线路。

examples.en: The British rail website explained what an Anytime ticket covered.
examples.zh: 英国铁路网站解释了「英国不限时段车票」涵盖哪些行程。

collocations: check the route on an Anytime ticket

words.enDefinition: Short-stay apartments combined with facilities or services associated with hotels

examples.en: The aparthotel had a small kitchen in each guest unit.
examples.zh: 那家「公寓式酒店」的每个客房单元都有一个小厨房。

examples.en: My friends chose an aparthotel because they wanted more space.
examples.zh: 朋友们想住得宽敞一些，就选了「公寓式酒店」。

words.enDefinition: asks whether visitors may take photographs in this area

examples.en: Are photos allowed here if we turn the flash off during the tour?
examples.zh: 导览期间关掉闪光灯的话，「这里允许拍照吗」？

examples.en: Excuse me, are photos allowed here, or should I put my camera away?
examples.zh: 不好意思，「这里允许拍照吗」？还是我应该把相机收起来？

collocations: excuse me, are photos allowed here?
are photos allowed here during the tour?
before we begin, are photos allowed here?

words.enDefinition: the part of a seat that supports your arm

examples.en: I kept my elbow off the armrest while my neighbour was writing a note.
examples.zh: 邻座在写东西时，我的手肘没有搭在「座椅扶手」上。

examples.en: The power outlet was just under the armrest between the two seats on our flight.
examples.zh: 我们那趟航班的电源口就在两个座位之间的「座椅扶手」下面。

collocations: rest an elbow on the armrest

words.enDefinition: an estimate of when a vehicle will reach a particular stop or station

examples.en: The arrival prediction shifted while we waited at the university stop.
examples.zh: 我们在学校站等车时，「到站时间预测」变了。

examples.en: I compared the arrival prediction with the position of the bus on the map.
examples.zh: 我把「到站时间预测」和地图上的公交位置作了对照。

words.enDefinition: A display showing incoming services and when they are expected

examples.en: I checked the arrivals board before going to meet my roommate.
examples.zh: 我先看了「到站信息屏」，才去接室友。

examples.en: The arrivals board listed the arrivals from both routes separately.
examples.zh: 「到站信息屏」分开列出了两条线路的抵达班次。

collocations: the arrivals board at the station

words.enDefinition: a long bus with sections joined by a flexible joint so it can turn

examples.en: An articulated bus arrived just as our lecture group reached the crowded stop.
examples.zh: 我们班一到拥挤的站台，一辆「铰接式公交车」就来了。

examples.en: I stood near the middle of the articulated bus because the front was full.
examples.zh: 车前部挤满了，我站在「铰接式公交车」中段附近。

words.enDefinition: at the speed that suits you personally

examples.en: You can look around at your own pace once you've picked up the visitor map.
examples.zh: 拿到游客地图后，你可以「按自己的节奏」随便看看。

examples.en: The leaflet says you can explore at your own pace once the guided introduction finishes.
examples.zh: 宣传单上说，导游介绍完后，你可以「按自己的节奏」逛。

collocations: look around at your own pace

words.enDefinition: To fasten an identifying label to baggage

examples.en: The volunteer showed me where to attach a bag tag to each suitcase.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我看，每个行李箱应该在哪里「贴上行李标签」。

examples.en: I paused to attach a bag tag after printing it at the machine.
examples.zh: 我用机器打出标签后，停下来「贴上行李标签」。

collocations: ask how to attach a bag tag
attach a bag tag to a suitcase
help someone attach a bag tag

words.enDefinition: a button that signals you want a flight attendant

examples.en: I asked which symbol marked the attendant call button above the row of seats.
examples.zh: 我问座位上方哪个图标代表「呼叫乘务员的按钮」。

examples.en: The attendant call button lit up when the passenger next to me pressed it.
examples.zh: 旁边的乘客按了「呼叫乘务员的按钮」，按钮就亮了。

words.enDefinition: An audible cue associated with a pedestrian crossing

examples.en: I could hear the audible crossing signal from the corner near the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆附近的拐角能听见「有声过街信号」。

examples.en: The accessibility map identified an audible crossing signal beside the east park entrance.
examples.zh: 无障碍地图标出了公园东门旁边的「有声过街信号」。

collocations: a crossing with an audible crossing signal

words.enDefinition: a recording or device giving spoken information about a place

examples.en: I used an audio guide because I wanted more time in the smaller rooms.
examples.zh: 我用了「语音导览」，因为想在较小的房间里多待一会儿。

examples.en: The audio guide explained why the windows were different on each side of the house.
examples.zh: 「语音导览」解释了为什么老宅两侧的窗户不一样。

words.enDefinition: a person who has permission under the rental terms to drive the vehicle

examples.en: I checked whether I was listed as an authorized driver on the agreement.
examples.zh: 我查了自己是否在协议上被列为「获准驾驶的人」。

examples.en: The rental agency asked whether the person returning the car was an authorized driver.
examples.zh: 租车公司询问，还车的人是不是「获准驾驶的人」。

words.zhGloss: 仅限驾驶自动挡的驾照
words.enDefinition: a licence whose vehicle permissions restrict the holder to automatic transmission in a specified category
acceptedZhAnswers: 仅限驾驶自动挡的驾照

examples.en: The rental form asked me whether my automatic-only licence covered the selected car.
examples.zh: 租车表格问，我的「仅限驾驶自动挡的驾照」是否适用于选中的车。

examples.en: The instructor pointed to the code for an automatic-only licence on the sample.
examples.zh: 教练指出，样本上哪个代码代表「仅限驾驶自动挡的驾照」。

collocations: a restriction on an automatic-only licence

words.enDefinition: a replacement flight booking made automatically by the airline

examples.en: The app offered automatic rebooking after my connection was cancelled while we were still airborne.
examples.zh: 我们还在空中时，转乘航班被取消了，应用上出现了「自动改订航班」的选项。

examples.en: I checked the automatic rebooking because the new flight arrived at a different airport.
examples.zh: 新航班到的是另一个机场，我就核对了「自动改订航班」的结果。

words.enDefinition: a vehicle transmission that changes gears automatically without manual gear selection in ordinary driving

examples.en: I checked whether the rental car was equipped with automatic transmission before confirming.
examples.zh: 确认预订前，我核实了车上是否装有「自动变速器」。

examples.en: The listing showed automatic transmission in the same column as the seating capacity.
examples.zh: 车型列表把「自动变速器」和载客人数列在同一栏。

words.enDefinition: A bicycle that can currently be rented

examples.en: The app showed one available bike outside the entrance to the riverside park.
examples.zh: 应用显示河边公园入口外有一辆「可租用的自行车」。

examples.en: I looked for an available bike before agreeing to meet my classmate at the market.
examples.zh: 答应在市场和同学见面之前，我先找了有没有「可租用的自行车」。

collocations: a station with an available bike

words.enDefinition: A small bed a lodging property provides for a baby

examples.en: My sister asked the hotel to provide a baby cot for her daughter.
examples.zh: 姐姐请酒店为她的女儿提供一张「旅店婴儿床」。

examples.en: The receptionist checked whether a baby cot was already in the room.
examples.zh: 前台人员确认客房里是否已经放了「旅店婴儿床」。

collocations: check availability of a baby cot

words.enDefinition: The length, width and height of a bag

examples.en: I checked the bag dimensions on the label before buying the suitcase for my trip.
examples.zh: 为这趟行程买行李箱前，我看了标签上的「行李尺寸」。

examples.en: The form asked for bag dimensions when I added my equipment case to the booking.
examples.zh: 我把器材箱加到预订记录时，表单要求填写「行李尺寸」。

words.enDefinition: The latest time a checked bag is accepted

examples.en: I checked the bag drop deadline before deciding when to leave my flat.
examples.zh: 我先查了「托运交付截止时间」，再决定几点出门。

examples.en: The bag drop deadline appeared next to the flight details in the airline email.
examples.zh: 航空公司的邮件在航班详情旁列出了「托运交付截止时间」。

words.enDefinition: An airport point for handing over checked baggage

examples.en: We went to bag drop after printing the tags by the airline counters.
examples.zh: 我们在航空公司柜台旁打印了标签，然后去了「托运行李交运处」。

examples.en: The sign for bag drop was above the second row of check-in machines.
examples.zh: 「托运行李交运处」的牌子在第二排值机机器上方。

words.enDefinition: A check of the contents of a bag

examples.en: I told the officer the bag was mine before the bag inspection began.
examples.zh: 「行李检查」开始前，我告诉安检员那个包是我的。

examples.en: The sign showed where to wait if staff requested a bag inspection.
examples.zh: 告示说明了工作人员要求「行李检查」时去哪里等。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that a previously missing bag has been found

examples.en: The app displayed 'Bag located' just before the baggage team emailed me about delivery.
examples.zh: 行李小组发邮件联系我送件前，应用显示了「已找到行李」。

examples.en: I saw 'Bag located' on the status page, but it hadn't reached the airport yet.
examples.zh: 我在状态页面看到「已找到行李」，不过它还没到机场。

words.enDefinition: A train carriage used to transport passengers' registered luggage

examples.en: The staff member showed where the train's baggage car was located.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我们看列车的「行李车厢」在什么位置。

examples.en: I asked whether this particular departure had a baggage car that day.
examples.zh: 我问当天这趟车有没有「行李车厢」。

collocations: send a bag in the baggage car

words.enDefinition: a moving belt where arriving passengers collect checked bags

examples.en: I stood by the baggage carousel while my flatmate went to check the flight number.
examples.zh: 室友去核对航班号时，我站在「行李转盘」旁等着。

examples.en: The baggage carousel stopped before I saw the suitcase I had checked that morning.
examples.zh: 「行李转盘」停了，我还没看到早上托运的箱子。

words.enDefinition: the arrivals area where passengers collect their checked bags

examples.en: We walked to baggage claim after leaving the plane and followed the signs for our flight.
examples.zh: 下飞机后我们走到「行李提取区」，跟着自己航班的指示牌走。

examples.en: I called my friend from baggage claim because our suitcases were taking a while.
examples.zh: 箱子要等一阵，我在「行李提取区」给朋友打了电话。

words.zhGloss: 本航班行李传送已结束
words.enDefinition: a status saying the routine unloading of baggage from a flight has finished
acceptedZhAnswers: 本航班行李传送已结束

examples.en: The screen said 'Baggage delivery complete,' but I was still waiting for my suitcase.
examples.zh: 信息屏显示「本航班行李传送已结束」，可我还在等箱子。

examples.en: I checked our flight number again when 'Baggage delivery complete' appeared beside the carousel.
examples.zh: 转盘旁显示「本航班行李传送已结束」后，我又核对了一遍航班号。

collocations: a screen saying baggage delivery complete
the display shows baggage delivery complete
wait until it says baggage delivery complete

words.enDefinition: A charge for carrying baggage on a flight

examples.en: I asked what the baggage fee covered before paying at the airline counter.
examples.zh: 我在航空公司柜台付钱前，问了「行李费用」包含哪些项目。

examples.en: The booking showed the baggage fee separately from the fare for each passenger.
examples.zh: 预订记录把「行李费用」和每位乘客的票价分开显示。

words.enDefinition: sending delayed baggage onward to the intended airport or recipient

examples.en: The airline arranged baggage forwarding after locating the bag at the airport where I transferred.
examples.zh: 航空公司在我转机的机场找到了包，随后安排「延误行李再次转运」。

examples.en: I saw a note about baggage forwarding beside the new airport on the status page.
examples.zh: 我在状态页面的新机场名称旁边看到一条「延误行李再次转运」的说明。

words.enDefinition: A record that checked baggage was accepted

examples.en: The check-in agent gave me a baggage receipt after my suitcase went onto the belt.
examples.zh: 我的行李箱上了传送带以后，值机人员给了我一张「托运行李凭条」。

examples.en: I kept the baggage receipt with my boarding pass in the same folder.
examples.zh: 我把「托运行李凭条」和登机牌放在同一个文件夹里。

collocations: a baggage receipt for each checked bag

words.enDefinition: a counter where passengers hand in bags collected during a transfer

examples.en: The agent pointed out the baggage recheck counter on the map of the arrivals level.
examples.zh: 工作人员在到达层的地图上指出了「行李转机再托运柜台」。

examples.en: We reached the baggage recheck counter after collecting our bags for this particular connection.
examples.zh: 这个换乘环节我们先领了行李，再走到「行李转机再托运柜台」。

collocations: go to the baggage recheck counter
ask at the baggage recheck counter
follow signs to the baggage recheck counter

words.enDefinition: A scale used to weigh bags

examples.en: The baggage scale was near the entrance to the self-service bag drop.
examples.zh: 「行李秤」在自助托运点的入口附近。

examples.en: I watched the baggage scale display while my suitcase was on the belt.
examples.zh: 行李箱放上传送带时，我看着「行李秤」的显示屏。

collocations: put a bag on the baggage scale

words.enDefinition: a status showing staff are still trying to locate a bag

examples.en: The page still showed baggage search in progress when I got back to campus.
examples.zh: 我回到学校时，页面仍显示「行李仍在查找中」。

examples.en: I could see baggage search in progress but there was no updated arrival time.
examples.zh: 我能看到「行李仍在查找中」，但没有新的预计到达时间。

collocations: a baggage search in progress status
the app says baggage search in progress

words.enDefinition: a counter staffed to help with missing or damaged bags

examples.en: I went to the baggage services desk after the belt stopped and my bag hadn't appeared.
examples.zh: 转盘停了还没看到我的包，我就去了「行李服务柜台」。

examples.en: The agent at the baggage services desk asked which flight I had arrived on.
examples.zh: 「行李服务柜台」的工作人员问我是坐哪趟航班到的。

collocations: go to the baggage services desk
ask at the baggage services desk
an agent at the baggage services desk

words.enDefinition: A frame used to check a bag's size

examples.en: The baggage sizer beside the counter had the airline's name printed on it.
examples.zh: 柜台旁的「行李尺寸框」上印着航空公司的名字。

examples.en: I saw a baggage sizer near the gate but did not need to use it.
examples.zh: 我在登机口附近看到一个「行李尺寸框」，不过没用到。

collocations: a bag fits in the baggage sizer
a baggage sizer at the gate

words.enDefinition: new information about the progress of locating or returning a bag

examples.en: I got a baggage status update while I was unpacking the things from my backpack.
examples.zh: 我从背包里拿东西时，收到了一条「行李查找进展通知」。

examples.en: The baggage status update said the bag had finally reached the airport near campus.
examples.zh: 「行李查找进展通知」说，包终于到了学校附近的机场。

collocations: ask for a baggage status update

words.enDefinition: the number used to identify an individual checked bag

examples.en: I found the baggage tag number on the small receipt I got at check-in.
examples.zh: 我在值机时拿到的小凭条上找到了「托运行李标签号码」。

examples.en: The agent asked me to read out the baggage tag number from my receipt.
examples.zh: 工作人员请我念出凭条上的「托运行李标签号码」。

collocations: give the agent a baggage tag number

words.enDefinition: A machine that prints labels for checked baggage

examples.en: The baggage tag printer near the airline counter had run out of paper.
examples.zh: 航空公司柜台旁的「行李标签打印机」用完了纸。

examples.en: The volunteer pointed out the baggage tag printer beside the row of scales.
examples.zh: 志愿者给我指了指一排行李秤旁的「行李标签打印机」。

collocations: load paper into a baggage tag printer

words.enDefinition: the airline's search to locate luggage that has not arrived

examples.en: The agent started baggage tracing after I gave her the number from my receipt.
examples.zh: 我把凭条上的号码报给工作人员后，她开始「查找追踪行李」。

examples.en: A team responsible for baggage tracing emailed to ask for a photo of the suitcase.
examples.zh: 负责「行李查找追踪」的团队发来邮件，要一张箱子的照片。

collocations: check the progress of baggage tracing

words.enDefinition: a code identifying an airline's search record for a missing bag

examples.en: I wrote down my baggage tracing reference before leaving the airport for my residence.
examples.zh: 离开机场去宿舍前，我记下了「行李查找编号」。

examples.en: The agent needed the baggage tracing reference to find my report on her screen.
examples.zh: 工作人员需要「行李查找编号」，才能在她的屏幕上找到我的报告。

collocations: ask for the baggage tracing reference

words.enDefinition: the movement of checked baggage from one flight to another

examples.en: The supervisor checked the baggage transfer before telling me where the suitcase would come out.
examples.zh: 主管查了「转机行李转运」的安排，才告诉我箱子会从哪儿出来。

examples.en: I asked whether a baggage transfer had been arranged for the two flights on my ticket.
examples.zh: 我问这张机票上的两趟航班之间是否安排了「转机行李转运」。

words.enDefinition: A small cart used to move airport luggage

examples.en: We put both suitcases on a baggage trolley outside the terminal doors.
examples.zh: 我们在航站楼门外把两个行李箱放上了「行李手推车」。

examples.en: I returned the baggage trolley after my classmate finished checking in his bags.
examples.zh: 同学托运完行李后，我还了「行李手推车」。

words.enDefinition: The maximum weight allowed for a piece of baggage

examples.en: The airline's page displayed the baggage weight limit next to my fare type.
examples.zh: 航空公司页面在我的票价类型旁显示了「行李重量上限」。

examples.en: I asked the agent where the baggage weight limit appeared in my booking.
examples.zh: 我问工作人员，预订记录上哪里能看到「行李重量上限」。

collocations: the baggage weight limit for this fare

words.enDefinition: X-ray screening of a passenger's baggage

examples.en: The airport sign used the words baggage X-ray beside an image of a suitcase.
examples.zh: 机场指示牌在行李箱图案旁写着「行李X光检查」。

examples.en: The officer told me where to wait while the bag went through baggage X-ray.
examples.zh: 工作人员告诉我，行李接受「行李X光检查」时要在哪儿等。

words.enDefinition: stay mainly in a place while visiting other locations nearby

examples.en: You could base yourself in the old town and visit nearby villages during the day.
examples.zh: 你可以「以老城为出游据点」，白天去附近的村庄转转。

examples.en: It makes sense to base yourself in one place if you have only three days.
examples.zh: 如果只有三天，「以一个地方为出游据点」比较方便。

collocations: choose where to base yourself in the region

words.enDefinition: A display showing charge remaining in a battery

examples.en: I checked the battery indicator on the shared bike before choosing that one.
examples.zh: 选中那辆共享单车之前，我看了一下它的「电量指示器」。

examples.en: The bike had a small battery indicator beside the other symbols on the display.
examples.zh: 车上的显示屏有个小「电量指示器」，就在其他图标旁边。

collocations: a battery indicator on the display

words.enDefinition: To continue in a direction slightly to the left

examples.en: The directions said to bear left where the path divided near the water.
examples.zh: 指引说，小路在水边分岔时要「略向左走」。

examples.en: I was told to bear left after the wooden sign by the park gate.
examples.zh: 有人告诉我，过了公园门边的木牌后要「略向左走」。

words.enDefinition: To continue in a direction slightly to the right

examples.en: The route note said to bear right just beyond the bench in the shade.
examples.zh: 路线说明说，过了树荫里的长椅就「略向右走」。

examples.en: I checked both paths when the voice on my phone said to bear right.
examples.zh: 手机语音提示「略向右走」时，我看了看两条路。

collocations: bear right onto the main path

words.enDefinition: arrive before a place gets busy with visitors

examples.en: We got there just after opening to beat the crowds at the old market.
examples.zh: 我们刚开门就到旧市场了，想「赶在人多之前到」。

examples.en: I wanted to beat the crowds because we only had an hour in town.
examples.zh: 我们在镇上只有一小时，我想「赶在人多之前到」。

collocations: arrive early to beat the crowds
beat the crowds at a popular site

words.enDefinition: A small lodging establishment providing overnight rooms and breakfast

examples.en: We chose a bed and breakfast near campus for the graduation weekend.
examples.zh: 毕业典礼那个周末，我们选了学校附近一家「含早餐的家庭旅馆」。

examples.en: The bed and breakfast had a small dining area on the ground floor.
examples.zh: 那家「含早餐的家庭旅馆」一楼有一个小用餐区。

collocations: stay at a bed and breakfast

words.enDefinition: A listing label indicating bedding such as sheets is supplied

examples.en: The listing said bed linen provided next to the dorm bed option.
examples.zh: 住宿页面在多人间床位选项旁写着「提供床上用品」。

examples.en: I saw bed linen provided under the information for our own room.
examples.zh: 我看到我们的客房信息下面写着「提供床上用品」。

collocations: a hostel with bed linen provided
an option marked bed linen provided

words.enDefinition: The kind or arrangement of beds a guest would prefer

examples.en: I entered my bed preference after selecting the dates of my stay.
examples.zh: 选好住宿日期后，我填写了「床型偏好」。

examples.en: The receptionist asked whether our bed preference had changed since booking.
examples.zh: 前台人员问，我们的「床型偏好」在订房后有没有变化。

words.enDefinition: A basket attached to a bicycle for carrying things

examples.en: My folded jacket fit in the bike basket without taking up much space.
examples.zh: 我折好的外套放进「自行车车篮」里，占不了多少地方。

examples.en: The rental worker pointed out the bike basket on the front of that bicycle.
examples.zh: 租车工作人员指给我看那辆车前面的「自行车车篮」。

collocations: a bag in the bike basket
a rental bike with a bike basket

words.enDefinition: A bell mounted on a bicycle

examples.en: I noticed a blue bike bell on the rental bike near the park.
examples.zh: 我注意到公园附近那辆租赁自行车上有一个蓝色的「自行车铃」。

examples.en: The support form let me say that the bike bell was missing completely.
examples.zh: 客服表单允许我注明这辆车的「自行车铃」不见了。

collocations: a bike bell on the handlebars
the sound of a bike bell

words.enDefinition: A protective helmet made for riding a bike

examples.en: The rental shop had a bike helmet on the shelf beside the front desk.
examples.zh: 租车店的前台旁边有个架子，上面放了一个「自行车头盔」。

examples.en: My classmate asked whether a bike helmet could be rented with the bicycle.
examples.zh: 同学问租自行车时能不能一起租个「自行车头盔」。

words.enDefinition: The identifier assigned to a particular rental bike

examples.en: I checked the bike number against the one displayed in the app.
examples.zh: 我核对了「单车编号」是否和应用里显示的那一个一致。

examples.en: The support form asked for the bike number printed below the seat.
examples.zh: 客服表单要求填写印在车座下方的「单车编号」。

collocations: a bike number on the frame

words.enDefinition: A pump used to add air to bicycle tires

examples.en: The map marked a bike pump next to the public repair stand.
examples.zh: 地图在公共维修架旁标出了一处「自行车打气筒」。

examples.en: I asked whether the community hall had a bike pump near its entrance.
examples.zh: 我问社区活动大厅入口附近有没有「自行车打气筒」。

words.enDefinition: A stand holding bicycles for basic repair work

examples.en: The bike repair stand was just beside the pump near the riverside path.
examples.zh: 「自行车自助维修架」就在河边小路附近的打气筒旁边。

examples.en: I noticed a bike repair stand next to the covered bicycle parking area.
examples.zh: 我在有顶棚的自行车停车区旁看到一个「自行车自助维修架」。

collocations: a pump beside the bike repair stand

words.enDefinition: An arrangement reserving space for a bicycle on a particular train

examples.en: My friend checked whether the email included her bike reservation for the train.
examples.zh: 朋友核对了邮件里是否包含她这趟火车的「自行车上车位预订」。

examples.en: The ticket office told me where my bike reservation was listed.
examples.zh: 售票处告诉我，「自行车上车位预订」记录在哪个位置。

words.enDefinition: A message confirming that a rental bicycle was returned

examples.en: The bike return confirmation appeared after I left the station beside the sports hall.
examples.zh: 我离开体育馆旁的停靠点后，应用显示了「单车归还确认」。

examples.en: I saved the bike return confirmation with the other details of that ride.
examples.zh: 我把「单车归还确认」和那次骑行的其他细节一起保存了下来。

words.enDefinition: An app for finding and renting shared bicycles

examples.en: I opened the bike-share app to see where the nearest bikes were.
examples.zh: 我打开「共享单车应用」，看看最近的车在哪儿。

examples.en: The bike-share app showed no open docks at the station nearest the gallery.
examples.zh: 「共享单车应用」显示，离美术馆最近的站点没有空车桩。

collocations: a map in the bike-share app

words.enDefinition: A service for short-term use of shared bicycles

examples.en: The city added bike share to the local transport map beside the cycle network.
examples.zh: 市里在本地交通地图上新增了「共享单车服务」标记，放在骑行路线网旁。

examples.en: I used bike share to meet my classmate near the riverside market.
examples.zh: 我用了「共享单车服务」，去河边市场附近和同学碰面。

words.enDefinition: Access to bike rentals through a subscription

examples.en: The app showed my bike-share membership beside the other account details.
examples.zh: 应用把我的「共享单车会员资格」显示在其他账户信息旁。

examples.en: I asked whether the bike-share membership covered stations near both university campuses.
examples.zh: 我问这个「共享单车会员资格」是否覆盖两处校区附近的停靠点。

words.enDefinition: The geographic area covered by a bicycle-sharing service

examples.en: The bike-share service area was shaded blue on the app's city map.
examples.zh: 应用的城市地图用蓝色标出了「共享单车服务范围」。

examples.en: I checked whether my new flat was inside the bike-share service area.
examples.zh: 我查了新住处是否在「共享单车服务范围」内。

words.enDefinition: A blue map marker showing the user's location

examples.en: The blue dot appeared beside the park entrance after the map finished loading.
examples.zh: 地图加载完后，代表当前位置的「蓝点」出现在公园入口旁。

examples.en: I zoomed in because the blue dot was close to two parallel streets.
examples.zh: 我放大了地图，因为代表当前位置的「蓝点」靠近两条平行街道。

collocations: the blue dot on the map
a blue dot showing your location

words.enDefinition: to enter a bus or other vehicle using its front door

examples.en: The sign asked passengers to board at the front during the festival.
examples.zh: 节庆期间，牌子请乘客「从前门上车」。

examples.en: The driver pointed to a notice saying to board at the front.
examples.zh: 司机指了指写着「从前门上车」的通知。

collocations: ask passengers to board at the front
board at the front of the bus
be ready to board at the front

words.enDefinition: A message telling passengers when or where they may board

examples.en: We heard the boarding announcement from the café beside the platforms.
examples.zh: 我们在站台旁的咖啡馆里听到了「上车广播」。

examples.en: The boarding announcement mentioned which coach was ready for passengers.
examples.zh: 「上车广播」说了哪辆长途大巴已经可以上客。

words.enDefinition: Help provided to passengers who need support boarding

examples.en: My classmate asked the airline about boarding assistance before going to the gate.
examples.zh: 同学在去登机口之前问了航空公司有关「登机协助」的问题。

examples.en: The gate agent showed us where to wait for boarding assistance that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，登机口工作人员告诉我们该在哪里等候「登机协助」。

words.enDefinition: A notice that boarding is no longer open

examples.en: The screen showed “Boarding closed” even though people were still standing nearby.
examples.zh: 尽管附近还有人站着，屏幕已经显示「登机已结束」。

examples.en: I saw “Boarding closed” beside another flight number on the gate's display.
examples.zh: 我在登机口屏幕的另一个航班号旁边看到了「登机已结束」。

words.enDefinition: An airport point passengers pass through to board

examples.en: We walked to the boarding gate after checking the number on the screen.
examples.zh: 我们核对了屏幕上的号码，然后走向「登机口」。

examples.en: The boarding gate was at the far end of the concourse near the windows.
examples.zh: 「登机口」在候机廊区的另一头，靠近窗户。

collocations: a boarding gate on the lower level

words.enDefinition: A group of passengers assigned to board together

examples.en: I checked my boarding group before joining the line beside the gate.
examples.zh: 走进登机口旁的队伍前，我确认了自己的「登机组别」。

examples.en: The boarding group on my pass was different from my classmate's group.
examples.zh: 我登机牌上的「登机组别」和同学的不一样。

words.enDefinition: A marked lane passengers use to approach the gate

examples.en: The gate agent opened another boarding lane after calling the next group.
examples.zh: 登机口工作人员叫了下一组后，又开了一条「登机排队通道」。

examples.en: I stayed outside the boarding lane until the staff asked our group to enter.
examples.zh: 工作人员请我们这一组进去之前，我一直待在「登机排队通道」外。

words.enDefinition: The sequence in which passengers are invited to board

examples.en: The sign listed the boarding order above the desk where staff were scanning passes.
examples.zh: 牌子在工作人员扫描登机牌的柜台上方列出了「登机顺序」。

examples.en: The boarding order was shown on the screen beside the flight number.
examples.zh: 「登机顺序」显示在屏幕上的航班号旁。

words.enDefinition: A machine-readable code on a boarding pass

examples.en: The gate agent asked me to show the boarding pass barcode on my phone.
examples.zh: 登机口工作人员让我出示手机上的「登机牌条码」。

examples.en: The boarding pass barcode was printed below the flight number on the slip.
examples.zh: 纸条上的「登机牌条码」印在航班号下方。

words.enDefinition: A document used to board a particular flight

examples.en: I checked the gate number on my boarding pass before leaving the airline counter.
examples.zh: 离开航空公司柜台前，我看了「登机牌」上的登机口号码。

examples.en: The agent handed me a boarding pass and pointed toward the security checkpoint.
examples.zh: 工作人员把「登机牌」递给我，然后指了指安检口。

words.enDefinition: The specific spot where passengers are expected to enter a service

examples.en: The coach's boarding point was beside the station rather than inside it.
examples.zh: 这趟长途大巴的「上车地点」在车站旁，不在里面。

examples.en: I asked whether the boarding point was the same after the change.
examples.zh: 我问变更之后的「上车地点」是不是还在原处。

words.enDefinition: a line of passengers waiting to enter a vehicle

examples.en: I joined the boarding queue after checking that it was the correct route.
examples.zh: 我确认线路没错后，排进了「上车等候队伍」。

examples.en: The boarding queue extended past the shelter when two evening services were cancelled.
examples.zh: 两班晚间线路取消后，「上车等候队伍」排到了候车亭外面。

words.enDefinition: A sloping surface allowing passengers to move between platform and vehicle

examples.en: A staff member brought a boarding ramp to the train door.
examples.zh: 工作人员把一块「登车坡板」拿到了列车门边。

examples.en: I asked who would meet us with the boarding ramp at Central.
examples.zh: 我问到中央站时谁会带着「登车坡板」来接我们。

words.enDefinition: Stairs used to enter an aircraft from the ground

examples.en: The staff pointed toward the boarding stairs when we stepped off the airport bus.
examples.zh: 我们从机场接驳车下来时，工作人员指向了「登机梯」。

examples.en: I waited at the bottom of the boarding stairs until the line moved.
examples.zh: 队伍开始移动前，我在「登机梯」底下等着。

collocations: the bottom of the boarding stairs

words.enDefinition: an announcement that boarding has temporarily stopped

examples.en: The screen said 'Boarding suspended' while an agent spoke to the crew by the door.
examples.zh: 工作人员在门旁和机组人员说话时，屏幕显示「暂停登机」。

examples.en: I saw 'Boarding suspended' when I returned from filling my water bottle near the gate.
examples.zh: 我在登机口附近灌完水回来时，看见提示「暂停登机」。

words.enDefinition: The time when boarding is scheduled to begin

examples.en: I checked the boarding time before looking for my friend in the terminal.
examples.zh: 在航站楼里找朋友之前，我查了「登机时间」。

examples.en: The airline put the boarding time next to the gate number on my pass.
examples.zh: 航空公司把「登机时间」列在登机牌的登机口编号旁边。

collocations: a boarding time on the pass

words.enDefinition: A walkway made of boards or decking

examples.en: I followed the boardwalk along the waterfront until I saw the museum entrance.
examples.zh: 我沿水边的「木板步道」走，直到看到博物馆入口。

examples.en: The boardwalk was wider near the platform where visitors stopped to take photos.
examples.zh: 访客停下来拍照的平台附近，「木板步道」更宽一些。

words.enDefinition: A device used in security to screen people

examples.en: The officer pointed out the body scanner when I asked where to stand.
examples.zh: 我问该站哪儿时，工作人员指给我看「人体安检扫描仪」。

examples.en: The sign beside the body scanner explained where passengers should ask for assistance.
examples.zh: 「人体安检扫描仪」旁的告示写明了旅客需要帮助时到哪里询问。

collocations: a body scanner at the airport
a sign beside the body scanner

words.enDefinition: to reserve a vehicle to rent at an agreed time and location

examples.en: I wanted to book a rental car before the weekend trip was finalized.
examples.zh: 周末行程定下来之前，我想先「预订租车」。

examples.en: The visitor desk showed us where we could book a rental car nearby.
examples.zh: 访客服务台告诉我们，附近可以去哪儿「预订租车」。

collocations: book a rental car in advance
book a rental car for the weekend

words.enDefinition: A code that identifies a passenger's booking

examples.en: I entered my booking reference to open the reservation on the airline's website.
examples.zh: 我输入「预订编号」，打开了航空公司网站上的订票记录。

examples.en: The check-in agent asked for the booking reference from my original email.
examples.zh: 值机人员请我提供原始邮件中的「预订编号」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of room available in a car's rear luggage compartment

examples.en: We checked the boot space to see whether the exhibition display would fit.
examples.zh: 我们查看了「汽车后备厢空间」，看看能不能装下展品。

examples.en: The rental listing showed boot space beside the number of passenger seats.
examples.zh: 租车车型列表把「汽车后备厢空间」和乘客座位数列在一起。

words.enDefinition: A stop made partway through a rail journey before continuing later

examples.en: I asked the rail agent what break of journey meant for that route.
examples.zh: 我问铁路售票员，在那条线路上「中途下车后续乘」指什么。

examples.en: The example showed a break of journey in the town where we changed trains.
examples.zh: 示例展示了可以在换乘的小镇「中途下车后续乘」。

words.enDefinition: a policy or service plan covering specified assistance after a vehicle failure

examples.en: The UK quote described breakdown cover on a separate page from the rental terms.
examples.zh: 英国报价把「车辆故障救援保障」和租车条款分在不同页面。

examples.en: I asked whether the plan called breakdown cover included transport to a repair garage.
examples.zh: 我问「车辆故障救援保障」是否包含把车运到修理厂。

words.enDefinition: A morning meal set out for guests to serve themselves

examples.en: Our group met at the breakfast buffet before walking to campus.
examples.zh: 我们去学校之前，在「自助早餐」区碰面。

examples.en: I checked when the breakfast buffet would open on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我查看了星期六「自助早餐」几点开始供应。

words.enDefinition: A booking label indicating breakfast forms part of the price

examples.en: The room was marked breakfast included on the hotel's website.
examples.zh: 酒店网站给这间客房标了「包含早餐」。

examples.en: I asked what breakfast included meant on our confirmation email.
examples.zh: 我问确认邮件里写的「包含早餐」具体指什么。

collocations: book a room with breakfast included

words.enDefinition: extra time included to allow for possible delays

examples.en: We left buffer time between the two visits in case the first tour ran late.
examples.zh: 我们在两次参观之间「预留了机动时间」，以防第一场导览拖延。

examples.en: The buffer time gave us a chance to sit down after leaving the tower.
examples.zh: 从塔里出来后，「预留的机动时间」让我们有机会坐下来歇一会儿。

words.enDefinition: A seat directly behind a partition in an aircraft

examples.en: The agent offered a bulkhead seat in the first row of that cabin section.
examples.zh: 工作人员提供了客舱该区第一排一个「紧靠隔板后方的座位」。

examples.en: I asked where the bulkhead seat was before accepting the new seat assignment.
examples.zh: 接受新分配的座位之前，我问「紧靠隔板后方的座位」在哪儿。

collocations: a bulkhead seat near the front

words.enDefinition: damage to the protective front or rear part of a vehicle

examples.en: The agent took photos of the bumper damage during our rental inspection.
examples.zh: 检查租车时，代理拍下了「保险杠受损」的照片。

examples.en: The report noted bumper damage on the lower rear corner of the vehicle.
examples.zh: 记录注明车尾下角有「保险杠受损」。

words.enDefinition: a marked stopping space that a bus pulls into to pick up or drop off passengers

examples.en: The driver pulled into the bus bay while passengers waited by the market.
examples.zh: 乘客在市场旁等候时，司机把车开进了「公交停靠港湾」。

examples.en: The bus bay was set back from the main traffic lane near campus.
examples.zh: 学校附近的「公交停靠港湾」向主车道外侧凹进去。

words.enDefinition: a disruption in which buses that should be spaced apart arrive close together

examples.en: We saw bus bunching when three vehicles arrived together after a long wait.
examples.zh: 等了很久后连来三辆车，我们碰到了「公交车扎堆到站」。

examples.en: The transit report mentioned bus bunching on the route outside our campus.
examples.zh: 交通报告提到，学校外那条线路出现了「公交车扎堆到站」。

collocations: bus bunching on a busy route

words.enDefinition: a place where buses are kept, maintained or prepared when they are not serving passengers

examples.en: The route map showed a bus depot beside the industrial park outside town.
examples.zh: 线路图标出了城外工业园旁边的「公交车辆场站」。

examples.en: I wondered why the empty bus was heading toward the bus depot.
examples.zh: 我想知道那辆空车为什么开往「公交车辆场站」。

collocations: a maintenance area at a bus depot

words.enDefinition: A gate where passengers take a bus to the aircraft

examples.en: The bus gate was downstairs at the end of the newer concourse.
examples.zh: 「接驳车登机口」在楼下，位于较新的候机廊区尽头。

examples.en: I asked why our flight was listed at a bus gate on the screen.
examples.zh: 我问为什么屏幕显示我们这趟航班在「接驳车登机口」。

collocations: a sign for the bus gate

words.enDefinition: a lane reserved mainly for buses according to local rules

examples.en: Our bus moved quickly in the bus lane beside the morning traffic.
examples.zh: 早上车多，我们的车沿着「公交专用车道」开得很快。

examples.en: The window faced the bus lane on the road outside my flat.
examples.zh: 窗户正对着公寓外道路上的「公交专用车道」。

words.enDefinition: a high-capacity bus service designed for faster, more reliable trips, often using dedicated lanes

examples.en: The city opened a bus rapid transit route from campus to the hospital.
examples.zh: 市里开了一条从校区到医院的「快速公交系统」线路。

examples.en: Our class compared bus rapid transit with ordinary routes that use shared lanes.
examples.zh: 我们在课上比较了「快速公交系统」和走混合车道的普通线路。

collocations: build a bus rapid transit corridor

words.enDefinition: the path and sequence of stops followed by a scheduled bus service

examples.en: I checked which bus route went past the building for my placement.
examples.zh: 我查了哪条「公交线路」会经过我实习的那栋楼。

examples.en: The city changed one bus route after the road near campus closed.
examples.zh: 学校附近道路封闭后，市里调整了一条「公交线路」。

words.enDefinition: a covered structure that provides protection while people wait for a bus

examples.en: We moved into the bus shelter when it started raining after class.
examples.zh: 下课后开始下雨，我们就走进了「公交候车亭」。

examples.en: The bus shelter beside campus had a seat and a small route map.
examples.zh: 学校旁边的「公交候车亭」里有座位，还有张小线路图。

words.enDefinition: a unique identifier for a particular bus stop used in timetables or travel apps

examples.en: I entered the bus stop code to see when the next service would arrive.
examples.zh: 我输入「公交站查询编码」，查看下一班什么时候到。

examples.en: The bus stop code was printed at the bottom of the information panel.
examples.zh: 「公交站查询编码」印在信息牌的最下面。

collocations: look up a bus stop code

words.enDefinition: the vertical post that supports a bus stop sign or route information

examples.en: I found the revised timetable attached to the bus stop pole near the café.
examples.zh: 我发现改过的时刻表贴在咖啡馆附近的「公交站牌立杆」上。

examples.en: The bus stop pole had a small code below the route numbers.
examples.zh: 「公交站牌立杆」在线路编号下面写了一小行代码。

collocations: read a notice on the bus stop pole
stand beside the bus stop pole
a clearly marked bus stop pole

words.enDefinition: a facility where several bus routes begin or end and passengers can change services

examples.en: We changed buses at the bus terminal closest to the main campus.
examples.zh: 我们在离主校区最近的「公交总站」换了车。

examples.en: I checked the departure board inside the bus terminal after buying a ticket.
examples.zh: 买好票后，我在「公交总站」里面看了发车牌。

collocations: change buses at a bus terminal

words.enDefinition: an app or display showing where buses are and when they may reach stops

examples.en: I opened the bus tracker before walking out of the student residence.
examples.zh: 走出学生公寓前，我打开了「公交位置跟踪工具」。

examples.en: The bus tracker showed the vehicle still waiting at its first stop.
examples.zh: 「公交位置跟踪工具」显示，那辆车还停在始发站。

words.enDefinition: a spoken message played to passengers inside the aircraft

examples.en: A cabin announcement gave the arrival time while I was putting my book away.
examples.zh: 我正收起书时，「客舱广播」播报了到达时间。

examples.en: I missed the first cabin announcement because I was still wearing my headphones.
examples.zh: 我当时还戴着耳机，没听到第一条「客舱广播」。

words.enDefinition: the staff who look after passengers inside the aircraft

examples.en: The cabin crew answered questions about connections before we arrived at the next airport.
examples.zh: 到下一个机场前，「客舱乘务组」回答了转机方面的问题。

examples.en: I thanked the cabin crew for checking whether my headphones were still on the seat.
examples.zh: 我感谢「客舱乘务组」帮我查看耳机还在不在座位上。

collocations: a member of the cabin crew

words.enDefinition: the lights used inside the passenger area of an aircraft

examples.en: The crew dimmed the cabin lighting after dinner while most of us settled down.
examples.zh: 晚饭后大多数人安顿下来时，乘务组调暗了「客舱照明」。

examples.en: I stopped reading when the cabin lighting changed and the screen became easier to see.
examples.zh: 「客舱照明」变了，屏幕更好看清，我就不看书了。

words.enDefinition: A train carriage selling drinks and snacks to passengers onboard

examples.en: The conductor said the café car was two carriages ahead of ours.
examples.zh: 列车员说，「列车轻食车厢」在我们前面两节车厢。

examples.en: I picked up tea from the café car before returning to my seat.
examples.zh: 我在「列车轻食车厢」买了茶，然后回到了座位上。

collocations: buy coffee in the café car

words.enDefinition: The particular stations where a train is scheduled to stop

examples.en: The screen listed the calling points below the final destination.
examples.zh: 屏幕在终点站下方列出了「沿途停靠站」。

examples.en: I checked the calling points before deciding if I needed to change trains.
examples.zh: 我看了「沿途停靠站」，才决定是否需要换乘。

words.enDefinition: asks whether admission is possible before the scheduled time

examples.en: Can we enter earlier if a spot opens before our scheduled visit this afternoon?
examples.zh: 如果下午我们预订的参观前有空位，「我们能早点入场吗」？

examples.en: Can we enter earlier because our group has already finished visiting the garden?
examples.zh: 我们小组已经逛完花园了，「能早点入场吗」？

collocations: can we enter earlier if there is space?
can we enter earlier than our booked slot?
since we're here already, can we enter earlier?

words.expression: can we leave our bags here
words.lemma: can we leave our bags here
words.zhGloss: 我们能把包寄放在这里吗
words.enDefinition: asks whether there is somewhere to store your bags during the visit
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们能把包寄放在这里吗
acceptedEnVariants: can we leave our bags here

examples.en: Can we leave our bags here while we visit the rooms on the upper floor?
examples.zh: 我们上楼参观那些房间时，「能把包寄放在这里吗」？

examples.en: Can we leave our bags here until the walking tour comes back this afternoon?
examples.zh: 「我们能把包寄放在这里吗」？下午步行团回来再取。

collocations: can we leave our bags here during the tour?
excuse me, can we leave our bags here?
before we go in, can we leave our bags here?

words.expression: can we swap the order of the stops
words.lemma: can we swap the order of the stops
words.zhGloss: 我们能调换各站顺序吗
words.enDefinition: asks whether the group can visit stops in a different order
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们能调换各站顺序吗
acceptedEnVariants: can we swap the order of the stops

examples.en: Can we swap the order of the stops so we reach the garden before lunch?
examples.zh: 「我们能调换各站顺序吗」？这样午饭前就能到花园。

examples.en: Can we swap the order of the stops if the market opens later today?
examples.zh: 如果市场今天晚开门，「我们能调换各站顺序吗」？

collocations: can we swap the order of the stops today?
can we swap the order of the stops for tomorrow?
if it helps, can we swap the order of the stops?

words.enDefinition: a scheduled trip or vehicle that the operator no longer plans to run

examples.en: The app marked a cancelled service after the road near campus closed.
examples.zh: 学校附近的路封闭后，应用标出了一趟「取消的班次」。

examples.en: I chose another route when the driver mentioned the cancelled service at the station.
examples.zh: 司机提到车站有一趟「取消的班次」后，我选了另一条线路。

collocations: a notice about a cancelled service

words.enDefinition: A lodging business providing small individual sleeping pods to guests

examples.en: I tried a capsule hotel on a short trip with friends.
examples.zh: 我和朋友短途旅行时，体验了一次「胶囊旅馆」。

examples.en: The capsule hotel had a shared area for suitcases near reception.
examples.zh: 这家「胶囊旅馆」的前台附近有个共用的行李箱存放区。

collocations: a capsule hotel near the station

words.enDefinition: the service or arrangement of paying to use a car temporarily

examples.en: We shared the cost of car rental for our weekend trip out of town.
examples.zh: 周末出城玩时，我们分摊了「汽车租赁」费用。

examples.en: The visitor guide listed car rental near the bus and rail information.
examples.zh: 游客指南在大巴和铁路信息附近列出了「汽车租赁」服务。

words.enDefinition: a business that rents cars to customers for temporary use

examples.en: I contacted the car rental agency after seeing two dates on my confirmation.
examples.zh: 我发现确认单上有两个日期，就联系了「汽车租赁公司」。

examples.en: The car rental agency had an office just outside the train station.
examples.zh: 这家「汽车租赁公司」在火车站外面有个办公室。

collocations: book with a car rental agency

words.enDefinition: a marked parking space reserved for a shared vehicle or service

examples.en: The map showed the car-share bay behind the student hall near the gate.
examples.zh: 地图标出了学生礼堂后门附近的「共享汽车专用车位」。

examples.en: I found the car-share bay by looking for the numbered sign.
examples.zh: 我找到了写着编号的牌子，也找到了「共享汽车专用车位」。

collocations: return a vehicle to a car-share bay

words.enDefinition: membership of a service that lets users book shared cars

examples.en: I signed up for car-share membership before my placement outside the city.
examples.zh: 去城外实习前，我注册取得了「共享汽车会员资格」。

examples.en: The app showed when my car-share membership would need to be renewed.
examples.zh: 应用显示我的「共享汽车会员资格」什么时候要续期。

words.enDefinition: a service providing vehicles that members or customers can book for temporary use

examples.en: Our classmate used a car-sharing service to collect supplies for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 同学用了「共享汽车服务」，去取展览需要的物资。

examples.en: I checked whether the car-sharing service had vehicles near the student residence.
examples.zh: 我查了「共享汽车服务」在学生公寓附近有没有可用车辆。

words.enDefinition: A door allowing entry to or exit from a train carriage

examples.en: I waited near the carriage door with my small suitcase.
examples.zh: 我带着小行李箱，在「车厢门」附近等候。

examples.en: The carriage door was opposite the sign showing our coach number.
examples.zh: 「车厢门」正对着标有我们车厢编号的牌子。

collocations: stand clear of the carriage door

words.enDefinition: A letter identifying one passenger carriage of a particular train

examples.en: I matched the carriage letter by the door to the one on my ticket.
examples.zh: 我把车门旁的「车厢字母编号」和车票上的编号核对了一下。

examples.en: The carriage letter was painted just below the first window.
examples.zh: 「车厢字母编号」涂在第一扇窗户正下方。

collocations: match the carriage letter to your ticket

words.enDefinition: A sign showing where a numbered train carriage is expected to stop

examples.en: I waited by the carriage marker after checking which coach I needed.
examples.zh: 核对我要坐哪节车厢后，我在「车厢候车位置标识」旁等车。

examples.en: The carriage marker was painted on the ground near the stairs.
examples.zh: 「车厢候车位置标识」涂在楼梯附近的地面上。

words.enDefinition: The cabin baggage covered by a ticket's terms

examples.en: I asked about the carry-on allowance before choosing which bag to bring.
examples.zh: 决定带哪个包之前，我问了「随身行李额度」。

examples.en: The carry-on allowance for our flight was shown separately from the checked baggage details.
examples.zh: 我们这趟航班的「随身行李额度」和托运行李详情分开显示。

collocations: a carry-on allowance on the booking

words.enDefinition: A bag a passenger takes into the cabin

examples.en: I kept my book in my carry-on bag so I could read while waiting.
examples.zh: 我把书放在「随身登机行李」里，这样候机时可以看。

examples.en: The agent asked which bag was my carry-on bag before she tagged the suitcase.
examples.zh: 工作人员给行李箱贴标签前，问我哪件是「随身登机行李」。

collocations: place a carry-on bag in the cabin

words.enDefinition: the fare amount when a passenger pays for transport using cash

examples.en: I asked the driver whether the cash fare matched the price on the sign.
examples.zh: 我问司机，「现金车费」是不是和牌子上的价格一样。

examples.en: The notice listed the cash fare separately from the electronic card fare.
examples.zh: 通知把「现金车费」和电子卡票价分开列了。

words.enDefinition: to board the final scheduled bus for a route or destination

examples.en: We packed up early so we could catch the last bus home.
examples.zh: 我们提早收拾好东西，为的是「赶上末班公交」回家。

examples.en: I checked whether we could still catch the last bus after the film.
examples.zh: 我查了电影结束后还能不能「赶上末班公交」。

collocations: run to catch the last bus
leave in time to catch the last bus
hope to catch the last bus

words.enDefinition: to switch from one transit line to another during a journey

examples.en: I had to change lines at the next station to reach the new campus.
examples.zh: 我要在下一站「换乘另一条线路」，才能到新校区。

examples.en: The route planner showed where we could change lines without leaving the station.
examples.zh: 行程规划工具标出了哪里不用出站就能「换乘另一条线路」。

words.enDefinition: To move from one guest room to another during a stay

examples.en: I asked to change rooms because the room faced the main road.
examples.zh: 因为客房朝着主路，我问能不能「换客房」。

examples.en: The front desk offered to let us change rooms after breakfast.
examples.zh: 前台说早餐后可以让我们「换客房」。

collocations: offer to let a guest change rooms

words.enDefinition: To leave one train and board another during a journey

examples.en: We needed to change trains before reaching the town on the coast.
examples.zh: 我们得「换乘火车」，才能到海边的那个小镇。

examples.en: I checked which station we had to change trains at on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我查了星期天得在哪个车站「换乘火车」。

words.enDefinition: A fare allowing changes to a booking under its terms

examples.en: I checked what the coach website meant by a changeable fare.
examples.zh: 我看了看长途大巴网站上说的「可改签票价」是什么意思。

examples.en: The clerk explained which conditions came with the changeable fare.
examples.zh: 售票员解释了「可改签票价」附带哪些条件。

words.enDefinition: weather that changes quickly or often

examples.en: The changeable weather made us leave a few hours free for an indoor visit.
examples.zh: 由于「天气多变」，我们留了几小时，可以安排室内参观。

examples.en: I packed an extra layer because the guide warned us about changeable weather near the coast.
examples.zh: 导游提醒我们海边「天气多变」，所以我多带了一层衣服。

words.enDefinition: the amount of energy remaining in a battery, often displayed as a percentage

examples.en: I checked the charge level on the dashboard before returning the electric car.
examples.zh: 还电动汽车前，我看了仪表盘上的「电池电量水平」。

examples.en: The app showed a different charge level after the vehicle was plugged in.
examples.zh: 车接上充电后，应用显示的「电池电量水平」变了。

words.enDefinition: the socket on a device or vehicle through which charging power is supplied

examples.en: The rental agent pointed out the charging port on the side of the car.
examples.zh: 租车代理指给我看车侧面的「充电接口」。

examples.en: I checked where the charging port was before connecting at the station.
examples.zh: 在充电站接线前，我先看了「充电接口」在什么地方。

words.enDefinition: one period during which an electric vehicle is connected and receives electricity

examples.en: The receipt listed the charging session separately from the parking charge that day.
examples.zh: 收据把当天的「一次车辆充电」和停车费分开列出。

examples.en: I checked when the charging session ended before leaving the car park.
examples.zh: 离开停车场前，我查了「这次车辆充电」什么时候结束。

collocations: the cost of a charging session

words.enDefinition: To hand a bag over for transport in the hold

examples.en: Can I check a bag at this counter if I already have my boarding pass?
examples.zh: 我已经有登机牌了，可以在这个柜台「托运一件行李」吗？

examples.en: I decided to check a bag because I was bringing books from my course.
examples.zh: 我带了课上的书，就决定「托运一件行李」。

collocations: check a bag at the airport

words.enDefinition: An airline worker who assists passengers at check-in

examples.en: The check-in agent looked up both bookings when we arrived at the counter.
examples.zh: 我们到柜台时，「值机人员」查了两份预订记录。

examples.en: I asked the check-in agent whether my classmate and I could sit together.
examples.zh: 我问「值机人员」能不能让我和同学坐在一起。

collocations: a check-in agent at the counter

words.enDefinition: The terminal space where passengers check in

examples.en: The check-in area was quiet when our group arrived with all our luggage.
examples.zh: 我们一行人带着行李到达时，「值机区」很安静。

examples.en: We chose a meeting point just outside the check-in area near the escalator.
examples.zh: 我们选了个碰面地点，就在自动扶梯旁的「值机区」外面。

words.enDefinition: The conveyor taking checked baggage from the counter

examples.en: The agent lifted my suitcase onto the check-in belt after checking the new tag.
examples.zh: 工作人员核对新标签后，把我的行李箱放上了「值机托运行李传送带」。

examples.en: I waited beside the check-in belt until the suitcase moved away from the counter.
examples.zh: 我等在「值机托运行李传送带」旁，直到行李箱离开柜台。

collocations: place a bag on the check-in belt
a suitcase on the check-in belt

words.enDefinition: A message showing that check-in was completed

examples.en: I saved the check-in confirmation after the page showed my flight and seat details.
examples.zh: 页面显示航班和座位详情后，我保存了「值机确认信息」。

examples.en: My check-in confirmation appeared in the app shortly after I finished the form.
examples.zh: 我填完表单后不久，「值机确认信息」就出现在应用里。

words.enDefinition: The latest time check-in is accepted

examples.en: I checked the check-in cutoff in the airline's message before booking my airport bus.
examples.zh: 订机场公交之前，我在航空公司的消息里查了「值机截止时间」。

examples.en: The check-in cutoff was listed under a different heading from the boarding time.
examples.zh: 「值机截止时间」列在一个与登机时间不同的栏目下。

collocations: the check-in cutoff for a flight

words.enDefinition: To register as ready to travel on a flight

examples.en: I needed to check in for a flight before meeting my friend downstairs.
examples.zh: 我得先「办理航班值机」，再去楼下找朋友。

examples.en: Can I check in for a flight with my booking reference at this machine?
examples.zh: 我可以在这台机器上用预订编号「办理航班值机」吗？

collocations: use a kiosk to check in for a flight
arrive to check in for a flight
check in for a flight online

words.enDefinition: A line of passengers waiting to check in

examples.en: The check-in queue started near the pillar in the middle of the departure hall.
examples.zh: 「值机队伍」从出发大厅中间的柱子旁开始排。

examples.en: I joined the check-in queue after finding my booking confirmation on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机上找出预订确认邮件后，就排进了「值机队伍」。

words.enDefinition: A row of counters used for checking in

examples.en: The sign gave a check-in row for each airline in the departure hall.
examples.zh: 出发大厅的牌子上标出了每家航空公司对应的「值机柜台所在排」。

examples.en: I checked the letter above the check-in row before joining my classmate.
examples.zh: 我看了「值机柜台所在排」上方的字母，再去找同学。

collocations: a sign above a check-in row

words.enDefinition: The published time for a guest to start checking in

examples.en: I checked the check-in time before booking our afternoon train.
examples.zh: 我先查看了「办理入住的时间」，才订我们的下午火车。

examples.en: The email showed a different check-in time from the original listing.
examples.zh: 邮件写的「办理入住的时间」与原住宿页面上的不同。

words.enDefinition: tell the guide that you have arrived for the tour

examples.en: Please check in with the guide by the steps before we set off together.
examples.zh: 一起出发前，「请在台阶旁向导游报到」。

examples.en: I went to check in with the guide before looking for somewhere to sit.
examples.zh: 我先去「向导游报到」，再找地方坐。

collocations: please check in with the guide
remember to check in with the guide
check in with the guide at the entrance

words.enDefinition: The time by which a guest is expected to leave a room

examples.en: I checked the check-out time before arranging breakfast with my friend.
examples.zh: 约朋友吃早餐之前，我查了「最晚退房时间」。

examples.en: The check-out time was written on a note behind the door.
examples.zh: 「最晚退房时间」写在门后的一张提示纸上。

words.enDefinition: Baggage handed over for transport in the hold

examples.en: I checked that both suitcases appeared as checked baggage in the airline's app.
examples.zh: 我确认航空公司应用把两个行李箱都列为「托运行李」。

examples.en: The email had a separate section listing our checked baggage for the trip.
examples.zh: 邮件单独用一栏列出了我们这趟行程的「托运行李」。

words.enDefinition: The checked baggage covered under a ticket's terms

examples.en: My checked baggage allowance was different from my classmate's because we booked different fares.
examples.zh: 我和同学订了不同的票价类型，所以「托运行李额度」也不同。

examples.en: The booking email showed the checked baggage allowance below each passenger's name.
examples.zh: 预订邮件在每位乘客姓名下方显示了「托运行李额度」。

collocations: look up your checked baggage allowance

words.enDefinition: used for baggage accepted for transfer to a named airport

examples.en: The bag label showed that my suitcase was checked through to the final airport.
examples.zh: 行李标签显示，我的箱子已「直挂至最终到达的机场」。

examples.en: I asked whether our bags were checked through to Boston or just to the transfer airport.
examples.zh: 我问我们的行李是「直挂至波士顿」，还是只托运到转机机场。

collocations: bags checked through to the final destination
luggage checked through to the next airport
ask if it is checked through to the end

words.enDefinition: Directions explaining what guests should do before leaving an accommodation

examples.en: The host sent the checkout instructions the evening before we left.
examples.zh: 接待方在我们离开的前一晚发来了「退房须知」。

examples.en: The checkout instructions explained where to leave our room keys.
examples.zh: 「退房须知」说明了客房钥匙要放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a short leisure trip spent visiting a city

examples.en: We took a city break during our reading week and visited two museums each day.
examples.zh: 阅读周我们去了一趟「城市短假游」，每天参观两家博物馆。

examples.en: My flatmate wanted a city break with plenty of time for cafés and galleries.
examples.zh: 室友想来趟「城市短假游」，留足时间去咖啡馆和画廊。

words.enDefinition: A local tax associated with overnight stays in some cities

examples.en: The hostel listed the city tax separately on our accommodation receipt.
examples.zh: 旅舍在我们的住宿收据上单列了「城市住宿税」。

examples.en: I asked whether the city tax appeared on each person's receipt.
examples.zh: 我问每个人的收据上是不是都列了「城市住宿税」。

words.enDefinition: a fee for cleaning a vehicle or item beyond what is included in an agreement

examples.en: The final rental invoice showed a cleaning charge under the extra fees section.
examples.zh: 租车的最终账单在额外费用一节列出了一项「清洁费」。

examples.en: I asked the clerk for a description of the cleaning charge listed on my receipt.
examples.zh: 我请办事员说明收据上列的「清洁费」具体是什么。

words.enDefinition: given permission by air traffic control to take off

examples.en: The captain said we were cleared for takeoff after a long wait on the ground.
examples.zh: 在地面等了很久后，机长说我们已经「获准起飞」。

examples.en: We were cleared for takeoff just as I finished reading the first chapter of my book.
examples.zh: 我刚读完书的第一章，飞机就「获准起飞」了。

words.enDefinition: unavailable for entry by people coming to visit

examples.en: The courtyard was closed to visitors while staff prepared for an event that evening.
examples.zh: 工作人员在准备晚间活动，院子「不对游客开放」。

examples.en: We followed a different path because the old reading room was closed to visitors.
examples.zh: 老阅览室「不对游客开放」，我们就走了另一条路线。

words.enDefinition: Amtrak's regular seated travel class on many passenger train services

examples.en: The Amtrak app listed Coach Class for our overnight trip.
examples.zh: Amtrak 应用显示，我们的夜间行程有「美式列车普通座席」可选。

examples.en: My friend checked whether Coach Class was available on that departure.
examples.zh: 朋友核对了那趟车有没有「美式列车普通座席」。

words.enDefinition: The person responsible for driving a bus on a long route

examples.en: I asked the coach driver where to put my small case.
examples.zh: 我问「长途大巴司机」小箱子该放在哪儿。

examples.en: The coach driver checked our tickets before calling the next group.
examples.zh: 「长途大巴司机」查过我们的车票后，叫了下一组乘客。

collocations: a notice from the coach driver

words.enDefinition: The price charged for a journey on a long-distance bus

examples.en: I checked the coach fare before suggesting the trip to my flatmates.
examples.zh: 我先看了「长途大巴票价」，才跟室友们提议去旅行。

examples.en: The screen showed the coach fare beside the departure time.
examples.zh: 屏幕在发车时间旁显示了「长途大巴票价」。

words.enDefinition: A number identifying a particular passenger carriage on a train

examples.en: I checked the coach number on the side of the train.
examples.zh: 我核对了车身上的「列车车厢编号」。

examples.en: The ticket displayed my seat beside the coach number for that carriage.
examples.zh: 车票上的「列车车厢编号」旁写了我的座位。

collocations: the coach number on your ticket

words.enDefinition: A terminal where intercity buses pick up and drop passengers

examples.en: We walked to the coach station together after our last lecture.
examples.zh: 最后一节课结束后，我们一起走去「长途大巴站」。

examples.en: I asked where to find the entrance to the coach station.
examples.zh: 我问「长途大巴站」的入口在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: One flight sold under codes by multiple airlines

examples.en: I saw two different flight numbers for the same codeshare flight on my itinerary.
examples.zh: 我在行程单上看到，同一趟「代码共享航班」有两个不同的航班号。

examples.en: The airline counter explained which number to look for because it was a codeshare flight.
examples.zh: 因为是「代码共享航班」，航司柜台的工作人员告诉我要找哪个航班号。

collocations: check in for a codeshare flight

words.enDefinition: a small storage compartment that uses a coin to operate

examples.en: I used a coin-operated locker for my daypack before starting the tour of the house.
examples.zh: 进老宅参加导览前，我用「投币式寄存柜」存了当天背的小包。

examples.en: The visitor center had a coin-operated locker next to the desk where we got maps.
examples.zh: 游客中心在我们拿地图的服务台旁边设了个「投币式寄存柜」。

words.enDefinition: pick up a checked bag and hand it in for the next flight

examples.en: I asked where to collect and recheck my bag before heading to the next terminal.
examples.zh: 去下一座航站楼前，我问了在哪儿「领回行李再办理托运」。

examples.en: I had to collect and recheck my bag during the connection shown on my itinerary.
examples.zh: 这次行程单上的转机，我得「领回行李再办理托运」。

collocations: need to collect and recheck my bag
where to collect and recheck my bag
time to collect and recheck my bag

words.enDefinition: to go to a specified place and receive the keys for a vehicle

examples.en: I went to collect the keys after signing the rental agreement at reception.
examples.zh: 在接待处签完租车协议后，我去「领取车钥匙」。

examples.en: The confirmation said to collect the keys from the desk beside the entrance.
examples.zh: 确认单上说，要到入口旁的柜台「领取车钥匙」。

collocations: collect the keys at the desk
be ready to collect the keys

words.enDefinition: To take back the personal items you brought

examples.en: The sign asked you to collect your belongings before leaving the screening area.
examples.zh: 告示请你在离开安检区前「拿回随身物品」。

examples.en: Where do you collect your belongings after your tray reaches the other side?
examples.zh: 托盘到另一边后，你在哪里「拿回随身物品」？

collocations: collect your belongings from the tray
ask you to collect your belongings

words.enDefinition: To pick up tickets that have already been booked

examples.en: The confirmation tells you where to collect your tickets at the station.
examples.zh: 确认信息会告诉你在车站哪里「领取车票」。

examples.en: My friend asked how to collect your tickets when the machine was closed.
examples.zh: 朋友问机器停用时怎样「领取车票」。

collocations: collect your tickets at the station
collect your tickets from a machine

words.enDefinition: a rental-company agreement to reduce liability for specified damage to the rented vehicle

examples.en: The agent explained the collision damage waiver before I read the agreement.
examples.zh: 我读协议前，代理说明了「碰撞损坏责任减免」。

examples.en: The quote listed a collision damage waiver separately from the daily hire rate.
examples.zh: 报价把「碰撞损坏责任减免」和每日租车费率分开列出。

collocations: terms of a collision damage waiver

words.enDefinition: one ticket covering a fixed set of specific sites or attractions

examples.en: We bought a combination ticket for the garden and the house before walking to either.
examples.zh: 去花园或老宅前，我们买了两处通用的「景点联票」。

examples.en: The combination ticket included both rooms, so we visited the upper floor first.
examples.zh: 「景点联票」涵盖两个房间，所以我们先参观了楼上的。

collocations: a combination ticket for two sites

words.enDefinition: A short pause in a journey for passengers to use facilities

examples.en: The coach driver announced a comfort break at the next stop.
examples.zh: 长途大巴司机说，下一站会「途中短暂休息」。

examples.en: I asked how long the comfort break would be at the service area.
examples.zh: 我问在服务区「途中短暂休息」会有多长时间。

words.enDefinition: shoes comfortable enough for walking for a long time

examples.en: I wore comfortable walking shoes because we planned to see most of the old town.
examples.zh: 我们计划逛老城的大部分地方，所以我穿了双「适合长时间步行的鞋」。

examples.en: My flatmate brought comfortable walking shoes after seeing how many stops the tour included.
examples.zh: 室友看到导览要停很多站，就带了双「适合长时间步行的鞋」。

collocations: a pair of comfortable walking shoes

words.enDefinition: a car in a relatively small size class, with definitions varying between companies

examples.en: I checked that the compact car had enough room for our two bags.
examples.zh: 我确认了「紧凑型汽车」能放下我们的两个包。

examples.en: The rental counter offered a compact car after we asked about parking space.
examples.zh: 我们问了停车空间的问题后，租车柜台给我们提供了一辆「紧凑型汽车」。

words.enDefinition: Personal washing products available to hotel guests without a separate charge

examples.en: The hotel placed complimentary toiletries in a basket beside the bathroom sink.
examples.zh: 酒店在浴室洗手池旁的篮子里放了「免费洗漱用品」。

examples.en: I checked whether the guesthouse listed complimentary toiletries with the room.
examples.zh: 我查看了小旅馆有没有在客房信息中列出「免费洗漱用品」。

words.enDefinition: a reduced fare offered to groups that meet the operator's eligibility conditions

examples.en: The machine displayed concession fare as a category beneath the standard adult price.
examples.zh: 售票机在标准成人票价下方单列了「特定人群优惠车费」。

examples.en: I asked which student documents were accepted for the concession fare in that city.
examples.zh: 我问在那个城市，乘车要享受「特定人群优惠车费」可用哪些学生证件。

words.zhGloss: 面向特定人群的优惠票
words.enDefinition: a reduced-price ticket for eligible groups of visitors
acceptedZhAnswers: 面向特定人群的优惠票

examples.en: At the UK gallery, I asked who could buy a concession ticket for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 在英国这家画廊，我问了展览「面向特定人群的优惠票」谁可以买。

examples.en: She checked whether she could use a concession ticket before booking a morning visit.
examples.zh: 订上午的参观前，她查了自己是否可以用「面向特定人群的优惠票」。

words.enDefinition: A hotel desk helping guests with local information and arrangements

examples.en: I picked up a city map from the concierge desk downstairs.
examples.zh: 我在楼下的「酒店礼宾台」拿了一张城市地图。

examples.en: The concierge desk told us which entrance led toward the university.
examples.zh: 「酒店礼宾台」告诉我们哪个出口通往大学方向。

collocations: a map from the concierge desk

words.enDefinition: A terminal corridor or hall serving multiple gates

examples.en: The concourse had several gates and two long rows of seats along the windows.
examples.zh: 「候机廊区」里有几个登机口，沿窗摆着两长排座位。

examples.en: We followed the signs along the concourse until we could see our gate.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「候机廊区」照指示牌走，直到看到自己的登机口。

words.enDefinition: a place secured on a flight without waiting for an opening

examples.en: I didn't have a confirmed seat on the earlier flight, so I waited downstairs.
examples.zh: 早一趟航班上我还没有「已确认的座位」，所以在楼下等着。

examples.en: The airline sent an update when I finally had a confirmed seat on the replacement flight.
examples.zh: 我终于拿到替代航班上「已确认的座位」时，航空公司发来了更新消息。

words.enDefinition: change flights at a specified airport or city on the way

examples.en: We decided to connect via Dublin because the two flights fit our class schedule better.
examples.zh: 这两趟航班更适合我们的课表，所以我们决定「经都柏林转机」。

examples.en: I can connect via the same airport on my way back, depending on the times.
examples.zh: 看时间是否合适，我回来也可以「经同一个机场转机」。

collocations: choose to connect via a hub

words.enDefinition: A coach used to continue a trip after an earlier service

examples.en: The connecting coach left from a bay behind the train station.
examples.zh: 「接续长途大巴」从火车站后面的一个车位出发。

examples.en: I asked where we would board our connecting coach that evening.
examples.zh: 我问当天晚上在哪里上我们的「接续长途大巴」。

words.enDefinition: a later flight that continues your journey after you change planes

examples.en: My connecting flight left from a different terminal, so I checked the route before landing.
examples.zh: 我的「转乘航班」从另一座航站楼出发，所以我着陆前就查了路线。

examples.en: A crew member showed me where to check the gate for my connecting flight.
examples.zh: 一位乘务员告诉我在哪里查「转乘航班」的登机口。

collocations: the gate for a connecting flight

words.enDefinition: Guest rooms linked by a door inside the rooms

examples.en: My friend's family asked for connecting rooms when they visited campus.
examples.zh: 我朋友一家来学校探访时，问有没有「有内门相通的客房」。

examples.en: The photos showed the doors between the two connecting rooms.
examples.zh: 照片展示了两间「有内门相通的客房」之间的门。

words.enDefinition: a transport service that a passenger can change to in order to continue a journey

examples.en: I found the connecting service on the screen after getting off the tram.
examples.zh: 下了有轨电车后，我在屏幕上找到了「接续班次」。

examples.en: The guide showed where the connecting service would stop during the works.
examples.zh: 指南标出了施工期间「接续班次」在哪里停。

collocations: take a connecting service to campus

words.enDefinition: A later train used to continue a trip after another service

examples.en: The connecting train left from the other side of the platform.
examples.zh: 「接续列车」从站台另一侧出发。

examples.en: I checked the number of our connecting train before getting off.
examples.zh: 下车之前，我核对了「接续列车」的车次号。

collocations: a ticket for a connecting train

words.enDefinition: says a passenger may miss the next flight because time is short

examples.en: The later arrival put my connection at risk, and the agent was checking alternatives.
examples.zh: 到得晚了，我「可能赶不上转机」，工作人员正在查备选航班。

examples.en: A message said 'Connection at risk' after the aircraft had been held on the ground.
examples.zh: 飞机在地面等了一阵后，一条消息提示「可能赶不上转机」。

collocations: a connection at risk after a delay
a delay putting a connection at risk

words.enDefinition: A temporary solid fence around construction work
