examples.en: The notice was attached to the construction hoarding beside the diversion sign.
examples.zh: 告示贴在绕行指示牌旁的「施工围挡」上。

examples.en: I followed the path as it curved around the construction hoarding near campus.
examples.zh: 我沿小路走，绕过学校附近的「施工围挡」。

collocations: a notice on the construction hoarding

words.enDefinition: A light morning meal often including bread and a drink

examples.en: I asked what the continental breakfast included at this guesthouse.
examples.zh: 我问这家小旅馆的「欧陆式早餐」包含什么。

examples.en: The continental breakfast was served in the lounge downstairs that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上的「欧陆式早餐」在楼下休息室供应。

words.enDefinition: To complete the next part of a journey by long-distance bus

examples.en: The notice said we would continue by coach for the last section.
examples.zh: 告示说，最后一段我们要「改乘大巴继续前往」。

examples.en: I asked which passengers needed to continue by coach after leaving the train.
examples.zh: 我问哪些乘客下火车后需要「改乘大巴继续前往」。

collocations: continue by coach from the station
continue by coach for the final section
be asked to continue by coach

words.enDefinition: politely asks an attendant to bring a blanket

examples.en: Could I get a blanket after you finish serving the drinks to our row?
examples.zh: 给我们这排送完饮料后，「能给我一条毯子吗」？

examples.en: Could I get a blanket because the seat by the window feels quite cold?
examples.zh: 「能给我一条毯子吗」？靠窗的座位挺冷的。

collocations: could I get a blanket for this seat?
excuse me, could I get a blanket?
when you have a moment, could I get a blanket?

words.zhGloss: 我们能在这儿多待一会儿吗
words.enDefinition: asks for extra time at the current place
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们能在这儿多待一会儿吗

examples.en: Could we spend longer here so everyone gets a chance to see the display?
examples.zh: 「我们能在这儿多待一会儿吗」？让每个人都能看看展出的东西。

examples.en: Could we spend longer here if the next part of the tour is nearby?
examples.zh: 如果导览的下一站就在附近，「我们能在这儿多待一会儿吗」？

collocations: could we spend longer here today?
could we spend longer here before lunch?
if there's time, could we spend longer here?

words.enDefinition: asks a nearby passenger to move so you can reach the aisle

examples.en: Could you let me out once you've put your drink down on the table?
examples.zh: 等你把饮料放到桌板上，「能让我从座位出去吗」？

examples.en: Excuse me, could you let me out after the trolley has passed our seats?
examples.zh: 不好意思，餐车经过我们这排后，「能让我从座位出去吗」？

collocations: could you let me out for a moment?
excuse me, could you let me out?
could you let me out when the trolley passes?

words.enDefinition: A view from a guest room looking over an inner courtyard

examples.en: I chose a room with a courtyard view to avoid the street.
examples.zh: 我选了有「内院景观」的客房，没有选临街房。

examples.en: The room photos showed the courtyard view from an upstairs window.
examples.zh: 客房照片展示了从楼上窗户看到的「内院景观」。

collocations: book a room with a courtyard view
a room offering a courtyard view

words.enDefinition: whether enough crew members are available to operate a flight

examples.en: The revised departure time depended on crew availability, according to the announcement at the gate.
examples.zh: 登机口广播说，新的出发时间取决于「机组人员能否到位」。

examples.en: The airline mentioned crew availability before confirming that our flight could leave that evening.
examples.zh: 航空公司先提到了「机组人员能否到位」，之后才确认我们能当天晚上出发。

collocations: a change due to crew availability

words.enDefinition: To move from one side to the other

examples.en: The park map showed where to cross over to the other side of the stream.
examples.zh: 公园地图标出了从哪里能「走到对岸」。

examples.en: I asked where we could cross over to the path on the other side.
examples.zh: 我问我们可以从哪里「走到对面」那条小路。

collocations: cross over to the other side

words.enDefinition: Someone assigned to assist people at a crossing

examples.en: A crossing guard was standing by the school gate beside our meeting point.
examples.zh: 一位「引导行人过街的人员」站在我们碰面地点旁边的校门口。

examples.en: I asked the crossing guard which of the nearby streets led to campus.
examples.zh: 我问那位「引导行人过街的人员」，附近哪条街通往学校。

collocations: a crossing guard near the gate

words.enDefinition: Painted lines that identify a pedestrian crossing

examples.en: The crosswalk markings were much easier to see on this side of the square.
examples.zh: 广场这一侧的「人行横道标线」容易看清得多。

examples.en: My classmate pointed to the crosswalk markings while explaining where we should meet.
examples.zh: 同学在说明碰面地点时，指了指「人行横道标线」。

words.enDefinition: a transport trip with many passengers and little free space

examples.en: I waited for the next bus instead of boarding the crowded service.
examples.zh: 我没上这趟「乘客拥挤的班次」，等了下一班公交。

examples.en: The route had a crowded service after the basketball match on campus.
examples.zh: 学校篮球比赛结束后，线路上有一趟「乘客拥挤的班次」。

collocations: wait for a less crowded service

words.enDefinition: the height at which a plane flies steadily along its route

examples.en: The plane reached cruising altitude while I was organizing notes for the next seminar.
examples.zh: 我在整理下次研讨课的笔记时，飞机到达了「巡航高度」。

examples.en: I could see the mountains clearly after we reached cruising altitude above the clouds.
examples.zh: 到云层上方的「巡航高度」以后，我能清楚地看见群山。

words.enDefinition: a stop where passengers board directly from the side of the road

examples.en: The replacement service used a curbside stop instead of the station's main platforms.
examples.zh: 代运班次使用「路缘停靠站」，没用车站的主站台。

examples.en: I checked the map for the curbside stop outside the student residence.
examples.zh: 我在地图上查了学生公寓外的「路缘停靠站」。

collocations: pick up passengers at a curbside stop

words.enDefinition: end a visit earlier than planned

examples.en: We had to cut the visit short because one friend had an evening class.
examples.zh: 有个朋友晚上有课，我们只好「提前结束参观」。

examples.en: I decided to cut the visit short after realizing how late it was getting.
examples.zh: 发现时间已经挺晚了，我就决定「提前结束参观」。

collocations: have to cut the visit short
decide to cut the visit short
need to cut the visit short

words.enDefinition: A system of connected routes for cyclists

examples.en: The brochure maps the cycle network around the university and the town centre.
examples.zh: 手册画出了学校和市中心周围的「骑行路线网」。

examples.en: The two riverside paths form part of the local cycle network shown here.
examples.zh: 这里标出的两条河边小路都属于本地的「骑行路线网」。

collocations: a map of the cycle network

words.enDefinition: A path set aside for cycling

examples.en: The cycle path through the park ended beside the public garden entrance.
examples.zh: 公园里的「自行车专用道」通到公共花园入口旁就结束了。

examples.en: The map showed a cycle path running behind the station toward the river.
examples.zh: 地图标出车站后面有条通向河边的「自行车专用道」。

collocations: a cycle path through the park

words.enDefinition: A planned or marked route for cyclists

examples.en: The signs for the cycle route all had the same green bicycle symbol.
examples.zh: 「骑行路线」的指示牌上都有同样的绿色自行车标志。

examples.en: I checked whether the cycle route went near the hall where we were meeting.
examples.zh: 我查了「骑行路线」会不会经过我们要见面的大厅附近。

words.enDefinition: A traffic signal specifically for bicycle traffic

examples.en: The cycle signal had a bicycle symbol that stood out from the others.
examples.zh: 「自行车信号灯」有个自行车图案，从其他信号灯里很容易认出来。

examples.en: The junction diagram showed the cycle signal beside the one for pedestrians.
examples.zh: 路口示意图将「自行车信号灯」画在行人信号灯旁边。

collocations: a cycle signal at a junction
a cycle signal with a bicycle symbol

words.enDefinition: A navigation setting for bike trips

examples.en: I chose cycling mode to see which park entrance connected to the cycle path.
examples.zh: 我选了「骑行模式」，看看公园哪个入口连着自行车专用道。

examples.en: In cycling mode, the map showed routes on both sides of the river.
examples.zh: 在「骑行模式」下，地图显示了河流两岸的路线。

collocations: plan a route in cycling mode

words.enDefinition: A sign telling cyclists to get off their bikes

examples.en: The “Cyclists dismount” sign was at the footbridge entrance near the market.
examples.zh: 市场附近的人行天桥入口处有块牌子，写着「骑行者请下车」。

examples.en: I asked what “Cyclists dismount” meant after seeing it on the park sign.
examples.zh: 在公园看到「骑行者请下车」的牌子后，我问这是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the charge per day for using a particular rental vehicle

examples.en: We compared the daily rental rate for two classes of car online.
examples.zh: 我们在网上比较了两类汽车的「每日租车费率」。

examples.en: The quote listed a daily rental rate before taxes and other fees.
examples.zh: 报价先列了「每日租车费率」，再列税款和其他费用。

words.enDefinition: the amount a renter can be required to pay toward covered vehicle damage

examples.en: I found the damage excess listed near the top of the UK rental quote.
examples.zh: 我在英国租车报价的上方找到了「租车损坏自付额」。

examples.en: The agent showed where the damage excess appeared on the vehicle agreement.
examples.zh: 代理指给我看，车辆协议在哪里写了「租车损坏自付额」。

collocations: the amount of the damage excess

words.enDefinition: checked luggage returned with physical damage

examples.en: I showed the agent my damaged baggage because one of the suitcase wheels was missing.
examples.zh: 我的箱子少了一个轮子，所以我把「受损的托运行李」给工作人员看。

examples.en: The representative asked whether I had photos of the damaged baggage taken after arrival.
examples.zh: 工作人员问我有没有到达后拍的「受损的托运行李」的照片。

words.enDefinition: a ticket allowing specified public transport journeys in a day or day-long period

examples.en: I bought a day pass for visiting several museums on Saturday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我买了张「一日乘车票」，周六下午去好几个博物馆。

examples.en: The driver showed me which part of the day pass gave its expiry time.
examples.zh: 司机给我看了「一日乘车票」上哪儿写着失效时间。

collocations: a day pass for the bus

words.enDefinition: A fare that covers both parts of a return journey on one day

examples.en: We bought a day return for our trip to the museum.
examples.zh: 我们为去博物馆的行程买了「当天往返票」。

examples.en: I checked whether the day return showed the correct date for Saturday.
examples.zh: 我核对了「当天往返票」上的日期是不是那个星期六。

collocations: a day return to the city
check the date on a day return

words.enDefinition: a trip away and back on the same day

examples.en: We took a day trip to a nearby town after our exams finished.
examples.zh: 考完试后，我们去附近的小镇「当天往返玩了一趟」。

examples.en: A day trip worked well because nobody wanted to spend money on a room.
examples.zh: 大家都不想花钱住一晚，所以「当天往返的短途旅行」很合适。

words.enDefinition: a small backpack used to carry things for one day

examples.en: I brought a daypack with water and a book for the afternoon trip.
examples.zh: 下午出游时，我带了个「短途用的小背包」，里面放了水和一本书。

examples.en: My daypack fit under the bench while we ate in the garden courtyard.
examples.zh: 我们在花园院子里吃东西时，我带的「短途用的小背包」正好能放在长椅下面。

words.zhGloss: 英国铁路晚点补偿制度
words.enDefinition: A British rail scheme concerning compensation for eligible train delays
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国铁路晚点补偿制度

examples.en: The British operator listed Delay Repay on a separate help page.
examples.zh: 英国运营方在单独的帮助页面上列了「英国铁路晚点补偿制度」。

examples.en: I asked what Delay Repay meant in the notice at the station.
examples.zh: 我问车站告示中的「英国铁路晚点补偿制度」指什么。

words.enDefinition: checked luggage that has not reached the traveler at the expected time

examples.en: I asked about my delayed baggage because I had another trip the following morning.
examples.zh: 我第二天早上还有一趟行程，所以问了问「延迟到达的托运行李」。

examples.en: The airline sent an update about our delayed baggage while we waited for the bus.
examples.zh: 等公交时，航空公司发来了「延迟到达的托运行李」的最新消息。

words.enDefinition: Words introducing the stated cause of a delay

examples.en: The announcement said we were delayed due to congestion at the station.
examples.zh: 广播说，我们「由于车站拥堵而延误」。

examples.en: The coach message said "Delayed due to traffic" beside our trip details.
examples.zh: 长途大巴消息在行程详情旁写着「由于交通拥堵而延误」。

collocations: delayed due to a signal fault

words.enDefinition: a scheduled vehicle or trip running later than planned

examples.en: We waited for a delayed service underneath the shelter outside the library.
examples.zh: 我们在图书馆外的候车亭等一趟「晚点班次」。

examples.en: The display showed the delayed service below two buses running on time.
examples.zh: 显示屏把那趟「晚点班次」列在两班准点车下面。

collocations: check the status of a delayed service
a notice about a delayed service

words.enDefinition: A room marketed as above the property's usual basic category

examples.en: I asked how a deluxe room differed from the standard option.
examples.zh: 我问「升级型客房」与标准客房有什么区别。

examples.en: The listing showed a deluxe room with a separate seating area.
examples.zh: 住宿页面展示了一间带独立休息区的「升级型客房」。

collocations: a deluxe room with a view

words.enDefinition: points recorded for certain driving offences in jurisdictions using a points system

examples.en: The Australian notice listed demerit points on a separate line below the fine.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的通知在罚款下面单列了一行「交通违规记分」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the sample record showed the demerit points.
examples.zh: 我问样本记录哪部分显示了「交通违规记分」。

words.enDefinition: refused permission to board a flight

examples.en: The traveler was denied boarding and went to the airline desk to ask what happened.
examples.zh: 这位旅客「被拒绝登机」，就去航空公司柜台问发生了什么。

examples.en: I asked why I was denied boarding after the agent told me to step aside.
examples.zh: 工作人员让我先站到一边，我问自己为什么「被拒绝登机」。

collocations: ask why you were denied boarding

words.enDefinition: A marked area where a coach stops to collect passengers

examples.en: I waited at the departure bay printed on my coach ticket.
examples.zh: 我在长途大巴票上印的「大巴发车位」等车。

examples.en: The board showed which departure bay was assigned to our service.
examples.zh: 显示屏标明我们的班次用哪个「大巴发车位」。

collocations: the departure bay for a coach

words.enDefinition: A display listing upcoming services, times, and departure locations

examples.en: The departure board showed our train at the top of the list.
examples.zh: 「发车信息屏」把我们的列车列在最上面。

examples.en: We watched the departure board until our platform number appeared there.
examples.zh: 我们一直看着「发车信息屏」，直到上面显示我们的站台号。

words.enDefinition: a display counting down the time left until a service is due to leave

examples.en: The departure countdown reached one minute while I was walking toward the platform.
examples.zh: 我往站台走时，「发车倒计时」剩一分钟。

examples.en: The app updated the departure countdown after the tram arrived earlier than expected.
examples.zh: 电车比预计早到，应用更新了「发车倒计时」。

words.enDefinition: A notice saying a scheduled service will leave later than planned

examples.en: The rail app showed "Departure delayed" just after we reached the station.
examples.zh: 我们刚到车站时，铁路应用显示「发车延误」。

examples.en: I read "Departure delayed" beside our coach on the station display.
examples.zh: 我看到车站屏幕在我们那趟长途大巴旁写着「发车延误」。

collocations: mark a service as departure delayed

words.enDefinition: The airport hall for passengers before departure

examples.en: I met my classmate in the departure hall before we found the airline counter.
examples.zh: 我们找到航空公司柜台前，我先在「出发大厅」见了同学。

examples.en: The bus stopped outside the departure hall where the airline signs were easy to see.
examples.zh: 公交车停在「出发大厅」外，航空公司的指示牌在那里很容易看到。

collocations: a sign in the departure hall

words.enDefinition: A waiting area for passengers before their flight

examples.en: We picked seats in the departure lounge where we could hear announcements clearly.
examples.zh: 我们在「候机厅」选了几个能听清广播的座位。

examples.en: I met a classmate in the departure lounge after we checked in separately.
examples.zh: 我们各自办完值机后，我在「候机厅」见到了一位同学。

words.enDefinition: the part of a flight when the aircraft moves to a lower altitude

examples.en: We began our descent while I was reading the final page of my article.
examples.zh: 我读文章最后一页的时候，飞机开始「下降」。

examples.en: The pilot announced our descent, so I put the last of my books away.
examples.zh: 机长广播说飞机开始「下降」，我就把最后一本书收好了。

words.enDefinition: An area set aside for parking bicycles

examples.en: The park map marked designated bike parking next to the smaller gate.
examples.zh: 公园地图把较小的门旁边标为「指定自行车停放区」。

examples.en: The volunteer pointed toward designated bike parking at the back of the hall.
examples.zh: 志愿者指向大厅后面的「指定自行车停放区」。

words.enDefinition: Usable room on a desk for writing or working

examples.en: I checked the photos for desk space before booking the room.
examples.zh: 订房之前，我看了照片确认「书桌可用空间」有多大。

examples.en: There was enough desk space for my laptop and one notebook.
examples.zh: 「书桌可用空间」够大，放得下我的笔记本电脑和一本笔记本。

words.enDefinition: a sign on a vehicle showing its destination and sometimes its route number

examples.en: I read the destination display before boarding the bus at the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆站上车前，先看了「终点站显示牌」。

examples.en: The destination display changed when the bus turned around at the last stop.
examples.zh: 公交车在末站掉头时，「终点站显示牌」上的内容变了。

words.enDefinition: A sign showing a way around a blockage

examples.en: The detour sign pointed toward the side street behind the closed footpath.
examples.zh: 「绕行指示牌」指向封闭步道后面的小街。

examples.en: I stopped beside the detour sign to read the small map on it.
examples.zh: 我在「绕行指示牌」旁停下，看它上面的小地图。

words.enDefinition: A digital credential on a device for accessing a guest room

examples.en: The app showed the digital room key beside my check-in details.
examples.zh: 应用把「电子客房钥匙」显示在我的入住信息旁边。

examples.en: I asked the front desk whether my booking offered a digital room key.
examples.zh: 我问前台，我的订单是否提供「电子客房钥匙」。

collocations: set up a digital room key

words.enDefinition: A train carriage where passengers can sit and eat meals

examples.en: My friend asked which end of the train had the dining car.
examples.zh: 朋友问列车哪一端有「餐车」。

examples.en: The dining car had tables on both sides of the aisle.
examples.zh: 「餐车」的过道两边都有餐桌。

words.enDefinition: a service that takes passengers to a destination without requiring a change of vehicle

examples.en: I took a direct service to campus so I could keep reading on the bus.
examples.zh: 我坐了去学校的「直达班次」，可以继续在公交车上阅读。

examples.en: The route planner showed no direct service to the museum on Sundays.
examples.zh: 行程规划工具显示，周日没有去博物馆的「直达班次」。

words.enDefinition: A train that reaches your destination without requiring a change

examples.en: I chose a direct train because I was carrying several bags.
examples.zh: 因为带了好几个包，我选了「直达列车」。

examples.en: The ticket office showed only one direct train that Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 售票处显示，那个星期六早上只有一趟「直达列车」。

words.enDefinition: the direction in which a vehicle is moving or is scheduled to go

examples.en: The map showed the direction of travel beside each line on the diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图在每条线路旁标出了「行驶方向」。

examples.en: I checked the direction of travel against the arrow on the station sign.
examples.zh: 我对照站内牌子上的箭头确认了「行驶方向」。

words.enDefinition: a fare whose amount depends on the distance travelled

examples.en: The leaflet illustrated a distance-based fare using a short trip and a longer one.
examples.zh: 宣传单用一段短行程和一段长行程说明了「按距离计费的车费」。

examples.en: I asked how the distance-based fare was recorded on my trip history.
examples.zh: 我问「按距离计费的车费」在乘车记录里怎么显示。

words.zhGloss: 能辨认行李的独特标记
words.enDefinition: unusual visible features that help identify a bag
acceptedZhAnswers: 能辨认行李的独特标记

examples.en: The agent asked about distinctive markings, so I mentioned the yellow tape near the handle.
examples.zh: 工作人员问有没有「能辨认行李的独特标记」，我就提到提手旁边的黄胶带。

examples.en: I added distinctive markings to the report because three bags looked almost the same.
examples.zh: 三个包看起来几乎一模一样，所以我在报告里补充了「独特标记」。

words.enDefinition: a flight sent to land at an airport other than the planned one

examples.en: The diverted flight landed in another city and we waited there for an update.
examples.zh: 「改降其他机场的航班」落地在另一座城市，我们在那里等消息。

examples.en: I tracked the diverted flight after my friend told me the plane had changed course.
examples.zh: 朋友告诉我飞机改了航向后，我追踪了这个「改降其他机场的航班」。

collocations: a diverted flight due to weather

words.enDefinition: A train using a different route from the one originally planned

examples.en: The diverted train still reached our destination but skipped one town.
examples.zh: 「改道运行的列车」仍会到我们的目的地，但跳过一个小镇。

examples.en: My friend asked which route the diverted train would take instead.
examples.zh: 朋友问「改道运行的列车」会改走哪条线路。

words.enDefinition: A sign telling hotel staff or other people not to enter

examples.en: The do not disturb sign was hanging on the inside of the door.
examples.zh: 「请勿打扰牌」挂在房门内侧。

examples.en: I put up the do not disturb sign while preparing for my presentation.
examples.zh: 我准备做报告时，挂上了「请勿打扰牌」。

collocations: hang the do not disturb sign
leave the do not disturb sign on the door
remove the do not disturb sign

words.enDefinition: To return a shared bicycle into a docking point

examples.en: I asked where to dock the bike after finding the station near the library.
examples.zh: 找到图书馆附近的停靠点后，我问该在哪儿「把单车停进车桩」。

examples.en: The volunteer showed us where to dock the bike at the other end.
examples.zh: 志愿者给我们指出另一端哪里可以「把单车停进车桩」。

collocations: dock the bike at a station
ask where to dock the bike
find a place to dock the bike

words.enDefinition: A site with docks for shared bicycles

examples.en: The docking station beside the river had room for several more bicycles.
examples.zh: 河边的「共享单车停靠点」还可以再停几辆自行车。

examples.en: We picked a meeting point near the docking station outside the sports hall.
examples.zh: 我们选了体育馆外「共享单车停靠点」附近的一处地点碰面。

collocations: return a bicycle to a docking station

words.enDefinition: A shared bicycle that uses no fixed dock

examples.en: I checked whether the dockless bike could be returned near the public garden.
examples.zh: 我查了这辆「无桩共享单车」能不能还在公共花园附近。

examples.en: The app showed a dockless bike parked across the street from our classroom.
examples.zh: 应用显示，教室马路对面停着一辆「无桩共享单车」。

collocations: a dockless bike near the entrance

words.enDefinition: asks whether a listed price or ticket covers the tour

examples.en: Does this include the tour of the garden or just access to the house?
examples.zh: 「这包含花园导览吗」，还是只包括进老宅参观？

examples.en: Before I buy the ticket, does this include the tour with the local guide?
examples.zh: 我买门票之前想确认一下，「这包含本地导游带的导览吗」？

collocations: does this include the tour of the house?
does this include the tour as well?
just to check, does this include the tour?

words.enDefinition: The departure area or listing for flights within a country

examples.en: I looked for domestic departures on the signs after leaving the airport bus.
examples.zh: 我下了机场公交之后，在指示牌上找「国内出发」。

examples.en: The domestic departures area was on another level from the international counters we passed.
examples.zh: 「国内出发」区和我们经过的国际航班柜台不在同一层。

words.enDefinition: A signal telling pedestrians not to start crossing

examples.en: The picture showed an orange hand used for the don't walk signal in that city.
examples.zh: 图片画了一只橙色的手，那座城市用它作为「行人禁止通行信号」。

examples.en: I compared the walk signal with the don't walk signal in the orientation booklet.
examples.zh: 我对照看了迎新手册里的行人通行信号和「行人禁止通行信号」。

collocations: a sign showing a don't walk signal

words.enDefinition: an announcement that passengers should expect the vehicle's left-side doors to open

examples.en: I heard “doors opening on the left” as the train approached our stop.
examples.zh: 车快到我们这一站时，我听到了「左侧车门开启」的播报。

examples.en: The screen showed “doors opening on the left” beside the station name.
examples.zh: 屏幕在站名旁显示「左侧车门开启」。

collocations: hear doors opening on the left
announce doors opening on the left
a message saying doors opening on the left

words.enDefinition: An individual bed booked in a shared hostel sleeping room

examples.en: I booked a dorm bed for the night after the concert.
examples.zh: 我为音乐会结束后的那一晚订了一个「旅舍多人间床位」。

examples.en: My confirmation listed a dorm bed rather than the entire room.
examples.zh: 我的确认信息上写的是一个「旅舍多人间床位」，不是整个房间。

collocations: a dorm bed for one night

words.enDefinition: An accommodation arrangement or rate based on two guests staying

examples.en: The listing said the nightly rate was based on double occupancy.
examples.zh: 住宿页面注明，每晚房价按「双人入住」计算。

examples.en: I checked whether the double occupancy booking included both our names.
examples.zh: 我核对了「双人入住」的订单上有没有我们两个人的姓名。

words.enDefinition: A room intended for two guests, typically with one double bed

examples.en: I checked the bed details before booking a double room for us.
examples.zh: 我先核对了床型，然后给我们订了一间「双人床客房」。

examples.en: The double room in the photo had one bed beside the window.
examples.zh: 照片上的「双人床客房」有一张靠窗的床。

collocations: a double room for two guests

words.enDefinition: the status of meeting an organization's or jurisdiction's requirements to drive a vehicle

examples.en: The rental website explained driver eligibility in a section beside the booking form.
examples.zh: 租车网站在预约表旁专门介绍了「驾驶人资格」。

examples.en: I asked which document was needed to confirm driver eligibility for this booking.
examples.zh: 我问这笔预约要提交什么材料确认「驾驶人资格」。

words.enDefinition: a person who teaches people how to drive a vehicle

examples.en: The driving instructor met me outside the student residence before our first lesson.
examples.zh: 「驾驶教练」在第一节课前到学生公寓外与我见面。

examples.en: I asked my driving instructor about changing the afternoon lesson to Friday.
examples.zh: 我问「驾驶教练」能不能把下午的课改到周五。

words.enDefinition: a period of guided practice with someone teaching you to drive

examples.en: I moved my driving lesson because it overlapped with a laboratory session.
examples.zh: 我的实验课时间撞了，所以把「驾驶课」改了期。

examples.en: The driving lesson began in a quiet car park near the sports centre.
examples.zh: 「驾驶课」从体育中心附近一个安静的停车场开始。

words.enDefinition: an official document showing that someone is permitted to drive specified vehicles

examples.en: I took my driving licence to the counter when collecting the rental car.
examples.zh: 我去柜台取租来的车时，带上了「驾驶执照」。

examples.en: The clerk checked the photograph on my driving licence against my booking details.
examples.zh: 柜台人员核对了「驾驶执照」上的照片和我的预约信息。

words.enDefinition: an official record of a person's driving licence status and certain driving history

examples.en: The company asked for permission to view my driving record before the rental.
examples.zh: 租车前，公司征求我同意查看「驾驶记录」。

examples.en: I read my driving record before discussing the incorrect date with staff.
examples.zh: 和工作人员讨论错误日期之前，我先看了自己的「驾驶记录」。

collocations: a copy of your driving record

words.enDefinition: To mark a chosen place on a map

examples.en: Could you drop a pin where the riverside path meets the park entrance?
examples.zh: 你能「在地图上打个标记」，标出河边小路和公园入口相接的地方吗？

examples.en: I asked my roommate to drop a pin by the building's side door.
examples.zh: 我让室友「在地图上标一下」那栋楼的侧门。

collocations: drop a pin on the map
drop a pin at a meeting point
ask someone to drop a pin

words.enDefinition: an area where vehicles may stop briefly to let passengers get out

examples.en: We met our classmate at the drop-off zone outside the conference building.
examples.zh: 我们在会场外的「乘客下车临停区」和同学会合。

examples.en: A temporary sign moved the drop-off zone to the side street for the event.
examples.zh: 活动期间，一块临时牌子把「乘客下车临停区」改到了侧街。

words.enDefinition: A lowered section of kerb beside a road

examples.en: The accessibility map marked a dropped kerb outside the entrance to the public garden.
examples.zh: 无障碍地图标出了公共花园入口外「降低的路缘石」。

examples.en: I asked whether the corner by the library had a dropped kerb.
examples.zh: 我问图书馆旁的拐角有没有「降低的路缘石」。

collocations: a dropped kerb at the crossing
a path with a dropped kerb

words.enDefinition: An airline ticket recorded electronically

examples.en: I saved my e-ticket so I could find my flight details later.
examples.zh: 我保存了「电子机票」，以便之后查航班详情。

examples.en: The e-ticket was attached to the confirmation email I received from the travel office.
examples.zh: 旅行服务处发来的确认邮件附有「电子机票」。

words.enDefinition: Arriving and taking a booked room before the usual arrival time

examples.en: We asked about early check-in because our train arrived before lunch.
examples.zh: 我们的火车午饭前就到，所以问了能不能「提前入住」。

examples.en: The early check-in option was shown under our booking details.
examples.zh: 订单详情下面列出了「提前入住」的选项。

words.enDefinition: Leaving an accommodation before the originally planned departure date

examples.en: I called the front desk after class to confirm my early departure.
examples.zh: 下课后，我打电话给前台，确认自己会「提前离店」。

examples.en: The early departure was recorded on the updated booking summary.
examples.zh: 更新后的订单概要记下了「提前离店」。

words.enDefinition: a small car designed to be economical to operate, often an entry rental class

examples.en: We booked an economy car because only two people were travelling that weekend.
examples.zh: 周末只有两个人出行，我们订了一辆「经济型汽车」。

examples.en: The company replaced our economy car with a larger vehicle at pickup.
examples.zh: 取车时，公司给我们换了辆更大的车，替代原订的「经济型汽车」。

words.enDefinition: a road charge collected electronically instead of at a staffed payment booth

examples.en: The road sign explained that an electronic toll applied on that section.
examples.zh: 道路标识说明，这一段收「电子道路通行费」。

examples.en: I asked how the electronic toll would appear on the rental invoice.
examples.zh: 我问「电子道路通行费」会在租车账单上怎样显示。

words.enDefinition: An unused space for returning a shared bicycle

examples.en: The map showed one empty dock at the station beside the public garden.
examples.zh: 地图显示公共花园旁的站点有一个「空车桩」。

examples.en: I checked for an empty dock before choosing where to end the ride.
examples.zh: 决定在哪里结束骑行之前，我先找了找有没有「空车桩」。

collocations: a station with an empty dock

words.enDefinition: A guest room with its own directly attached bathroom

examples.en: My friend picked an en-suite room for the night after graduation.
examples.zh: 朋友给毕业典礼后的那一晚订了间「带独立卫浴的客房」。

examples.en: The listing priced the en-suite room separately from the dorm beds.
examples.zh: 住宿页面把「带独立卫浴的客房」与多人间床位分开标价。

collocations: an en-suite room with a shower

words.enDefinition: To finish a rental ride in the system

examples.en: The app showed where I could end the ride near the park.
examples.zh: 应用标出了我可以在公园附近哪里「结束本次骑行」。

examples.en: I checked the screen to see whether the button said End the ride.
examples.zh: 我看了一下屏幕，确认按钮是不是写着「结束本次骑行」。

collocations: find a place to end the ride

words.enDefinition: a specific time or period reserved for someone to enter

examples.en: We booked an entry slot in the morning so we could see the gardens later.
examples.zh: 我们订了上午的「入场时段」，之后还能去看花园。

examples.en: I checked my entry slot before deciding how long to stay in the market.
examples.zh: 我先查了「入场时段」，再决定在市场待多久。

words.enDefinition: the currently predicted time when a vehicle will actually depart

examples.en: The estimated departure changed after the tram was held at the previous stop.
examples.zh: 电车在上一站停留后，「预计发车时间」变了。

examples.en: I refreshed the app to check the latest estimated departure for my route.
examples.zh: 我刷新应用，看这条线路最新的「预计发车时间」。

words.enDefinition: How long a walk is expected to take

examples.en: The app showed the estimated walking time from my flat to the museum.
examples.zh: 应用显示了从我住处到博物馆的「预计步行时长」。

examples.en: I checked the estimated walking time before agreeing to meet my classmate downtown.
examples.zh: 答应和同学在市中心见面之前，我看了「预计步行时长」。

collocations: an estimated walking time on the map

words.enDefinition: a location where an electric vehicle can be connected to charging equipment

examples.en: The hotel map marked an EV charging point near the back entrance.
examples.zh: 酒店地图在后门附近标了一个「电动汽车充电点」。

examples.en: I asked which EV charging point was available for visitors that evening.
examples.zh: 我问那天晚上访客能用哪个「电动汽车充电点」。

words.enDefinition: Baggage that exceeds the allowance on a ticket

examples.en: The agent explained the charge for excess baggage after checking my fare.
examples.zh: 工作人员核对我的票价类型后，解释了「超额行李」如何收费。

examples.en: The email listed excess baggage separately from the baggage included with the ticket.
examples.zh: 邮件把「超额行李」和机票包含的行李分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a fee for distance driven beyond the amount included in a rental agreement

examples.en: The invoice listed an excess mileage charge below the daily rental rate.
examples.zh: 账单在每日租车费率下面列了一项「超出里程的收费」。

examples.en: I asked how the excess mileage charge had been calculated for that trip.
examples.zh: 我问那趟行程「超出里程的收费」是怎么算出来的。

collocations: an excess mileage charge per mile

words.enDefinition: a short organized trip away from a usual place

examples.en: The college arranged an excursion to the coast for students staying over the break.
examples.zh: 学院给假期留校的学生安排了一次去海边的「短途出游」。

examples.en: Our excursion included a stop at a small gallery on the way back.
examples.zh: 我们的「短途出游」安排了回程在一家小画廊停留。

words.enDefinition: a bus service that takes less time by skipping stops or using a faster route

examples.en: I took the express bus because it skipped several stops near campus.
examples.zh: 我坐「快速公交车」，因为它会跳过学校附近的几站。

examples.en: The express bus reaches the city centre before the regular service does.
examples.zh: 「快速公交车」比普通班次更早到市中心。

words.enDefinition: An expedited process for leaving a property with fewer desk steps

examples.en: The hotel listed express checkout as an option on the welcome card.
examples.zh: 酒店在欢迎卡上把「快速退房」列为一个选项。

examples.en: I asked whether express checkout was available before my early train.
examples.zh: 我问一早去赶火车之前能不能「快速退房」。

words.enDefinition: A long-distance bus making fewer stops than other services

examples.en: We chose the express coach because it stopped in fewer towns.
examples.zh: 我们选了「少停站的快速大巴」，因为沿途停靠的城镇更少。

examples.en: The express coach shown on the timetable left just after our seminar.
examples.zh: 时刻表上的「少停站的快速大巴」在研讨课结束后不久发车。

words.enDefinition: To arrange to remain at an accommodation for additional nights

examples.en: The confirmation explains whom to contact to extend your stay at this hotel.
examples.zh: 确认信息说明了在这家酒店要找谁「延长住宿」。

examples.en: The manager explained how you could extend your stay without changing rooms.
examples.zh: 经理说明了怎样在同一间客房里「延长住宿」。

collocations: check whether you can extend your stay

words.enDefinition: A bag in addition to those already included

examples.en: My flatmate added an extra bag to the booking before we left.
examples.zh: 我们出门前，室友在预订记录里加了「额外一件行李」。

examples.en: I asked whether the extra bag would appear on the same confirmation email.
examples.zh: 我问「额外一件行李」会不会出现在同一封确认邮件里。

words.enDefinition: An additional pillow supplied beyond those already in a room

examples.en: My roommate called reception to ask for an extra pillow.
examples.zh: 室友打电话给前台，问能不能「加一只枕头」。

examples.en: The hotel brought an extra pillow before we returned from dinner.
examples.zh: 我们吃晚饭回来前，酒店已经送来了「额外的枕头」。

words.enDefinition: move more slowly and end up behind the rest of the group

examples.en: It's easy to fall behind the group if you stop to read every sign.
examples.zh: 如果每块牌子都停下来读，很容易「落在队伍后面」。

examples.en: I didn't want to fall behind the group, so I waited to take more photos.
examples.zh: 我不想「落在队伍后面」，就先忍住没继续拍照。

collocations: try not to fall behind the group
start to fall behind the group
easy to fall behind the group

words.enDefinition: A boarding stage for passengers traveling with children

examples.en: The gate agent called family boarding before inviting the next group to line up.
examples.zh: 登机口工作人员先通知「携儿童家庭登机」，再请下一组排队。

examples.en: I saw family boarding listed near the top of the gate screen.
examples.zh: 我看到登机口屏幕靠上位置列出了「携儿童家庭登机」。

words.enDefinition: A guest room equipped to accommodate adults traveling with children

examples.en: My sister booked a family room while visiting me at university.
examples.zh: 姐姐来学校看我时，订了一间「家庭客房」。

examples.en: The family room had enough beds for my friend's whole family.
examples.zh: 「家庭客房」的床位足够我朋友全家人住。

collocations: a family room with extra beds

words.enDefinition: a device on a bus or other vehicle used to collect cash fares

examples.en: I saw one passenger drop coins into the fare box after boarding.
examples.zh: 我看到一名乘客上车后把硬币投进「公交投币箱」。

examples.en: The driver pointed to the fare box when I asked where to pay.
examples.zh: 我问该在哪里付车费，司机指了指「公交投币箱」。

collocations: put coins in the fare box
a fare box beside the driver

words.enDefinition: a limit on the total charged for eligible travel within a stated period

examples.en: I asked how the fare cap appeared in my online trip history.
examples.zh: 我问「车费累计上限」在网上的乘车记录里怎样显示。

examples.en: The visitor guide illustrated a fare cap using several journeys in one day.
examples.zh: 游客指南用同一天的几段行程说明了什么是「车费累计上限」。

words.enDefinition: an entry or exit barrier that opens after a fare or ticket has been verified

examples.en: I took my card out before reaching the fare gate at the station.
examples.zh: 我到车站的「检票闸机」前就把卡拿了出来。

examples.en: The fare gate stayed closed until the reader recognized my paper ticket.
examples.zh: 读卡设备识别我的纸票后，「检票闸机」才打开。

collocations: line up at the fare gate

words.enDefinition: a check that passengers have paid or hold valid travel tickets

examples.en: Our tram stopped briefly while the staff carried out a fare inspection.
examples.zh: 工作人员做「车票稽查」时，我们坐的有轨电车短暂停了一下。

examples.en: I kept the mobile ticket open after hearing an announcement about fare inspection.
examples.zh: 听到「车票稽查」的通知后，我没关手机车票页面。

words.enDefinition: a transport employee who checks that passengers hold valid tickets or have paid the fare

examples.en: The fare inspector waited while I found the ticket in my email.
examples.zh: 我在邮件里找车票时，「查票员」等了一下。

examples.en: I asked the fare inspector whether my ticket covered the replacement bus.
examples.zh: 我问「查票员」这张票能不能坐代运公交。

collocations: show a ticket to a fare inspector

words.enDefinition: a device that reads a card or device to register a transit fare

examples.en: I held my card next to the fare reader by the bus door.
examples.zh: 我把卡靠近公交车门旁的「车费感应读卡器」。

examples.en: The fare reader flashed green before the screen showed the new balance.
examples.zh: 「车费感应读卡器」先闪起绿灯，随后屏幕显示了新余额。

collocations: tap a card on the fare reader
a fare reader at the gate

words.enDefinition: an area used to determine the cost or validity of a transport journey

examples.en: I checked which fare zone included the station closest to my campus.
examples.zh: 我查了离学校最近的车站在哪个「票价分区」。

examples.en: The ticket shows the fare zone where it is valid for travel.
examples.zh: 车票上标出了可以使用的「票价分区」。

words.enDefinition: secure the belt that holds you in your seat

examples.en: Please fasten your seat belt while we prepare for landing at our destination airport.
examples.zh: 我们正在准备在目的地机场着陆，「请系好安全带」。

examples.en: Please fasten your seat belt while we wait for the weather to improve further.
examples.zh: 我们在等天气进一步好转，这段时间「请系好安全带」。

collocations: remember to fasten your seat belt
ask you to fasten your seat belt

words.enDefinition: A shared hostel sleeping room reserved for women guests

examples.en: My classmate booked a bed in a female-only dorm for the trip.
examples.zh: 同学为这趟旅行订了一张「仅限女性的多人间」床位。

examples.en: The website displayed the female-only dorm next to the other dorm options.
examples.zh: 网站把「仅限女性的多人间」和其他多人间选项并排列出。

collocations: book a bed in a female-only dorm

words.enDefinition: the last part of the approach as the plane lines up for landing

examples.en: We were on final approach when I finally saw the river through the clouds.
examples.zh: 飞机进入「最后进近」时，我隔着云终于看到了那条河。

examples.en: The captain announced the final approach after we passed over the edge of the city.
examples.zh: 飞过城市边缘后，机长广播说飞机进入了「最后进近」。

words.enDefinition: The last announcement asking passengers to board

examples.en: We heard the final boarding call while walking toward the gate after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，我们往登机口走时听到了「最后登机广播」。

examples.en: The agent made a final boarding call before removing the boarding sign.
examples.zh: 工作人员撤掉登机指示牌之前播了「最后登机广播」。

collocations: the final boarding call for a flight

words.enDefinition: the earliest scheduled transit service on a route or day

examples.en: The first service left before the café at the station had opened.
examples.zh: 车站咖啡馆还没开门，「首班车」就发车了。

examples.en: I checked the first service before signing up for the early volunteer shift.
examples.zh: 报名参加早班志愿服务前，我查了「首班车」。

collocations: check the first service on Sunday

words.enDefinition: A room fitted with equipment for exercise inside a property

examples.en: The welcome card listed the opening times for the fitness room.
examples.zh: 欢迎卡上写了「小型健身房」的开放时间。

examples.en: My classmate asked whether the fitness room was open that morning.
examples.zh: 同学问「小型健身房」那天早上是否开放。

words.enDefinition: a single price for eligible trips regardless of how far the passenger travels

examples.en: The bus leaflet said the route used a flat fare between all its stops.
examples.zh: 公交宣传单说，这条线各站之间都实行「全程统一车费」。

examples.en: I asked if the flat fare covered a trip from campus to the market.
examples.zh: 我问，从学校到市场的一程是否适用「全程统一车费」。

collocations: a flat fare for the route

words.enDefinition: A tire that has lost most of its air

examples.en: I saw a flat tire on the rental bike and reported it in the app.
examples.zh: 我看到出租自行车上有个「没气的轮胎」，就在应用里报了问题。

examples.en: My classmate noticed the flat tire while we were still at the station.
examples.zh: 我们还在停靠点时，同学发现那个「轮胎瘪了」。

collocations: a bike with a flat tire

words.enDefinition: a ticket that allows entry without fixing one exact time

examples.en: I bought a flexible entry ticket because my project meeting might finish quite late.
examples.zh: 我的项目会可能结束得挺晚，所以买了「入场时间灵活的门票」。

examples.en: Our flexible entry ticket let us visit in the afternoon after the garden tour.
examples.zh: 我们的「入场时间灵活的门票」能让我们在花园导览结束后下午再去参观。

words.enDefinition: a person who looks after passengers on an aircraft

examples.en: A flight attendant helped me read a small note on the in-flight entertainment screen.
examples.zh: 一位「客舱乘务员」帮我看机上娱乐屏幕上的一条小提示。

examples.en: I asked the flight attendant when the plane was expected to arrive in Toronto.
examples.zh: 我问「客舱乘务员」飞机预计什么时候到多伦多。

words.enDefinition: the decision that a scheduled flight will not take place

examples.en: The airline sent a flight cancellation notice while we were still waiting for the train.
examples.zh: 我们还在等火车时，航空公司就发来了「航班取消」通知。

examples.en: We changed our travel plans after the flight cancellation and arrived the following morning.
examples.zh: 「航班取消」后我们改了出行计划，第二天早上到达。

words.enDefinition: a sign or label directing passengers to their next flight

examples.en: We followed the flight connections signs because our next flight left from another terminal.
examples.zh: 下一趟航班从另一座航站楼出发，所以我们跟着「航班转机指示」走。

examples.en: The sign marked 'Flight Connections' pointed towards a corridor where passengers were waiting.
examples.zh: 写着「航班转机」的牌子指向一条走廊，有些旅客正在里面等。

words.enDefinition: value with an airline that can be applied to a future booking

examples.en: The app showed my flight credit when I started searching for dates during the break.
examples.zh: 我开始查假期可飞的日期时，应用显示了我的「机票抵用余额」。

examples.en: I checked whether my flight credit was listed under the original booking in the app.
examples.zh: 我查了「机票抵用余额」是否列在应用里的原预订下面。

words.enDefinition: a flight leaving or arriving later than scheduled

examples.en: The flight delay meant I could join the first hour of our group call.
examples.zh: 「航班延误」了，我就能参加小组通话的第一个小时。

examples.en: I told my housemate about the flight delay before she left for the airport.
examples.zh: 我在室友出发去机场之前，告诉了她「航班延误」的事。

collocations: a flight delay due to weather

words.enDefinition: a written record from an airline confirming a delay

examples.en: I requested a flight delay confirmation because I was late for a scheduled training session.
examples.zh: 因为我没能按时到培训课，我申请了一份「航班延误证明」。

examples.en: The airline emailed a flight delay confirmation shortly after we landed in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们下午着陆后不久，航空公司发邮件给了一份「航班延误证明」。

words.enDefinition: one part of a journey flown between two airports

examples.en: The first flight leg ended in Vancouver, where I met my friend before continuing east.
examples.zh: 第一段「航程」到温哥华结束，我在那里和朋友碰面后再继续往东。

examples.en: I saved my reading for the longest flight leg because it was in daylight.
examples.zh: 我留着书在最长的那段「航程」上看，因为那一段是白天飞。

words.enDefinition: A code identifying a particular scheduled flight

examples.en: The agent asked for my flight number before looking up the booking.
examples.zh: 工作人员先问我的「航班号」，然后查找预订记录。

examples.en: I checked the flight number because two flights had the same destination that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上有两趟航班飞往同一个地方，所以我核对了「航班号」。

collocations: a flight number on the board

words.enDefinition: a notification about a change or update to a flight

examples.en: I got a flight status alert while I was on the bus to the airport.
examples.zh: 我坐公交去机场时收到一条「航班状态提醒」。

examples.en: The flight status alert showed a new gate before the information screen had updated.
examples.zh: 信息屏还没更新，「航班状态提醒」就已经显示了新的登机口。

words.enDefinition: a seat that folds down for use and up to leave more room

examples.en: I found a fold-down seat near the back of the crowded tram.
examples.zh: 我在拥挤的有轨电车后部找到了一个「可翻折座位」。

examples.en: The fold-down seat returned to its upright position when I stood up.
examples.zh: 我站起来后，「可翻折座位」就翻回了竖直位置。

words.enDefinition: A bicycle designed to fold into a more compact shape

examples.en: I asked whether my folding bicycle would fit beside the luggage rack.
examples.zh: 我问我的「折叠自行车」能不能放在行李架旁边。

examples.en: My friend brought a folding bicycle on the regional train to campus.
examples.zh: 朋友带着一辆「折叠自行车」坐区域列车去了学校。

collocations: carry a folding bicycle on a train

words.enDefinition: To go along an indicated alternative route

examples.en: The map said to follow the diversion around the garden to reach the library.
examples.zh: 地图说要「沿绕行路线走」，绕过花园去图书馆。

examples.en: We had to follow the diversion because the footbridge was closed that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午人行天桥封闭，我们只能「沿绕行路线走」。

collocations: ask where to follow the diversion
follow the diversion around the site

words.enDefinition: To continue along the route of a path

examples.en: I decided to follow the path until it reached the gate near the river.
examples.zh: 我决定「沿着小路走」，直到河边的门口。

examples.en: Can we follow the path behind the garden to get back to the library?
examples.zh: 我们可以「沿着花园后面的小路走」回图书馆吗？

collocations: follow the path along the river
follow the path to the gate

words.enDefinition: A bridge intended for people on foot

examples.en: We used the footbridge over the canal to reach our classmate's flat.
examples.zh: 我们从运河上的「人行桥」过去，到了同学住的公寓。

examples.en: The footbridge was easy to see from the path near the garden.
examples.zh: 从花园旁的小路很容易看到那座「人行桥」。

words.enDefinition: A path intended for people walking

examples.en: The footpath behind the garden led to a quieter entrance to the park.
examples.zh: 花园后面的「步行小路」通向公园一个比较安静的入口。

examples.en: We met on the footpath beside the stream after finishing our morning lecture.
examples.zh: 上午的讲座结束后，我们在溪边的「步行小路」碰面。

words.enDefinition: A notice that a walking path cannot be used

examples.en: The barrier had a “Footpath closed” notice just beyond the park entrance.
examples.zh: 刚过公园入口的隔栏上挂着「步行小路关闭」的告示。

examples.en: I saw “Footpath closed” on the map before leaving the university library.
examples.zh: 离开学校图书馆前，我在地图上看到「步行小路关闭」的提示。

words.enDefinition: A place where one path divides into two

examples.en: At the fork in the path, I checked which branch led toward the gallery.
examples.zh: 到了「小路的岔口」，我确认哪一支通往美术馆。

examples.en: We met at the fork in the path where both routes were marked.
examples.zh: 我们在两条路线都有标记的「小路岔口」碰了面。

collocations: reach a fork in the path
a marker at the fork in the path
stop at a fork in the path

words.enDefinition: A place with its occupant facing the direction of travel

examples.en: The seat map showed only one forward-facing seat near a window.
examples.zh: 座位图上只有一个靠窗且「顺向座位」。

examples.en: I asked whether my ticket showed a forward-facing seat on this train.
examples.zh: 我问车票是否显示我坐的是这趟车上「顺向座位」。

words.enDefinition: An item easily broken or damaged

examples.en: I told the agent that I had a fragile item inside the case.
examples.zh: 我告诉工作人员，手提箱里有一件「易碎物品」。

examples.en: The clerk asked me to describe the fragile item before printing the baggage label.
examples.zh: 柜台工作人员先让我说明「易碎物品」是什么，再打印行李标签。

collocations: a bag containing a fragile item

words.enDefinition: entry to a place without an admission charge

examples.en: The gallery offered free admission on the morning we went after our seminar.
examples.zh: 研讨课结束后，我们上午去的那家画廊提供「免费入场」。

examples.en: I chose the garden because free admission made it an easy stop for our group.
examples.zh: 我选了花园，因为「免费入场」，我们一组人顺路去也方便。

words.enDefinition: An option allowing an eligible reservation to be cancelled without charge

examples.en: The listing showed free cancellation beside one of the room options.
examples.zh: 住宿页面在一个房型旁标了「免费取消预订」。

examples.en: I asked where the confirmation mentioned free cancellation for our booking.
examples.zh: 我问订单确认信息里哪里提到了「免费取消预订」。

words.enDefinition: The latest time a booking can be cancelled without a charge

examples.en: I checked which time zone the free-cancellation deadline used on my booking.
examples.zh: 我核对了订单上的「免费取消截止时间」用的是哪个时区。

examples.en: The confirmation listed the free-cancellation deadline beneath the room details.
examples.zh: 确认信息在客房详情下面写了「免费取消截止时间」。

words.enDefinition: time when visitors may look around without following a group schedule

examples.en: The tour gave us free time to explore after the guide finished in the courtyard.
examples.zh: 导游在院子里讲完后，我们有了「自由游览的时间」。

examples.en: We had free time to explore before meeting back at the old market square.
examples.zh: 回到旧市场广场集合前，我们有「自由游览的时间」。

collocations: give visitors free time to explore

words.enDefinition: permission to move onto an eligible connecting service without paying a separate fare

examples.en: I checked whether my bus ticket allowed a free transfer to the tram.
examples.zh: 我确认公交票能不能「免费换乘」电车。

examples.en: The app showed where a free transfer was available on that itinerary.
examples.zh: 应用显示这条行程上哪里可以「免费换乘」。

words.enDefinition: a transport service operating often enough that waits are generally short

examples.en: Our local route had frequent service during the first week of term.
examples.zh: 新学期第一周，我们本地这条线路提供「发车频繁的服务」。

examples.en: I chose the tram because the route map described it as frequent service.
examples.zh: 我选有轨电车，因为线路图上说那条线是「发车频繁的服务」。

words.enDefinition: A hotel employee who assists guests at the reception desk

examples.en: The front desk agent checked my booking before handing me the key.
examples.zh: 「酒店前台接待员」查了我的订单，把钥匙交给了我。

examples.en: I asked the front desk agent whether my room faced the courtyard.
examples.zh: 我问「酒店前台接待员」，我的客房是否朝内院。

collocations: speak to a front desk agent
information from the front desk agent

words.enDefinition: The carriages forming the forward section of a passenger train

examples.en: The announcement said the front portion would continue toward the coast.
examples.zh: 广播说，「列车前部」会继续开往海边。

examples.en: I checked whether my seat was in the front portion that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上我核对了座位是否在「列车前部」。

collocations: the front portion of the train

words.enDefinition: the small outer flap on a vehicle covering access to the fuel filler

examples.en: The fuel door was on the opposite side from the one on my friend's car.
examples.zh: 这辆车的「加油口外盖」在我朋友那辆车的另一侧。

examples.en: I looked for the button that opened the fuel door on our rental.
examples.zh: 我找了找租来的车上哪个按钮能打开「加油口外盖」。

words.enDefinition: the removable or hinged cover sealing the opening used to fill a fuel tank

examples.en: The agent showed me where the fuel filler cap sat behind the flap.
examples.zh: 代理指给我看外盖后面的「油箱加注口盖」在哪里。

examples.en: I checked the fuel filler cap before taking the car back to the depot.
examples.zh: 把车开回租车场之前，我检查了「油箱加注口盖」。

words.enDefinition: an instrument showing how much fuel remains in a vehicle's tank

examples.en: I checked the fuel gauge before we left the rental lot that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午离开租车场前，我看了「燃油表」。

examples.en: The fuel gauge showed just under half when we returned the vehicle.
examples.zh: 我们还车时，「燃油表」显示略少于半箱。

words.enDefinition: the amount of fuel in a vehicle's tank at a given time

examples.en: The agent recorded the fuel level alongside the car's mileage at pickup.
examples.zh: 取车时，代理记录了「油箱剩余油量」和车辆里程。

examples.en: I took a photo of the fuel level before returning the keys.
examples.zh: 交还车钥匙前，我拍下了「油箱剩余油量」的照片。

words.enDefinition: a rental rule about fuel at pickup and return and how fuel charges are handled

examples.en: I read the fuel policy before choosing between two similar rental offers.
examples.zh: 在两个相近的租车报价里选之前，我读了「租车燃油约定」。

examples.en: The fuel policy was printed below the mileage information in the agreement.
examples.zh: 协议把「租车燃油约定」印在里程信息下面。

words.enDefinition: the kind of fuel a vehicle is designed to use, such as petrol or diesel

examples.en: I checked the fuel type on the rental agreement before stopping at the station.
examples.zh: 在加油站停车前，我核对了租车协议上的「燃油种类」。

examples.en: The sticker beside the cap gives the fuel type for that vehicle.
examples.zh: 加油口旁边的贴纸标明了这辆车的「燃油种类」。

words.enDefinition: Accommodation with breakfast, lunch, and dinner included in the price

examples.en: The conference package listed full board with the overnight rooms.
examples.zh: 会议套餐里列出的客房是「含三餐的住宿」。

examples.en: My classmate asked whether full board applied on our last day.
examples.zh: 同学问最后一天是否仍算「含三餐的住宿」。

words.enDefinition: A docking station with no empty spaces

examples.en: The app marked a full docking station near campus when I looked for somewhere to return the bike.
examples.zh: 我找还车地点时，应用标出了学校附近一个「车桩已满的停靠点」。

examples.en: We met near a full docking station and looked for another one on the map.
examples.zh: 我们在一个「车桩已满的停靠点」附近碰面，然后在地图上另找了一个。

collocations: a warning about a full docking station
a full docking station on the app

words.enDefinition: a standard driving licence issued after the learner or restricted stage

examples.en: The rental form asked whether I held a full driving licence or a permit.
examples.zh: 租车表格问，我持有的是「正式驾驶执照」还是学习许可。

examples.en: I had to show my full driving licence when collecting the replacement car.
examples.zh: 去取替换车辆时，我得出示「正式驾驶执照」。

words.enDefinition: a fuel policy in which a car is collected full and returned full

examples.en: The agent explained the full-to-full policy when I asked about the fuel charge.
examples.zh: 我问燃油收费时，代理说明了「满油取还政策」。

examples.en: The agreement marked full-to-full policy beside the description of the fuel level.
examples.zh: 协议在油量说明旁标了「满油取还政策」。

collocations: a rental with a full-to-full policy

words.enDefinition: A train departure for which no additional reservations are available

examples.en: The ticket office showed a fully booked train on our original route.
examples.zh: 售票处显示，我们原来选的线路上有一趟「座位订满的列车」。

examples.en: We chose another departure after seeing a fully booked train on the screen.
examples.zh: 屏幕上看到那趟「座位订满的列车」后，我们选了另一个班次。

collocations: check for a fully booked train
a notice for a fully booked train

words.enDefinition: A long bag for carrying clothes on hangers

examples.en: I packed my jacket in a garment bag for the university awards ceremony.
examples.zh: 为了参加学校的颁奖仪式，我把外套装进「衣物防皱袋」。

examples.en: I asked the airline counter where the garment bag went during the flight.
examples.zh: 我问航空公司柜台，这个「衣物防皱袋」在飞行途中会放在哪里。

collocations: pack a suit in a garment bag

words.enDefinition: An airline worker who assists passengers at a gate

examples.en: The gate agent showed me which line to join with my boarding pass.
examples.zh: 「登机口工作人员」指给我看，拿着登机牌该排哪条队。

examples.en: I asked the gate agent whether my friend was in the same boarding group.
examples.zh: 我问「登机口工作人员」，朋友的登机组别是不是和我的一样。

collocations: a gate agent at the podium

words.enDefinition: The space around a gate for waiting or boarding

examples.en: We sat in the gate area while a staff member updated the screen.
examples.zh: 工作人员更新屏幕时，我们坐在「登机口区域」等着。

examples.en: The gate area was nearly empty when our group arrived after the security check.
examples.zh: 我们一行人安检后到达时，「登机口区域」几乎没人。

words.enDefinition: a change to the gate assigned for a flight

examples.en: A gate change sent us to the other side of the terminal before boarding.
examples.zh: 因为「登机口变更」，登机前我们去了航站楼另一头。

examples.en: I saw the gate change on my phone while waiting for a coffee near departures.
examples.zh: 我在出发区附近等咖啡时，手机显示了「登机口变更」。

words.enDefinition: To hand a bag over for the hold at the gate

examples.en: The agent said we could gate-check a bag if we wanted more room on board.
examples.zh: 工作人员说，如果我们想在机上多腾些空间，可以「在登机口托运行李」。

examples.en: I asked what label I would receive if I had to gate-check a bag.
examples.zh: 我问如果需要「在登机口托运行李」，会拿到什么标签。

collocations: ask someone to gate-check a bag

words.enDefinition: The time a gate stops accepting boarding passengers

examples.en: The gate closing time appeared on another line below the boarding time.
examples.zh: 「登机口关闭时间」另外列在登机时间下方一行。

examples.en: I checked the gate closing time before taking a seat near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我先看了「登机口关闭时间」，才在入口附近找了个座位。

collocations: arrive before the gate closing time

words.enDefinition: The identifying number or code of a boarding gate

examples.en: I checked the gate number before sending my classmate a message about where to meet.
examples.zh: 告诉同学去哪儿碰面之前，我核对了「登机口编号」。

examples.en: The gate number appeared at the top of the screen above our flight details.
examples.zh: 「登机口编号」显示在屏幕顶部的航班详情上方。

collocations: a gate number on the boarding pass

words.enDefinition: a lever, dial or set of controls for selecting a vehicle's gear or drive setting

examples.en: The agent pointed out the gear selector before handing me the vehicle keys.
examples.zh: 把车钥匙交给我之前，代理指给我看「挡位选择器」在哪里。

examples.en: The gear selector was a small dial rather than a traditional lever.
examples.zh: 车上的「挡位选择器」是个小旋钮，不是传统的杆。

words.enDefinition: A surface that rises or falls gradually

examples.en: The path behind the museum ran along a gentle slope toward the water.
examples.zh: 博物馆后面的小路沿「缓坡」通向水边。

examples.en: The accessibility map showed a gentle slope on the route past the library.
examples.zh: 无障碍地图标出经过图书馆的路线上有一段「缓坡」。

collocations: a path with a gentle slope
a gentle slope toward the river

words.expression: get off at the next stop
words.lemma: get off at the next stop
words.enDefinition: to leave a vehicle at the stop immediately after your current position
acceptedEnVariants: get off at the next stop

examples.en: The driver told me to get off at the next stop for the market.
examples.zh: 司机说，去市场要「在下一站下车」。

examples.en: I decided to get off at the next stop and walk across the park.
examples.zh: 我决定「在下一站下车」，步行穿过公园。

collocations: need to get off at the next stop
ready to get off at the next stop
tell someone to get off at the next stop

words.enDefinition: to board a bus that does not take you in the direction or to the place intended

examples.en: I managed to get on the wrong bus after reading the route number too quickly.
examples.zh: 我看公交线路编号看得太快，结果「坐错公交车」。

examples.en: The stop has two similar route signs, so it is easy to get on the wrong bus.
examples.zh: 站上有两个很像的线路牌，很容易「坐错公交车」。

collocations: accidentally get on the wrong bus
easy to get on the wrong bus
try not to get on the wrong bus

words.enDefinition: to stand and offer your seat to a person who needs it more

examples.en: You can give up your seat if someone needs a place to sit.
examples.zh: 有人需要坐下的话，你可以「给别人让座」。

examples.en: The poster said, “Please give up your seat if another passenger needs it.”
examples.zh: 牌子请乘客在有人更需要座位时「给别人让座」。

collocations: offer to give up your seat
be willing to give up your seat
give up your seat to someone

words.enDefinition: a small storage compartment in a vehicle's dashboard, usually on the passenger side

examples.en: The agent left the rental documents in the glove compartment beneath the dashboard.
examples.zh: 代理把租车文件放在仪表台下方的「前排储物盒」里。

examples.en: I found the charging card in the glove compartment before returning the car.
examples.zh: 还车前，我在「前排储物盒」里找到了充电卡。

collocations: keep papers in the glove compartment

words.enDefinition: leave the group temporarily to do something on your own

examples.en: You can go off on your own during the break and meet us afterwards.
examples.zh: 休息时你可以「独自离队活动」，之后再来和我们会合。

examples.en: If you go off on your own, we'll see you at the main entrance.
examples.zh: 如果你要「独自离队活动」，我们就在正门碰面。

collocations: choose to go off on your own
time to go off on your own
free to go off on your own

words.enDefinition: To pass through the airport's security checks

examples.en: We had time to go through security before meeting the rest of the group.
examples.zh: 和队伍其他人碰面前，我们还有时间「过安检」。

examples.en: The agent pointed toward the east side where we could go through security.
examples.zh: 工作人员指了指东边，我们可以在那里「过安检」。

collocations: get ready to go through security
go through security at the airport

words.enDefinition: pass another security check while making a connection

examples.en: I asked whether I needed to go through security again before my connecting flight.
examples.zh: 我问上转乘航班之前是否要「再过一次安检」。

examples.en: We had to go through security again after changing airports for the second flight.
examples.zh: 为了第二趟航班换机场后，我们得「再过一次安检」。

collocations: ask whether to go through security again
need to go through security again
go through security again for a connection

words.enDefinition: a wait before takeoff while a flight is held on the ground

examples.en: We had a ground delay before takeoff, and I finished another page of my notes.
examples.zh: 我们起飞前遇上了「地面延误」，我又看完了一页笔记。

examples.en: The ground delay ended while we were still waiting near the gate to board.
examples.zh: 我们在登机口附近候机时，「起飞前地面延误」结束了。

words.enDefinition: A guest room on the level nearest the ground outside

examples.en: My sister requested a ground-floor room because she had a stroller.
examples.zh: 姐姐带着婴儿车，所以要求订一间「地面层客房」。

examples.en: The guesthouse confirmed a ground-floor room near the front door.
examples.zh: 小旅馆确认有一间靠近正门的「地面层客房」。

words.enDefinition: Workers assisting airline operations on the ground

examples.en: The ground staff directed us toward the row for checking in our bags.
examples.zh: 「地勤人员」把我们指到了办理行李托运的那排柜台。

examples.en: I asked the ground staff where our group should wait before boarding.
examples.zh: 我问「地勤人员」，我们一行人登机前应该在哪里等。

words.enDefinition: a short leisure trip taken together by several people

examples.en: Our residence planned a group outing to the gardens after everyone finished unpacking.
examples.zh: 等大家都收拾完行李后，宿舍组织了一次去花园的「集体出游」。

examples.en: I joined the group outing to meet people from other courses before term started.
examples.zh: 我参加了「集体出游」，想在开学前认识其他专业的同学。

words.enDefinition: a reduced price offered when people book as a group

examples.en: I asked about a group rate because ten students from our course wanted to go.
examples.zh: 我们课程有十位同学想去，所以我问了「团体票价」。

examples.en: The website listed a group rate for the morning visit our society was planning.
examples.zh: 网站给我们社团计划的上午参观列了「团体票价」。

words.enDefinition: A hotel record listing a guest's charges, credits, and payments

examples.en: I asked for a copy of my guest folio before leaving.
examples.zh: 我离开前要了一份「住客消费明细账」副本。

examples.en: The guest folio showed my room charge above the restaurant bill.
examples.zh: 「住客消费明细账」把我的客房费用列在餐厅账单上面。

words.enDefinition: A kitchen accommodation makes available for people staying there

examples.en: The hostel showed us the guest kitchen before we went upstairs.
examples.zh: 我们上楼前，旅舍工作人员给我们指了「住客厨房」。

examples.en: My classmates made breakfast together in the guest kitchen before leaving.
examples.zh: 同学们离开前在「住客厨房」一起做了早餐。

words.enDefinition: An area where guests can use machines to wash clothes

examples.en: I checked whether the guest laundry was on the same floor.
examples.zh: 我查了「住客自助洗衣区」是不是就在同一层。

examples.en: The hostel map showed the guest laundry near the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 旅舍示意图把「住客自助洗衣区」标在共用厨房附近。

words.enDefinition: A lockable compartment provided for a guest's belongings

examples.en: My guest locker was large enough for a small backpack.
examples.zh: 我的「住客储物柜」够大，能放下一个小背包。

examples.en: The hostel assigned a guest locker with the same number as my bed.
examples.zh: 旅舍给我分配了一个编号与床号相同的「住客储物柜」。

collocations: a guest locker in the dorm

words.enDefinition: A form recording basic details about people staying at a property

examples.en: The receptionist gave me a guest registration form for our group.
examples.zh: 前台人员给了我们一行一张「住客登记表」。

examples.en: I checked the dates on the guest registration form before handing it back.
examples.zh: 交回「住客登记表」前，我核对了上面的日期。

words.enDefinition: A small lodging establishment offering rooms to paying guests

examples.en: We stayed at a guesthouse near the university during the conference.
examples.zh: 开会期间，我们住在大学附近的一家「小型旅馆」。

examples.en: The guesthouse sent us directions from the main train station.
examples.zh: 「小型旅馆」给我们发了从火车总站过去的路线。

words.enDefinition: a book giving visitors information about a place and what to see

examples.en: I borrowed a guidebook to look up the old market before we went.
examples.zh: 我们出发前，我借了本「旅行指南」查查旧市场。

examples.en: The guidebook mentioned a small garden near the river that our map did not show.
examples.zh: 「旅行指南」提到河边有座小花园，我们的地图上却没标。

words.zhGloss: 含早餐和一顿正餐的住宿
words.enDefinition: Accommodation including breakfast and one other daily meal, usually dinner
acceptedZhAnswers: 含早餐和一顿正餐的住宿

examples.en: The hotel listed half board among the meal options for our stay.
examples.zh: 这家酒店的用餐选项中有「含早餐及另一正餐的住宿」。

examples.en: I asked which meals half board covered before confirming my stay.
examples.zh: 我问了「含早餐及另一正餐的住宿」具体包括哪两餐，才确认预订。

words.enDefinition: an outing that takes only part of the day

examples.en: We chose a half-day trip so we could get back before evening rehearsal.
examples.zh: 我们选了「半日游」，好在晚上的排练开始前回来。

examples.en: A half-day trip gave us enough time to see the old market and gardens.
examples.zh: 一次「半日游」让我们有足够的时间逛旧市场和花园。

collocations: a half-day trip to a town

words.enDefinition: The bar used to steer a bicycle

examples.en: The handlebars on that rental bicycle had a small number printed in the middle.
examples.zh: 那辆租来的自行车的「车把」中间印了一个小号码。

examples.en: My friend spotted a tag hanging from the handlebars of the bike I rented.
examples.zh: 朋友看到我租的那辆车的「车把」上挂了一个标签。

words.enDefinition: A suitcase with a rigid outer shell

examples.en: I chose a hard-shell suitcase because I was bringing a few framed prints.
examples.zh: 我要带几幅装裱过的印刷品，就选了一个「硬壳行李箱」。

examples.en: The hard-shell suitcase stood upright beside my friend's bag at the bag drop.
examples.zh: 「硬壳行李箱」竖放在行李托运处朋友的包旁边。

words.enDefinition: arrange for the bag to be brought to your address

examples.en: Could I have my bag delivered to my residence once it reaches this airport?
examples.zh: 行李到了这个机场之后，能「让人把行李送到我的宿舍」吗？

examples.en: I asked whether I could have my bag delivered after I moved to another address.
examples.zh: 我问换了住址之后，能不能「让人把行李送过来」。

collocations: can I have my bag delivered?
have my bag delivered to my residence
ask to have my bag delivered

words.enDefinition: a vehicle's flashing lights that warn others about a hazard or stopped vehicle

examples.en: The parked van had its hazard lights on beside the blocked street.
examples.zh: 封闭街道旁停着一辆厢式车，开着「危险警示闪光灯」。

examples.en: The instructor pointed to the red switch for the hazard lights in the rental.
examples.zh: 教练指出，租来的车上那个红色开关控制「危险警示闪光灯」。

collocations: drive with the hazard lights flashing

words.enDefinition: a test of how well a driver notices developing hazards in road situations

examples.en: The UK practice session included a hazard perception test with recorded traffic scenes.
examples.zh: 英国的练习课有一项「驾驶危险识别测试」，用的是预录的道路场景。

examples.en: I asked how the hazard perception test differed from the multiple-choice section.
examples.zh: 我问「驾驶危险识别测试」和选择题部分有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: a count of how many people are present

examples.en: The guide did a head count before our group crossed the main street.
examples.zh: 小组过主街之前，导游「清点了人数」。

examples.en: We waited by the entrance while the trip organizer finished the head count.
examples.zh: 出游组织者完成「人数清点」前，我们在入口旁等着。

words.enDefinition: a route linking places of local historical or cultural interest

examples.en: We followed a heritage trail past the old school and several former workshop buildings.
examples.zh: 我们沿一条「历史文化游览线路」走，经过旧学校和几座原来的工坊。

examples.en: The heritage trail started near the market, where we picked up a free leaflet.
examples.zh: 「历史文化游览线路」从市场附近开始，我们在那里拿了份免费宣传单。

collocations: a leaflet for a heritage trail

words.enDefinition: a particularly good place that few people know about

examples.en: The small garden felt like a hidden gem because we practically had it to ourselves.
examples.zh: 小花园几乎只有我们在逛，像是个「少有人知的好地方」。

examples.en: My host described the gallery as a hidden gem at the end of the alley.
examples.zh: 接待我的人说，巷子尽头的画廊是个「少有人知的好地方」。

collocations: describe a place as a hidden gem
a hidden gem near the centre

words.enDefinition: a location connected with an important part of the past

examples.en: I visited a historic site near the coast after reading about it in class.
examples.zh: 我在课上读到过海边的一处「历史遗址」，后来去看了看。

examples.en: The historic site had a small outdoor display explaining how people once lived there.
examples.zh: 这处「历史遗址」有个小型室外展区，介绍过去人们在那里怎样生活。

words.enDefinition: visit the most notable places or parts of a destination

examples.en: We had two hours in town, so we decided to hit the highlights first.
examples.zh: 我们在镇上有两小时，所以决定先「逛一逛主要景点」。

examples.en: The morning walk let us hit the highlights before meeting the others for lunch.
examples.zh: 上午散步时，我们先「逛了一下主要景点」，再去和其他人一起吃午饭。

collocations: hit the highlights in an afternoon
a tour that will hit the highlights

words.enDefinition: Baggage kept in a coach's lower compartment during the journey

examples.en: The coach driver told us where to collect our hold luggage.
examples.zh: 长途大巴司机告诉我们去哪里取「行李舱内行李」。

examples.en: I asked where the label for my hold luggage should go.
examples.zh: 我问「行李舱内行李」的标签应该贴在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: to keep your hand on a rail for support while standing or moving

examples.en: I tried to hold the handrail when the bus pulled away from the stop.
examples.zh: 公交驶离站台时，我尽量「扶住扶手」。

examples.en: The notice asked people to hold the handrail on the way down.
examples.zh: 通知请大家往下走时「扶住扶手」。

collocations: ask people to hold the handrail

words.expression: hold the room for late arrival
words.lemma: hold the room for late arrival
words.enDefinition: To keep a booked room available for a guest arriving late
acceptedEnVariants: hold the room for late arrival

examples.en: I asked whether the hotel could hold the room for late arrival after my train arrived.
examples.zh: 我问火车到站前，酒店能不能「为晚到旅客保留客房」。

examples.en: The booking included a note to hold the room for late arrival for our group.
examples.zh: 订单上有条备注，要「为晚到旅客保留客房」，指的是我们一行。

collocations: ask to hold the room for late arrival
agree to hold the room for late arrival
a note to hold the room for late arrival

words.enDefinition: a repeated flight path used while an aircraft waits to proceed

examples.en: The captain said we were in a holding pattern above the coast before landing.
examples.zh: 机长说，着陆前我们正在海岸上方「空中盘旋等待」。

examples.en: We stayed in a holding pattern long enough for me to finish the article.
examples.zh: 我们的「空中盘旋等待」持续了一阵，我都把文章读完了。

words.enDefinition: Delaying a connecting service so arriving passengers can still board

examples.en: The conductor spoke to the other station about holding the connection for us.
examples.zh: 列车长和另一个车站沟通，想为我们「让接续班次等候」。

examples.en: We heard staff discussing holding the connection before the train pulled in.
examples.zh: 列车进站前，我们听到工作人员讨论要不要「让接续班次等候」。

collocations: a notice about holding the connection

words.enDefinition: A plastic card giving a guest electronic access to a room

examples.en: The hotel key card came in a paper sleeve with the room details.
examples.zh: 「酒店房卡」装在一个写有客房信息的纸套里。

examples.en: I took my hotel key card back to reception because it stopped working.
examples.zh: 「酒店房卡」打不开门了，我就拿回了前台。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement asking a lodging property to hold a room

examples.en: I made a hotel reservation after choosing a date for my visit.
examples.zh: 我确定到访日期后做了「酒店预订」。

examples.en: My friend checked whether the hotel reservation covered both nights of the conference.
examples.zh: 朋友核对了这项「酒店预订」是不是涵盖会议期间的两晚。

words.enDefinition: A larger guest unit with sleeping space and a sitting area

examples.en: My classmates shared a hotel suite during the graduation weekend.
examples.zh: 毕业典礼那个周末，同学们合住了一间「酒店套房」。

examples.en: We used the sitting area in the hotel suite to plan our trip.
examples.zh: 我们在「酒店套房」的休息区里商量行程。

collocations: a hotel suite with a living area

words.enDefinition: A number identifying a building on a street

examples.en: The house number was partly covered by leaves when I reached the gate.
examples.zh: 我到门口时，「门牌号」有一部分被树叶挡住了。

examples.en: I checked the house number before sending my classmate a message to say I'd arrived.
examples.zh: 我确认了「门牌号」，再给同学发消息说到了。

words.enDefinition: The hotel service responsible for cleaning and preparing guest rooms

examples.en: I called housekeeping before bed to ask for an extra blanket.
examples.zh: 睡前，我打电话给「客房清洁服务」，请他们再送一条毯子。

examples.en: The hotel left a note about housekeeping beside our keys.
examples.zh: 酒店把关于「客房清洁服务」的提示放在我们的钥匙旁边。

words.enDefinition: A timetable showing when staff plan to clean guest rooms

examples.en: I checked the housekeeping schedule before deciding when to head out.
examples.zh: 我查了「客房清洁时间安排」，才决定什么时候出门。

examples.en: The hotel printed its housekeeping schedule on the welcome card.
examples.zh: 酒店在欢迎卡上印了「客房清洁时间安排」。

collocations: a change to the housekeeping schedule

words.expression: I left my bag on the plane
words.lemma: i left my bag on the plane
words.enDefinition: reports that a bag was forgotten inside the aircraft
acceptedEnVariants: I left my bag on the plane

examples.en: I left my bag on the plane, and my notebook is inside the front pocket.
examples.zh: 「我把包落在飞机上了」，我的笔记本就在前袋里。

examples.en: I think I left my bag on the plane when our group got off.
examples.zh: 我们小组下飞机时，「我好像把包落在飞机上了」。

collocations: I think I left my bag on the plane
I left my bag on the plane after landing
tell the agent I left my bag on the plane

words.enDefinition: A machine making or dispensing ice for people to use

examples.en: Our hotel map showed an ice machine near the elevator.
examples.zh: 酒店示意图在电梯附近标出了「制冰机」。

examples.en: I asked which floor had the ice machine for guests.
examples.zh: 我问哪层有供住客使用的「制冰机」。

words.enDefinition: films, music, or other entertainment provided during a flight

examples.en: I browsed the in-flight entertainment after finishing the reading I brought for class.
examples.zh: 看完上课要读的材料后，我浏览了一下「机上娱乐服务」。

examples.en: The in-flight entertainment included a short documentary about the city we were flying to.
examples.zh: 「机上娱乐服务」里有一部短纪录片，介绍我们要飞去的城市。

words.enDefinition: wireless internet access available while travelling on an aircraft

examples.en: I used in-flight Wi-Fi to tell my roommate which bus I hoped to catch.
examples.zh: 我用「机上无线网络」告诉室友我希望赶上哪班公交。

examples.en: The in-flight Wi-Fi stopped working while I was trying to open the course website.
examples.zh: 我正要打开课程网站时，「机上无线网络」断了。

words.enDefinition: Equipment and supplies provided inside a room for guests

examples.en: I checked the in-room amenities to see whether my room had a kettle.
examples.zh: 我查看了「客房内设施用品」清单，看看房间有没有水壶。

examples.en: The listing described the in-room amenities beneath the room photos.
examples.zh: 住宿页面在客房照片下面介绍了「客房内设施用品」。

words.enDefinition: A lockable box inside a hotel room for storing guest belongings

examples.en: The room description showed an in-room safe inside the wardrobe.
examples.zh: 客房介绍显示，衣柜里有一个「客房保险箱」。

examples.en: I asked the receptionist where to find the in-room safe.
examples.zh: 我问前台人员「客房保险箱」放在什么位置。

words.enDefinition: electric power available from a socket or port at your seat

examples.en: I checked for in-seat power because my phone battery was low after the first flight.
examples.zh: 第一程航班后手机快没电了，我就查看有没有「座位电源」。

examples.en: The in-seat power worked, so I could read on my tablet until we landed.
examples.zh: 「座位电源」可以用，所以我用平板一直看到飞机着陆。

words.enDefinition: with a seat's back raised to its straight position

examples.en: Please make sure your seat is in the upright position as we prepare to land.
examples.zh: 我们正在准备着陆，请确认「座椅靠背已竖直」。

examples.en: I left my seat in the upright position while the person behind me ate lunch.
examples.zh: 后面的人在吃午饭时，我让「座椅靠背保持竖直」。

collocations: keep your seat in the upright position
a seat in the upright position
return it to the upright position

words.enDefinition: a flight arriving at the airport being discussed

examples.en: The inbound flight to our transfer airport arrived a few minutes earlier than planned.
examples.zh: 「飞抵转机机场的航班」比计划早了几分钟到。

examples.en: I checked the inbound flight while my friend waited in the arrivals hall for me.
examples.zh: 朋友在到达大厅等我时，我查看了「飞抵该机场的航班」。

collocations: an inbound flight from a city

words.enDefinition: a service travelling toward a designated centre or arrival terminal

examples.en: I had to cross the road to catch the inbound service toward downtown.
examples.zh: 我得过马路，去坐「往市中心方向的班次」。

examples.en: The plan placed the inbound service on a different platform during construction.
examples.zh: 施工期间，「往中心方向的班次」被安排到了另一个站台。

words.enDefinition: Additional amounts charged for optional items or services during a stay

examples.en: I checked which incidental charges were listed on the final statement.
examples.zh: 我核对了最终账单上列出的「住宿杂费」。

examples.en: The front desk asked which incidental charges I wanted explained.
examples.zh: 前台问我想了解哪几项「住宿杂费」。

words.enDefinition: A temporary card authorization covering possible additional hotel expenses

examples.en: I asked what the pending incidental hold in my card app referred to.
examples.zh: 我问银行应用显示的那笔待处理「酒店杂费预授权」指什么。

examples.en: The receptionist explained where the incidental hold appeared on my account.
examples.zh: 前台人员说明了「酒店杂费预授权」显示在账户的什么位置。

words.enDefinition: The ride time covered by a rental fee

examples.en: I checked the included ride time before choosing a single ride pass.
examples.zh: 选单次骑行券之前，我查看了「套餐内骑行时长」。

examples.en: The screen listed the included ride time next to each option on the app.
examples.zh: 应用屏幕在每个选项旁列出了「套餐内骑行时长」。

collocations: a pass with included ride time

words.enDefinition: a station where passengers can change between several routes or transport services

examples.en: We changed to the metro at the interchange station near the market.
examples.zh: 我们在市场附近的「换乘站」换乘地铁。

examples.en: The interchange station has separate platforms for trams and underground trains.
examples.zh: 这座「换乘站」给有轨电车和地铁分别设了站台。

words.enDefinition: A passenger train linking separate cities, often over substantial distances

examples.en: I took an intercity train to see my friends after exams.
examples.zh: 考完试后，我坐「城际列车」去看朋友。

examples.en: The intercity train left from a different station than the commuter trains.
examples.zh: 「城际列车」和通勤列车不在同一个车站发车。

words.enDefinition: A station between the start and end of a railway service

examples.en: My roommate boarded at an intermediate station after my train left Central.
examples.zh: 我的列车离开中央站后，室友在一处「中途停靠站」上了车。

examples.en: The conductor announced the last intermediate station before our destination.
examples.zh: 列车长报了终点之前最后一个「中途停靠站」。

collocations: an intermediate station on the route

words.enDefinition: The departure area or listing for international flights

examples.en: The sign for international departures pointed upstairs from the bus entrance at the airport.
examples.zh: 从机场的公交入口进来，「国际出发」的指示牌指向楼上。

examples.en: We followed international departures on the signs until we reached the airline counters.
examples.zh: 我们跟着「国际出发」的指示牌走，到了航空公司柜台。

words.enDefinition: a standardized document translating driving licence details for use alongside the original abroad

examples.en: The hire desk asked whether I had an international driving permit with me.
examples.zh: 租车柜台问我有没有随身带「国际驾驶许可证」。

examples.en: I checked that my international driving permit listed the same details as my licence.
examples.zh: 我核对了「国际驾驶许可证」上的信息是否和驾照一致。

collocations: apply for an international driving permit

words.enDefinition: a sign explaining the history or meaning of something visitors see
