examples.en: An interpretive sign told us why the old bridge had two different stone arches.
examples.zh: 一块「景点解说牌」告诉我们，为什么旧桥有两个不同的石拱。

examples.en: We stopped by an interpretive sign to learn what the workshop once produced.
examples.zh: 我们在「景点解说牌」旁停下来，了解这间工坊过去生产什么。

collocations: an interpretive sign beside the path

words.expression: is my bag on the next flight
words.lemma: is my bag on the next flight
words.zhGloss: 我的行李在下一趟航班上吗
words.enDefinition: asks whether the bag is being sent on the next flight
acceptedZhAnswers: 我的行李在下一趟航班上吗
acceptedEnVariants: is my bag on the next flight

examples.en: Is my bag on the next flight from the airport where I changed planes?
examples.zh: 「我的行李在下一趟航班上吗」？是从我换飞机的机场飞过来的那趟。

examples.en: Is my bag on the next flight to this airport or still waiting somewhere?
examples.zh: 「我的行李在飞来这个机场的下一趟航班上吗」，还是仍在别处等着？

collocations: is my bag on the next flight from there?
can you check, is my bag on the next flight?
is my bag on the next flight to this airport?

words.enDefinition: asks whether another flight leaves at a later time

examples.en: Is there a later flight tonight if I can't reach the airport in time?
examples.zh: 如果我赶不到机场，今晚「还有更晚的航班吗」？

examples.en: Is there a later flight that still reaches the same airport before the buses stop running?
examples.zh: 「还有更晚的航班吗」？我想在公交停运前到达同一个机场。

collocations: is there a later flight today?
is there a later flight from this airport?
after this one, is there a later flight?

words.enDefinition: A question confirming who owns a bag

examples.en: The officer asked, “Is this your bag?” while pointing to the blue case.
examples.zh: 安检员指着蓝色的箱子问：「这是您的包吗？」

examples.en: I heard “Is this your bag?” and turned to see what the officer was holding.
examples.zh: 我听到「这是您的包吗」，转身看安检员拿着什么。

words.enDefinition: a plan showing the places and times on a trip

examples.en: I sent our itinerary to my flatmates before we left campus on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 周六早上离开学校前，我把「行程安排」发给了室友。

examples.en: The itinerary listed two places to visit before lunch and one afterwards.
examples.zh: 「行程安排」列出了午饭前去的两个地方和午饭后去的一个地方。

words.enDefinition: An enclosed walkway from the terminal to an aircraft

examples.en: We walked along the jet bridge after the agent scanned our boarding passes.
examples.zh: 工作人员扫完我们的登机牌后，我们沿着「登机廊桥」走。

examples.en: There was a short wait on the jet bridge before we reached the plane.
examples.zh: 到飞机前，我们在「登机廊桥」上等了一小会儿。

words.enDefinition: A larger guest room typically combining sleeping and sitting areas

examples.en: The junior suite had a small sofa beside the sleeping area.
examples.zh: 「小型套房」的睡眠区旁放着一张小沙发。

examples.en: I asked whether the junior suite included a separate bedroom door.
examples.zh: 我问「小型套房」里的卧室有没有单独的门。

collocations: a junior suite with a sofa

words.enDefinition: Very close to the near side of a junction

examples.en: The footpath entrance was just before the junction beside the public garden wall.
examples.zh: 「快到路口时」，在公共花园围墙旁就能看到那条步行小路的入口。

examples.en: I saw the street name sign just before the junction near campus.
examples.zh: 我「快到学校附近那个路口时」看到了路名牌。

collocations: a path just before the junction
a sign just before the junction

words.enDefinition: leave room to change the plans during a trip

examples.en: We decided to keep the itinerary flexible because the weather could change by lunchtime.
examples.zh: 天气可能到午饭时就变了，所以我们决定「给行程留出调整余地」。

examples.en: I wanted to keep the itinerary flexible in case some friends arrived quite late.
examples.zh: 有些朋友可能到得挺晚，我想「给行程留出调整余地」。

collocations: try to keep the itinerary flexible
decide to keep the itinerary flexible
keep the itinerary flexible for the group

words.enDefinition: move fast enough to stay alongside the rest of a group

examples.en: I put my camera away so I could keep up with the group.
examples.zh: 我把相机收了起来，好「跟上队伍」。

examples.en: The guide slowed down so everyone could keep up with the group in the garden.
examples.zh: 导游在花园里走慢了些，让大家都能「跟上队伍」。

collocations: try to keep up with the group
manage to keep up with the group
help someone keep up with the group

words.enDefinition: Directions explaining where or when guests can get their keys

examples.en: I read the key collection instructions while waiting at the train station.
examples.zh: 我在火车站等车时看了「领取钥匙须知」。

examples.en: The guesthouse sent separate key collection instructions before our arrival that evening.
examples.zh: 我们那天晚上到达前，小旅馆另外发了份「领取钥匙须知」。

words.enDefinition: A box where guests can leave room keys when departing

examples.en: The key return box was located beside the door to reception.
examples.zh: 「客房钥匙归还箱」就在前台入口旁边。

examples.en: I asked where to find the key return box before leaving early.
examples.zh: 我一早离开之前，问了「客房钥匙归还箱」在哪里。

collocations: put keys in the key return box

words.enDefinition: a pickup arrangement that lets the customer access a vehicle without collecting a physical key

examples.en: I selected keyless pickup when reserving the car for the weekend trip.
examples.zh: 预订周末出游的车时，我选了「无钥匙取车」。

examples.en: The app showed that keyless pickup was available at the station location.
examples.zh: 应用显示车站这个租车点支持「无钥匙取车」。

words.enDefinition: A folding support that holds a bicycle upright

examples.en: The rental bicycle had a kickstand on the left side behind the pedal.
examples.zh: 那辆出租自行车左侧的踏板后面有一个「脚撑」。

examples.en: The worker showed me which rental bikes had a kickstand near the rear wheel.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我看哪些出租自行车在后轮附近有「脚撑」。

collocations: a bicycle resting on its kickstand

words.enDefinition: A guest room furnished with at least one king-size bed

examples.en: My roommate asked what bed size the king room actually had.
examples.zh: 室友想确认「特大号床客房」里的床实际上有多大。

examples.en: The hotel showed a king room with space for two large bags.
examples.zh: 酒店展示了一间放得下两个大包的「特大号床客房」。

collocations: a king room for one night

words.enDefinition: a bus that can lower one side or the front to reduce the boarding step

examples.en: The museum group boarded a kneeling bus from a raised curb outside.
examples.zh: 博物馆参观团从外面的高路缘上了一辆「可降低车身的公交车」。

examples.en: The guide explained how a kneeling bus makes the entrance lower for passengers.
examples.zh: 指南说明了「可降低车身的公交车」怎样帮乘客降低上车台阶。

collocations: a kneeling bus with a ramp

words.zhGloss: 机场安检前的公共区域
words.enDefinition: On the public side of an airport terminal
acceptedZhAnswers: 机场安检前的公共区域

examples.en: I picked a landside meeting point for my friend before we went through security.
examples.zh: 「过安检前的公共区域」里，我选了一个和朋友碰面的地点。

examples.en: The landside café was near the doors where the airport bus dropped us off.
examples.zh: 「安检前公共区域里的」咖啡馆在机场公交让我们下车的门口附近。

words.enDefinition: a transfer that passes through the public side of an airport

examples.en: The agent marked the landside transfer on the map and pointed out the public walkway.
examples.zh: 工作人员在地图上标出了「经机场公共区转机」的路线，并指出了公共步道。

examples.en: I had a landside transfer and met my friend briefly in the public arrivals hall.
examples.zh: 我这次是「经机场公共区转机」，就在公共到达大厅和朋友短暂见了面。

words.zhGloss: 最近一次行李扫描记录
words.enDefinition: the latest recorded scan of a checked bag's tag
acceptedZhAnswers: 最近一次行李扫描记录

examples.en: The last baggage scan was recorded before my first flight left for the transfer airport.
examples.zh: 第一趟航班飞往转机机场前就有了「最近一次行李扫描记录」。

examples.en: I asked the agent whether the last baggage scan showed a time as well.
examples.zh: 我问工作人员，「最近一次行李扫描记录」是不是也显示时间。

collocations: look up the last baggage scan

words.enDefinition: the most recent place where a bag was known to be

examples.en: The last known location of my bag was the airport where I changed planes.
examples.zh: 我的包「最后一次确认的位置」是我换飞机的机场。

examples.en: The agent checked the last known location before asking another airport to look for it.
examples.zh: 工作人员先查了「最后一次确认的位置」，再请另一个机场帮忙找。

words.enDefinition: a trip arranged very shortly before leaving

examples.en: We took a last-minute trip after our tutor moved the Friday seminar online.
examples.zh: 导师把周五的研讨课改到线上后，我们来了次「临时决定的旅行」。

examples.en: My roommate suggested a last-minute trip when we discovered we both had Monday free.
examples.zh: 发现我们俩周一都有空，室友就建议来一次「临时决定的旅行」。

collocations: a last-minute trip during the break

words.enDefinition: the final scheduled transit service on a route or day

examples.en: We asked whether the last service left from the same stop as usual.
examples.zh: 我们问「末班车」是否从平时那个站发车。

examples.en: The last service was already full by the time it reached our stop.
examples.zh: 「末班车」到我们那一站时，车里已经挤满了人。

collocations: check the time of the last service

words.enDefinition: the final scheduled tour on a particular day

examples.en: We joined the last tour of the day after our visit to the market.
examples.zh: 逛完市场后，我们参加了「当天最后一场导览」。

examples.en: I asked when the last tour of the day would finish at the gardens.
examples.zh: 我问花园里「当天最后一场导览」什么时候结束。

collocations: catch the last tour of the day
miss the last tour of the day
join the last tour of the day

words.enDefinition: Checking into accommodation later than the usual or expected arrival time

examples.en: I emailed about late check-in after our evening train was rescheduled.
examples.zh: 晚间列车改了时间后，我发邮件咨询能否「较晚办理入住」。

examples.en: Our booking included a note about late check-in on Friday.
examples.zh: 我们的订单里有一条关于星期五「较晚办理入住」的备注。

collocations: inform the hotel about late check-in

words.enDefinition: Permission to leave a guest room later than the normal departure time

examples.en: We asked about late checkout because our coach left in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们的长途大巴下午才发车，所以问了能不能「延迟退房」。

examples.en: The desk agent told me how to confirm my late checkout.
examples.zh: 前台接待员告诉我怎样确认自己的「延迟退房」。

words.enDefinition: a plane arriving late before it is due to operate another flight

examples.en: The airline cited a late inbound aircraft when it delayed our evening departure again.
examples.zh: 航空公司再次推迟了我们晚上出发的时间，说是因为「前序执飞飞机晚到」。

examples.en: We waited for a late inbound aircraft, then watched our plane arrive at the gate.
examples.zh: 我们等着「晚到的前序执飞飞机」，后来看到它停靠在登机口。

collocations: a delay due to a late inbound aircraft
wait for a late inbound aircraft
a late inbound aircraft from another city

words.enDefinition: a charge for returning a rented item after the agreed time

examples.en: The agreement lists a late return fee below the scheduled drop-off time.
examples.zh: 协议在计划还车时间下面列出了「逾期还车费」。

examples.en: I called the rental company to ask about the late return fee.
examples.zh: 我打电话给租车公司，询问「逾期还车费」。

words.enDefinition: A hotel service that collects and washes guests' clothes

examples.en: The front desk told me when laundry service was available.
examples.zh: 前台告诉我「衣物送洗服务」什么时候可以用。

examples.en: I asked where to leave my shirt for laundry service.
examples.zh: 我问要用「衣物送洗服务」，衬衫应该放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a wait at an airport between two flights on a journey

examples.en: I spent my layover working on a presentation beside one of the charging points.
examples.zh: 在「转机等候时间」里，我坐在一个充电点旁边做汇报稿。

examples.en: The layover gave me enough time to call home before taking the next flight.
examples.zh: 「转机等候时间」够长，我赶下一趟航班前还给家里打了个电话。

words.enDefinition: a permit allowing someone to practise driving subject to local restrictions

examples.en: The driving school asked whether I already had a learner permit for lessons.
examples.zh: 驾校问我是否已有上课所需的「学员驾驶许可证」。

examples.en: I showed my learner permit to the instructor before my first driving lesson.
examples.zh: 上第一节驾驶课前，我向教练出示了「学员驾驶许可证」。

words.enDefinition: To leave luggage with staff at an accommodation's welcome desk

examples.en: The hostel told us we could leave your bags at reception before the room opened.
examples.zh: 旅舍说房间准备好之前可以「把行李寄存在前台」。

examples.en: I asked whether you could leave your bags at reception after giving back your key.
examples.zh: 我问你交回钥匙之后，能不能「把行李寄存在前台」。

collocations: ask to leave your bags at reception
offer to let you leave your bags at reception
choose to leave your bags at reception

words.enDefinition: A staffed place where passengers can leave luggage temporarily

examples.en: We passed the left-luggage office on our way to the station exit.
examples.zh: 我们去车站出口时经过了「行李寄存处」。

examples.en: I checked when the left-luggage office would close before leaving my bag.
examples.zh: 寄存包之前，我先查了「行李寄存处」几点关门。

collocations: leave a bag at the left-luggage office

words.enDefinition: a slow, relaxed rate of movement or activity

examples.en: We walked at a leisurely pace so everyone could look at the old shopfronts.
examples.zh: 我们「不紧不慢地」走着，让大家都能看看旧店面。

examples.en: The guide kept a leisurely pace while our group moved past the garden walls.
examples.zh: 我们小组沿着花园围墙经过时，导游走得「不紧不慢」。

words.enDefinition: allow travelers with another flight to leave the aircraft before others

examples.en: The crew asked us to let connecting passengers off first after our late arrival.
examples.zh: 我们晚到以后，乘务组请大家「让转机旅客先下机」。

examples.en: We stayed seated to let connecting passengers off first while the crew opened the door.
examples.zh: 乘务组开门时，我们留在座位上，「让转机旅客先下机」。

collocations: ask us to let connecting passengers off first
agree to let connecting passengers off first
an appeal to let connecting passengers off first

words.enDefinition: a place where a road or path crosses railway tracks at the same height

examples.en: Our walking route took us past a level crossing outside the tram depot.
examples.zh: 我们走的路经过电车车场外的一个「平交道口」。

examples.en: The local map marked the level crossing near the sports field.
examples.zh: 本地地图标出了运动场附近的「平交道口」。

collocations: a level crossing near the station

words.enDefinition: insurance covering certain amounts you may owe to other people for harm or damage

examples.en: The US rental guide discussed liability coverage separately from damage to the rental car.
examples.zh: 美国租车指南把「第三方责任保障」和租赁车辆损坏分开介绍。

examples.en: I asked where the policy explained liability coverage for damage to someone else's vehicle.
examples.zh: 我问保单哪里说明了损坏别人的车时，「第三方责任保障」如何适用。

words.enDefinition: a class on a driving licence showing a type of vehicle the holder may drive

examples.en: The clerk pointed to the licence category printed beside the small vehicle symbol.
examples.zh: 办事员指着小车辆图标旁印的「准驾车型类别」。

examples.en: I asked which licence category the rental form was referring to on that line.
examples.zh: 我问租车表格那一行说的是哪个「准驾车型类别」。

words.enDefinition: a code used by UK licensing services to share specified driving licence information

examples.en: The British rental company asked for a licence check code before handing over the keys.
examples.zh: 英国租车公司在交钥匙之前要求提供「驾照记录查询码」。

examples.en: I asked where to generate a licence check code on the government website.
examples.zh: 我问在政府网站哪里能生成「驾照记录查询码」。

words.enDefinition: the process of replacing a licence issued elsewhere with one issued locally

examples.en: The transport office explained which records it needed for a licence exchange.
examples.zh: 交通办事处说明了「换领当地驾驶执照」需要哪些材料。

examples.en: I booked a licence exchange appointment after I moved into the new flat.
examples.zh: 搬进新公寓后，我预约了「换领当地驾驶执照」。

words.enDefinition: the process of extending or reissuing a driving licence as its validity ends

examples.en: I received a confirmation message about my licence renewal in the online account.
examples.zh: 我的在线账号收到了一条「驾驶执照续期」确认消息。

examples.en: The counter had a separate sign for licence renewal and first-time applications.
examples.zh: 柜台用不同的牌子区分「驾驶执照续期」和首次申请。

words.enDefinition: an urban rail system using relatively light vehicles, often at street level or on separate tracks

examples.en: I used light rail to get across town for my afternoon placement.
examples.zh: 我坐「轻轨」穿过市区，去参加下午的实习。

examples.en: The light rail stops beside the newer campus instead of crossing the river.
examples.zh: 「轻轨」停在新一些的校区旁边，不往河对岸开。

words.enDefinition: a bus that serves fewer stops on its route than an ordinary service does

examples.en: I checked whether the limited-stop bus would stop near my evening class.
examples.zh: 我查了「少停站公交车」会不会在我上晚课的地方附近停靠。

examples.en: The limited-stop bus served the hospital but skipped our smaller campus stop.
examples.zh: 「少停站公交车」会停靠医院站，但跳过了我们学校那个小站。

words.enDefinition: spoken explanations given live while visitors travel or look around

examples.en: The guide provided live commentary as we passed the workshops along the old canal.
examples.zh: 我们经过旧运河边的工坊时，导游做了「现场讲解」。

examples.en: I could hear the live commentary clearly when our group stopped by the bridge.
examples.zh: 我们小组在桥边停下时，我能听清楚「现场讲解」。

words.enDefinition: departure times updated with current operational information rather than only the printed schedule

examples.en: I compared live departures for both tram lines while leaving the library.
examples.zh: 离开图书馆时，我比较了两条电车线路的「实时发车信息」。

examples.en: The screen stopped showing live departures during a brief power cut at the station.
examples.zh: 车站短暂停电时，屏幕停止显示「实时发车信息」。

words.enDefinition: a designated area for vehicles to stop while loading or unloading goods

examples.en: The driver pulled into the loading zone behind the residence with our boxes.
examples.zh: 司机载着我们的箱子开进了宿舍后面的「装卸车辆临停区」。

examples.en: The map labelled the loading zone separately from the ordinary visitor parking.
examples.zh: 地图把「装卸车辆临停区」和访客停车位分开标注。

words.enDefinition: A seating area in or adjoining a hotel's entrance hall

examples.en: I waited in the lobby lounge until my classmates arrived.
examples.zh: 我在「大堂休息区」等到同学们过来。

examples.en: We met in the lobby lounge before going out for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们先在「大堂休息区」碰面，再出去吃晚饭。

words.enDefinition: a bus operating within a community or area and typically stopping frequently

examples.en: I took a local bus to the supermarket after my afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 下午下课后，我坐「本地公交车」去了超市。

examples.en: The local bus stops outside the student flats on its way downtown.
examples.zh: 「本地公交车」开往市中心时会在学生公寓外停靠。

words.enDefinition: Unable to enter one's room because the door is locked

examples.en: I told reception I was locked out of my room after my card stopped working.
examples.zh: 房卡失灵后，我告诉前台我「被锁在自己房间外」。

examples.en: I asked for help when I found myself locked out of my room again.
examples.zh: 我发现自己又「被锁在自己房间外」，就去找人帮忙。

collocations: get locked out of my room
say "I'm locked out of my room."
call reception when locked out of my room

words.enDefinition: A bus designed to carry passengers between relatively distant places

examples.en: My flatmate took a long-distance coach home during the reading week.
examples.zh: 我室友在复习周坐「长途大巴」回了家。

examples.en: We boarded the long-distance coach outside the main station after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我们在主车站外面上了「长途大巴」。

words.enDefinition: Small stones lying freely on a surface

examples.en: The route description mentioned loose gravel on the path beside the canal.
examples.zh: 路线说明提到，运河旁的小路上有「散落的碎石」。

examples.en: I could hear loose gravel under my shoes on the way to the garden.
examples.zh: 去花园的路上，我能听见鞋底踩在「散落的碎石」上的声音。

words.enDefinition: A paving slab that shifts out of place

examples.en: I noticed a loose paving slab beside the sign at the park gate.
examples.zh: 我注意到公园门边的指示牌旁有一块「松动的铺路板」。

examples.en: A cone marked the loose paving slab near the corner of the campus walkway.
examples.zh: 学校步行道拐角附近摆了个路锥，标明那里有块「松动的铺路板」。

collocations: a loose paving slab near a gate

words.enDefinition: a rental waiver limiting responsibility for specified losses, which may include theft and damage

examples.en: The form listed the loss damage waiver beside other optional rental protections.
examples.zh: 表格把「车辆损失责任减免」与其他可选租车保障列在一起。

examples.en: I asked whether the loss damage waiver described theft as well as damage.
examples.zh: 我问「车辆损失责任减免」是否既包含损坏也提到了失窃。

collocations: terms of a loss damage waiver

words.enDefinition: checked luggage that the airline cannot locate

examples.en: The airline asked me to describe my lost baggage and check the contact number.
examples.zh: 航空公司请我描述「遗失的托运行李」，并确认联系电话。

examples.en: They sent another message about the lost baggage after checking a different arrival airport.
examples.zh: 核查了另一个到达机场后，他们又发来了关于「遗失的托运行李」的消息。

words.enDefinition: A service desk that helps people recover items they left behind

examples.en: I called the lost property desk after leaving my scarf at the hotel.
examples.zh: 我把围巾落在酒店，就给「失物招领服务台」打了电话。

examples.en: The receptionist told me where to find the lost property desk nearby.
examples.zh: 前台人员告诉我附近哪里有「失物招领服务台」。

collocations: ask at the lost property desk
a message from the lost property desk

words.enDefinition: a bus with a low passenger floor designed to make boarding easier

examples.en: The route map showed a low-floor bus symbol beside the weekend service.
examples.zh: 线路图在周末班次旁边用了「低地板公交车」标志。

examples.en: A low-floor bus arrived while we waited near the student residence entrance.
examples.zh: 我们在学生公寓入口附近等车时，来了一辆「低地板公交车」。

words.enDefinition: a warning showing that a vehicle has relatively little fuel remaining

examples.en: The low-fuel alert appeared while we were driving back from the campus event.
examples.zh: 我们从校园活动现场开车回去时，出现了「燃油不足提示」。

examples.en: I noticed the low-fuel alert when checking the dashboard before leaving the lot.
examples.zh: 离开停车场前，我看仪表盘时注意到「燃油不足提示」。

words.enDefinition: the period when a destination receives fewer visitors

examples.en: I visited in the low season and had time to look around without queues.
examples.zh: 我在「旅游淡季」去的，不用排队，能慢慢逛。

examples.en: Some tours ran less often during the low season, so we checked the schedule.
examples.zh: 「旅游淡季」有些导览的场次比较少，所以我们查了时刻安排。

words.enDefinition: A sleeping place positioned below another in a train compartment

examples.en: I requested a lower berth when booking the overnight train.
examples.zh: 我订夜间列车时选了「下铺」。

examples.en: My roommate had the lower berth in the same compartment as me.
examples.zh: 我室友坐的是跟我同一个包厢的「下铺」。

words.enDefinition: The bed positioned lower in a set of bunk beds

examples.en: My friend requested a lower bunk when booking her hostel bed.
examples.zh: 朋友订旅舍床位时，要求给她一个「下层床铺」。

examples.en: The label on the lower bunk was easier to see from the door.
examples.zh: 从门口更容易看清「下层床铺」上的标签。

words.enDefinition: The quantity or size of baggage permitted for a booking

examples.en: I checked the luggage allowance before choosing a bag for the coach.
examples.zh: 我先看了「行李限额」，再选坐大巴时带的包。

examples.en: The operator explained where the luggage allowance appeared on my booking.
examples.zh: 运营方说明了我的订单上在哪里显示「行李限额」。

words.enDefinition: A removable cover that protects a suitcase exterior

examples.en: I chose a bright luggage cover so I could recognize my suitcase quickly.
examples.zh: 我选了一个颜色鲜艳的「行李箱保护套」，这样能一下认出自己的箱子。

examples.en: The luggage cover had an opening for the handle at the top.
examples.zh: 「行李箱保护套」顶部有个开口，可以露出提手。

words.enDefinition: details such as size or color used to identify luggage

examples.en: My luggage description included a blue strap and a small white sticker near the handle.
examples.zh: 我的「行李外观描述」写了蓝色绑带，提手旁边还有一张小白贴纸。

examples.en: I updated the luggage description after finding a photo from our previous trip.
examples.zh: 找到上次旅行时拍的照片后，我更新了「行李外观描述」。

collocations: add details to a luggage description

words.enDefinition: A lower storage compartment for bags in a coach

examples.en: The driver opened the luggage hold before we showed our tickets.
examples.zh: 我们出示车票前，司机打开了「大巴行李舱」。

examples.en: My roommate collected her bag from the luggage hold at our stop.
examples.zh: 到我们下车的站时，室友从「大巴行李舱」里取了她的包。

collocations: put bags in the luggage hold
collect bags from the luggage hold

words.enDefinition: A small lock used to secure luggage

examples.en: My luggage lock was in the same pouch as the spare bag tags.
examples.zh: 我的「行李锁」和备用行李牌放在同一个袋子里。

examples.en: I bought a luggage lock from the shop in the departure hall.
examples.zh: 我在出发大厅的商店买了一个「行李锁」。

collocations: a suitcase with a luggage lock

words.enDefinition: A lockable compartment where travelers can temporarily leave bags

examples.en: I found a luggage locker beside the stairs at the station.
examples.zh: 我在车站楼梯旁找到了一个「行李寄存柜」。

examples.en: We looked for a luggage locker large enough for two bags.
examples.zh: 我们找了一个能放下两个包的「行李寄存柜」。

words.enDefinition: A room used for temporarily storing luggage at accommodation

examples.en: The luggage room was behind reception and just beside the stairs.
examples.zh: 「行李存放室」在前台后面，就在楼梯旁。

examples.en: I asked whether the luggage room was available after we checked out.
examples.zh: 我问我们退房之后还能不能用「行李存放室」。

collocations: leave a bag in the luggage room

words.enDefinition: A set of shelves for larger bags on a train

examples.en: I saw a luggage stack beside the door at the carriage entrance.
examples.zh: 我在车厢入口门边看到了「多层行李架」。

examples.en: The conductor pointed out the luggage stack for larger bags.
examples.zh: 列车员指明了用来放大件行李的「多层行李架」。

collocations: a luggage stack near the door

words.enDefinition: A strap fastened around a suitcase

examples.en: The bright luggage strap made it easy to recognize my suitcase in the queue.
examples.zh: 鲜艳的「行李箱捆扎带」让我一下就在队伍里认出了自己的行李箱。

examples.en: I tightened the luggage strap after closing the suitcase beside the check-in counter.
examples.zh: 我在值机柜台旁合上行李箱后，把「行李箱捆扎带」勒紧了。

words.enDefinition: Material wrapped around luggage for protection

examples.en: The shop near the counter offered luggage wrap for cases with exposed straps.
examples.zh: 柜台旁的店提供「行李缠绕包装膜」，用来包裹绑带露在外面的箱子。

examples.en: The luggage wrap on my classmate's suitcase was clear enough to see the handle.
examples.zh: 同学行李箱上的「行李缠绕包装膜」是透明的，能看见提手。

collocations: wrap a suitcase in luggage wrap

words.enDefinition: the person listed as primarily responsible for driving or renting the vehicle

examples.en: The rental clerk checked the main driver before adding my classmate to the agreement.
examples.zh: 租车柜台人员先核对了「主驾驶人」，再把同学加进协议。

examples.en: I updated the main driver field after our travel plans changed for Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六行程变了之后，我更新了「主驾驶人」一栏。

words.enDefinition: A station serving an important route in a railway network

examples.en: We walked from the mainline station to the university after our train ride.
examples.zh: 下火车后，我们从「干线铁路车站」走到大学。

examples.en: My friend told me which mainline station served the city centre.
examples.zh: 朋友告诉我哪座「干线铁路车站」通往市中心。

words.enDefinition: To clean and prepare an occupied or recently used guest room

examples.en: I asked when housekeeping could make up the room after our meeting.
examples.zh: 我问开完会后，客房服务人员什么时候可以「打扫并整理房间」。

examples.en: The card said "Make up the room," so I left it on the door.
examples.zh: 牌子上写着「打扫并整理房间」，我把它挂在门上。

collocations: ask housekeeping to make up the room
a sign asking to make up the room
time to make up the room

words.enDefinition: a transmission in which the driver selects gears and usually operates a clutch

examples.en: The agent asked whether we had booked a car with manual transmission.
examples.zh: 代理问我们订的是不是装有「手动变速器」的车。

examples.en: I compared the price of manual transmission cars with the automatic options.
examples.zh: 我比较了装「手动变速器」的车和自动挡车型的价格。

collocations: drive a vehicle with manual transmission

words.zhGloss: 用自家航班号销售的航司
words.enDefinition: an airline offering a flight under its own flight number
acceptedZhAnswers: 用自家航班号销售的航司

examples.en: The itinerary listed the marketing carrier beside the airline that would actually fly the plane.
examples.zh: 行程单把「用自家航班号销售的航司」列在实际执飞航司旁边。

examples.en: I compared the flight numbers to see whether the marketing carrier had changed on my booking.
examples.zh: 我对比了航班号码，看看预订里的「用自家航班号销售的航司」是否变了。

collocations: the marketing carrier for a codeshare flight

words.enDefinition: the largest number of people allowed in a group

examples.en: The guide checked the maximum group size before letting two more friends join us.
examples.zh: 让另外两个朋友加入以前，导游查了「团体人数上限」。

examples.en: We reached the maximum group size, so the organizer divided us into two tours.
examples.zh: 人数到了「团体人数上限」，组织者就把我们分成了两场导览。

words.enDefinition: the longest period a vehicle may remain in a parking space under stated conditions

examples.en: The parking sign showed a maximum stay beside the hourly fee.
examples.zh: 停车牌在每小时收费旁边注明了「最长允许停留时间」。

examples.en: I asked whether the maximum stay applied to the car park all day.
examples.zh: 我问停车场是不是一整天都适用「最长允许停留时间」规定。

collocations: a maximum stay of two hours

words.enDefinition: the period when crew serve meals to passengers on a flight

examples.en: I put my books away before meal service so there would be space on the table.
examples.zh: 「机上送餐服务」开始前，我把书收好，好在桌板上腾出地方。

examples.en: The captain said meal service would start after we passed through the clouds ahead.
examples.zh: 机长说飞过前面的云层后，就开始「机上送餐服务」。

words.enDefinition: a wheeled cart the crew uses to move meals through the cabin

examples.en: The meal trolley stopped next to my row while I was packing up my notebook.
examples.zh: 我收笔记本时，「机上餐车」停在我那排座位旁。

examples.en: I waited until the meal trolley had passed before asking to get into the aisle.
examples.zh: 我等「机上餐车」过去后，才开口请人让我到过道上。

collocations: a meal trolley in the aisle

words.enDefinition: asks the group to return to this place at a stated time

examples.en: Please meet back here at four so we can all walk to the bridge together.
examples.zh: 「请四点回这里集合」，这样大家能一起走去桥边。

examples.en: Let's meet back here at noon after everyone has seen the upstairs rooms.
examples.zh: 等大家看完楼上的房间，「咱们中午回这里集合」。

collocations: meet back here at the agreed time
please meet back here at three

words.enDefinition: the place where people have agreed to gather

examples.en: The guide asked us to be at the meeting point beside the market steps.
examples.zh: 导游请我们到市场台阶旁那个「约定的集合点」去。

examples.en: I took a photo of the meeting point so I could find it again later.
examples.zh: 我给「约定的集合点」拍了张照，方便之后再找到那里。

words.enDefinition: A device that senses the presence of metal

examples.en: The picture of a metal detector was on the sign above the checkpoint.
examples.zh: 安检口上方的牌子上画着一台「金属探测器」。

examples.en: I asked the officer which line led to the metal detector beside the belt.
examples.zh: 我问安检员哪条队伍通向传送带旁的「金属探测器」。

collocations: a metal detector at the checkpoint

words.enDefinition: an urban rapid rail system, which may run underground, above ground or both

examples.en: I took the metro to the student museum because it was raining.
examples.zh: 下雨了，我坐「城市地铁」去了学生博物馆。

examples.en: The metro was faster than the bus during the morning traffic that day.
examples.zh: 那天早上车多的时候，「城市地铁」比公交更快。

words.enDefinition: A seat between two other seats in a row

examples.en: I was assigned a middle seat while my classmate sat in another row.
examples.zh: 我分到了一个「中间座位」，同学则坐在另一排。

examples.en: The agent said the only seat still showing on my screen was a middle seat.
examples.zh: 工作人员说，我屏幕上唯一还显示的座位是「中间座位」。

collocations: a middle seat in the back

words.enDefinition: the distance a customer may drive under a rental rate before extra charges apply

examples.en: I checked the mileage allowance before deciding which town to visit on Sunday.
examples.zh: 决定周日去哪座城之前，我先查了「租车包含的里程数」。

examples.en: The agreement listed the mileage allowance above the charge for going beyond it.
examples.zh: 协议在超出里程的收费上方列出了「租车包含的里程数」。

words.enDefinition: A small supply of drinks and snacks provided inside a hotel room

examples.en: The confirmation listed a minibar among the room amenities on offer.
examples.zh: 确认信息在所提供的客房设施下列了「客房迷你吧」。

examples.en: I asked which of the drinks in the room were from the minibar.
examples.zh: 我问房间里的饮料有哪些是「客房迷你吧」提供的。

words.enDefinition: the official shortest scheduled interval for transferring between particular flights

examples.en: The agent checked the minimum connection time for the airport before showing me another itinerary.
examples.zh: 工作人员先查了那个机场的「最短转机时间」，才给我看另一条行程。

examples.en: I asked what minimum connection time applied to the transfer listed on my ticket.
examples.zh: 我问机票上的这次转机适用哪个「最短转机时间」。

words.enDefinition: the smallest number of participants needed for a group activity

examples.en: I checked the minimum group size before signing our society up for the outing.
examples.zh: 给社团报名出游之前，我查了「最低成团人数」。

examples.en: The tour had a minimum group size, so we invited members of another society.
examples.zh: 这场导览有「最低成团人数」要求，所以我们邀请了另一个社团的成员。

words.enDefinition: The smallest number of nights a property accepts for a booking

examples.en: I checked the minimum stay before asking about a Saturday room.
examples.zh: 问星期六有没有房以前，我先查看了「最少入住晚数」。

examples.en: The listing showed a minimum stay for the holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 住宿页面注明了节假日周末的「最少入住晚数」。

collocations: a minimum stay for certain dates

words.enDefinition: to fail to reach the next planned service in time to board it

examples.en: I was worried I might miss a connection after the tram stopped.
examples.zh: 有轨电车停住后，我担心会「没赶上换乘班次」。

examples.en: The app showed another route if passengers happened to miss a connection.
examples.zh: 应用显示，乘客如果「没赶上换乘班次」，还有另一条线路。

collocations: cause someone to miss a connection
have enough time to avoid missing a connection

words.enDefinition: arrive too late for the reserved time to enter

examples.en: We might miss our entry slot if we stop for another coffee after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后如果再停下来喝一杯咖啡，我们可能会「错过入场时段」。

examples.en: I called the gallery because we were about to miss our entry slot that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们快要「错过当天下午的入场时段」了，所以我给画廊打了电话。

collocations: try not to miss our entry slot
worried we'll miss our entry slot

words.enDefinition: A shared hostel room available to people of different genders

examples.en: We both booked beds in the same mixed dorm for Saturday.
examples.zh: 我们都订了星期六同一间「男女混住多人间」的床位。

examples.en: I checked whether the mixed dorm was on the same floor as reception.
examples.zh: 我核对了「男女混住多人间」和前台是不是在同一层。

collocations: book a bed in a mixed dorm
a mixed dorm at the hostel

words.enDefinition: A boarding pass displayed on a mobile device

examples.en: I opened the mobile boarding pass on my phone before joining the group.
examples.zh: 加入队伍前，我在手机上打开了「手机登机牌」。

examples.en: My friend checked the boarding time on the mobile boarding pass while we waited.
examples.zh: 等候时，朋友查看了「手机登机牌」上的登机时间。

words.enDefinition: a ticket displayed or stored on a phone or other mobile device

examples.en: The conductor scanned my mobile ticket from the screen of my phone.
examples.zh: 车上工作人员扫描了我手机屏幕上的「手机电子车票」。

examples.en: I downloaded the mobile ticket before going to the underground platform.
examples.zh: 去地下站台前，我下载了「手机电子车票」。

words.enDefinition: a transit pass covering eligible trips during a month or monthly period

examples.en: I compared a monthly transit pass with the cost of separate bus fares.
examples.zh: 我比较了「月度公交乘车证」和单独买公交票的费用。

examples.en: The monthly transit pass covered the two lines I used for class.
examples.zh: 「月度公交乘车证」覆盖我上课要坐的两条线路。

collocations: travel with a monthly transit pass

words.enDefinition: change an outdoor tour so it takes place inside

examples.en: The guide chose to move the tour indoors when heavy rain reached the village.
examples.zh: 大雨下到村庄时，导游决定「把导览改到室内」。

examples.en: We might move the tour indoors if the garden paths stay wet this afternoon.
examples.zh: 如果下午花园的小路还是湿的，我们可能会「把导览改到室内」。

collocations: decide to move the tour indoors
ask whether to move the tour indoors
have to move the tour indoors

words.enDefinition: To step out of the main line or path

examples.en: The officer asked me to move to the side while I found my boarding pass.
examples.zh: 安检员让我「移到旁边」找登机牌。

examples.en: Could you move to the side so the people behind you can pass?
examples.zh: 你能「移到旁边」吗，让身后的人过去。

collocations: ask someone to move to the side
move to the side of the lane
move to the side to let people pass

words.enDefinition: a pass giving entry to a selection of attractions across a destination

examples.en: I considered a multi-attraction pass because we planned to visit several places across town.
examples.zh: 我们计划逛遍镇上好几个地方，我就考虑买「多景点通票」。

examples.en: The multi-attraction pass included a list of sites we could visit over the weekend.
examples.zh: 「多景点通票」附了一张清单，列出了周末可以去的景点。

words.enDefinition: says your checked bag has not appeared on the belt

examples.en: My bag hasn't come out, but all the other students already have their suitcases.
examples.zh: 「我的行李还没出来」，但其他同学都已经拿到箱子了。

examples.en: My bag hasn't come out on this belt, although the screen shows my flight.
examples.zh: 屏幕显示的是我这趟航班，可「我的行李还没从这个转盘出来」。

collocations: my bag hasn't come out yet
my bag hasn't come out on this belt
it looks like my bag hasn't come out

words.expression: my bag was sent to the wrong airport
words.lemma: my bag was sent to the wrong airport
words.zhGloss: 我的行李被送错机场了
words.enDefinition: reports that the bag was routed to a different airport by mistake
acceptedZhAnswers: 我的行李被送错机场了
acceptedEnVariants: my bag was sent to the wrong airport

examples.en: The agent said my bag was sent to the wrong airport after our transfer.
examples.zh: 工作人员说，转机后「我的行李被送错机场了」。

examples.en: It looks like my bag was sent to the wrong airport according to the tracking page.
examples.zh: 从追踪页面看，好像「我的行李被送错机场了」。

collocations: it looks like my bag was sent to the wrong airport
the airline says my bag was sent to the wrong airport
I think my bag was sent to the wrong airport

words.enDefinition: A difference between names on two records

examples.en: The agent noticed a name mismatch and asked me to show the original email.
examples.zh: 工作人员发现「姓名不一致」，请我出示原始邮件。

examples.en: I asked the help desk about a name mismatch before going to check-in.
examples.zh: 去值机前，我向服务台问了「姓名不一致」的问题。

collocations: a name mismatch in the booking

words.enDefinition: The passenger name recorded for the reservation

examples.en: I checked the name on the booking before going to the airline counter.
examples.zh: 去航空公司柜台前，我核对了「预订记录上的姓名」。

examples.en: The agent asked whether the name on the booking included my middle name.
examples.zh: 工作人员问「预订记录上的姓名」是否包含我的中间名。

collocations: check the name on the booking
confirm the name on the booking
a typo in the name on the booking

words.enDefinition: A narrow walking area alongside a road

examples.en: The map note described a narrow pavement on the bridge toward the gallery.
examples.zh: 地图说明写着，通往美术馆的桥上有一段「狭窄的人行道」。

examples.en: The narrow pavement widened again beside the gates of the community garden.
examples.zh: 「狭窄的人行道」到了社区花园大门旁又变宽了。

collocations: a narrow pavement beside a wall

words.enDefinition: the earliest later flight that has a seat available

examples.en: The agent found the next available flight, which departed shortly after lunch the following day.
examples.zh: 工作人员找到了「下一班有位的航班」，第二天午饭后不久出发。

examples.en: I asked for the next available flight because my term started on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 我的学期周一早上开始，所以我问能不能坐「下一班有位的航班」。

words.enDefinition: a bus that operates late at night, often after regular services stop

examples.en: I took the night bus home after the campus film screening ended.
examples.zh: 校园电影放映结束后，我坐「夜间公交车」回家。

examples.en: The night bus uses a different stop on the other side of the road.
examples.zh: 「夜间公交车」停靠的是马路对面的另一个站。

words.enDefinition: A passenger train that runs during the night

examples.en: I booked a night train so I could travel after class.
examples.zh: 我订了「夜间列车」，这样下课之后还能出发。

examples.en: The night train reached the city just before my friends woke up.
examples.zh: 朋友们快起床时，「夜间列车」到了那座城市。

words.enDefinition: The amount charged for one night of accommodation

examples.en: I checked the nightly rate before confirming our weekend stay.
examples.zh: 我核对了「每晚房价」，才确认周末的住宿订单。

examples.en: The email listed a different nightly rate for the second night.
examples.zh: 邮件为第二晚列了不同的「每晚房价」。

words.enDefinition: A notice that cycling is prohibited there

examples.en: The park map marked the area around the pond “No cycling” in red.
examples.zh: 公园地图用红色将池塘周围标为「禁止骑行」。

examples.en: I saw a “No cycling” sign near the narrowest part of the path.
examples.zh: 我在小路最窄的地方附近看到一块「禁止骑行」的牌子。

words.enDefinition: a rule sign forbidding use of camera flash

examples.en: The old house had a no flash photography sign beside the upstairs display.
examples.zh: 老宅楼上的展区旁边有块牌子，写着「禁止使用闪光灯拍照」。

examples.en: I saw no flash photography on the notice before our group entered the room.
examples.zh: 我们小组进房间前，我看见告示上写着「禁止使用闪光灯拍照」。

collocations: a room marked no flash photography
a notice saying no flash photography

words.zhGloss: 暂未公布新的出发时间
words.enDefinition: says the airline has not announced a revised departure time
acceptedZhAnswers: 暂未公布新的出发时间

examples.en: There was no new departure time when I checked the app after speaking to my friend.
examples.zh: 我和朋友聊完后查看应用，发现「暂未公布新的出发时间」。

examples.en: The announcement said there was no new departure time while the aircraft was being checked.
examples.zh: 广播说飞机正在检查，「暂未公布新的出发时间」。

collocations: a notice saying no new departure time

words.enDefinition: an area where ordinary parking is prohibited

examples.en: The sign marked a no parking zone beside the vehicle entrance to campus.
examples.zh: 标识把学校车行入口旁标为「禁止停车区」。

examples.en: I asked the attendant where the no parking zone ended near the hall.
examples.zh: 我问管理员，大厅附近的「禁止停车区」到哪里结束。

words.enDefinition: A notice that people cannot continue there on foot

examples.en: The sign said “No pedestrian access” where the path reached the construction gate.
examples.zh: 小路走到施工门口的地方立着牌子，写着「行人禁止通行」。

examples.en: I saw “No pedestrian access” on one side of the temporary fence.
examples.zh: 我在临时围栏的一侧看到了「行人禁止通行」的标示。

words.enDefinition: A notice that there is no onward passage

examples.en: The map marked no through route beyond the courtyard during the exhibition.
examples.zh: 地图标明，展览期间院子后面的路「不可穿行」。

examples.en: I saw a “No through route” notice at the entrance to the narrow lane.
examples.zh: 我在窄巷入口看到了「前方不可穿行」的牌子。

collocations: a map showing no through route
a path marked no through route

words.enDefinition: A notice saying the accommodation has no guest rooms available

examples.en: The sign read "No vacancies," so we checked the next guesthouse.
examples.zh: 牌子上写着「没有空房」，我们就去看下一家小旅馆。

examples.en: I saw "No vacancies" on the hostel's booking page that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，我在旅舍预订页看到「没有空房」。

words.enDefinition: A price offered under terms that do not provide a refund

examples.en: I checked how the website labeled the non-refundable rate for that room.
examples.zh: 我查看了网站怎样标示该客房的「不可退款的房价」。

examples.en: The receptionist explained what the non-refundable rate on my confirmation meant.
examples.zh: 前台人员解释了我确认信息里的「不可退款的房价」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: A guest room where smoking is prohibited by the accommodation

examples.en: I checked whether the non-smoking room was listed on my confirmation.
examples.zh: 我核对了确认信息上有没有列出「禁烟客房」。

examples.en: The agent confirmed a non-smoking room for my friend's short stay.
examples.zh: 接待员确认给我朋友的这次短住安排了「禁烟客房」。

words.enDefinition: a flight that reaches its destination without an intermediate stop

examples.en: I booked a nonstop flight so I could get back home before my evening class.
examples.zh: 我订了「不经停航班」，这样可以在夜课前到家。

examples.en: A nonstop flight made the trip shorter when I was travelling with my project group.
examples.zh: 和项目组一起出行时，「不经停航班」缩短了整段行程。

words.enDefinition: A service making no scheduled stops between two locations

examples.en: We chose a nonstop service for the journey between the two cities.
examples.zh: 我们去另一座城市时，选了「中途不停的班次」。

examples.en: The midday coach was a nonstop service on the timetable.
examples.zh: 时刻表上，中午那趟长途大巴是一个「中途不停的班次」。

collocations: a nonstop service to the city

words.enDefinition: A notice that a particular service will skip a named station

examples.en: The board showed "Not calling at Riverside" beside our train number.
examples.zh: 显示屏在我们的车次号旁写了「不停靠河畔站」。

examples.en: The conductor said we were "Not calling at Central" this afternoon.
examples.zh: 列车长说，我们这趟下午的列车「不停靠中央站」。

collocations: not calling at the usual stations
not calling at the town centre
a notice saying not calling at

words.enDefinition: An announcement that boarding has started

examples.en: The gate screen showed “Now boarding” when we came back from the café.
examples.zh: 我们从咖啡馆回来时，登机口屏幕显示「正在登机」。

examples.en: I heard “Now boarding” over the loudspeaker and checked the flight number.
examples.zh: 我听到广播说「正在登机」，就核对了航班号。

collocations: now boarding at the next gate

words.enDefinition: Words introducing a revised estimate for when a service will arrive

examples.en: The board said "Now expected at six" beside the train number.
examples.zh: 显示屏在车次号旁写着「现预计于六点到站」。

examples.en: I heard "Now expected at nine" and sent my friend a message.
examples.zh: 我听到「现预计于九点到站」，就给朋友发了条消息。

collocations: now expected at the station at noon
mark a train as now expected at seven

words.enDefinition: a plate attached to a vehicle showing its official identification number or combination

examples.en: I checked the number plate to make sure I had found the correct car.
examples.zh: 我看了看「车牌」，确定自己找的是那辆车。

examples.en: The parking machine asked me to enter the number plate from my rental.
examples.zh: 停车缴费机让我输入租来那辆车的「车牌」信息。

words.enDefinition: a platform high above the ground for looking at the view

examples.en: We went up to the observation deck to see the city just before sunset.
examples.zh: 我们赶在日落前登上「高处观景台」看城市风景。

examples.en: The observation deck was quieter in the morning, and we stayed there for several minutes.
examples.zh: 早上「高处观景台」人少些，我们在那里停留了几分钟。

collocations: go up to the observation deck
the view from an observation deck

words.enDefinition: the total distance shown on a vehicle's distance counter at a particular time

examples.en: The desk recorded the odometer reading before handing the keys to us.
examples.zh: 柜台把钥匙交给我们前，记录了「里程表读数」。

examples.en: I checked the odometer reading against the number printed on the vehicle report.
examples.zh: 我把「里程表读数」和车辆记录上印的数字做了核对。

words.enDefinition: a rental branch located outside an airport's main premises

examples.en: The booking confirmation gave directions to the off-airport rental location near our hotel.
examples.zh: 预约确认单说明了怎么去酒店附近的「机场外租车点」。

examples.en: We took a local bus to the off-airport rental location on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六我们坐当地公交去「机场外租车点」。

collocations: pickup at an off-airport rental location

words.enDefinition: a fare charged for travel outside an operator's designated busy times

examples.en: The app showed an off-peak fare beside the price for the earlier departure.
examples.zh: 应用在较早班次价格旁列出了「非高峰时段车费」。

examples.en: I asked which time the off-peak fare started in the local fare guide.
examples.zh: 我问当地车费指南规定「非高峰时段车费」从何时开始。

words.enDefinition: transport service running outside an operator's busiest scheduled times

examples.en: The off-peak service took longer because it stopped at more local stations.
examples.zh: 「非高峰时段运营」下要多停几个小站，所以用时更长。

examples.en: I looked at the off-peak service before planning a trip after class.
examples.zh: 安排下课后出行之前，我查了「非高峰时段运营」。

words.enDefinition: A British rail fare for travel at specified quieter times

examples.en: I asked where to read the timing restrictions on my Off-Peak ticket.
examples.zh: 我问在哪里可以查看「英国非高峰票」的时段限制。

examples.en: The British rail website displayed an Off-Peak ticket for our planned journey.
examples.zh: 英国铁路网站显示，我们计划的行程有「英国非高峰票」。

collocations: an Off-Peak ticket for the return journey

words.enDefinition: parking in a lot, garage or other space away from the public roadway

examples.en: We looked for off-street parking near the hostel before checking in that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上办入住前，我们在旅舍附近找了个「非路边停车」的地方。

examples.en: The guest information listed off-street parking behind the building near the garden.
examples.zh: 住客信息标明，大楼后面花园附近可以「非路边停车」。

words.enDefinition: A map available without an internet connection

examples.en: I saved an offline map before leaving the flat for our afternoon walk.
examples.zh: 下午出门散步前，我保存了一份「离线地图」。

examples.en: The offline map still showed the streets near my friend's new place.
examples.zh: 「离线地图」仍然显示了朋友新住处附近的街道。

words.enDefinition: a ticket sales office located at the place being visited

examples.en: The on-site ticket office was just past the sign for the garden entrance.
examples.zh: 「景点现场售票处」就在花园入口的牌子再往前一点。

examples.en: I asked at the on-site ticket office whether a morning slot was available.
examples.zh: 我在「景点现场售票处」问有没有上午的参观时段。

collocations: buy tickets at the on-site ticket office
ask at the on-site ticket office

words.enDefinition: at a place commonly visited by tourists following familiar routes

examples.en: The old bridge is on the tourist trail, so it gets busy before noon.
examples.zh: 这座旧桥「在热门游客路线上」，中午前就挺热闹。

examples.en: We stayed on the tourist trail that morning because we wanted to see the main sights.
examples.zh: 上午我们沿着「热门游客路线」走，因为想看看主要景点。

collocations: a town on the tourist trail
a stop on the tourist trail
well known on the tourist trail

words.enDefinition: an extra charge for returning a rented vehicle to a different location

examples.en: The quote listed a one-way drop-off fee because we were returning the car elsewhere.
examples.zh: 因为我们要去别处还车，报价列了一笔「异地还车附加费」。

examples.en: I checked whether the one-way drop-off fee was included in the advertised price.
examples.zh: 我确认了广告价格是否包含「异地还车附加费」。

words.enDefinition: a rental that lets the customer collect a car in one place and return it elsewhere

examples.en: We chose a one-way rental because our train home left from another city.
examples.zh: 我们回家坐的火车从另一座城市发车，所以选择了「异地还车租赁」。

examples.en: The website showed which branches could accept the car from a one-way rental.
examples.zh: 网站显示，哪些门店能接收「异地还车租赁」的车辆。

words.enDefinition: a notice saying bookings can only be made online

examples.en: The tour page said 'Online booking only,' so I opened it on my phone.
examples.zh: 导览页面写着「仅限在线预订」，我就在手机上打开了。

examples.en: A sign at the entrance said 'Online booking only' for that morning's garden visits.
examples.zh: 入口处的牌子说，当天上午的花园参观「仅限在线预订」。

collocations: a sign saying online booking only
list a visit as online booking only

words.enDefinition: Checking in for a flight over the internet

examples.en: I completed online check-in from my laptop before leaving the student residence.
examples.zh: 离开学生宿舍之前，我用笔记本办好了「网上值机」。

examples.en: The email said online check-in was available for this flight on the airline's website.
examples.zh: 邮件说这趟航班可以在航空公司的网站上办理「网上值机」。

words.enDefinition: The next part of a trip after arriving somewhere

examples.en: I arranged onward travel after the train arrival time changed.
examples.zh: 列车的到站时间变了之后，我安排了「后续行程」。

examples.en: The notice gave a separate phone number for onward travel questions.
examples.zh: 通知为咨询「后续行程」单独列了一个电话号码。

words.enDefinition: allowing visitors to enter on days designated as bank holidays

examples.en: At the UK visitor centre, I asked whether the gardens were open on bank holidays.
examples.zh: 在英国的游客中心，我问花园「公共假日也开放」吗。

examples.en: The leaflet says the tower is open on bank holidays with a different tour schedule.
examples.zh: 宣传单说塔楼在「英国公共假日也开放」，但导览时间不同。

collocations: ask whether it is open on bank holidays

words.zhGloss: 不指定返程班次的往返票
words.enDefinition: A return fare that leaves the exact return service unspecified
acceptedZhAnswers: 不指定返程班次的往返票

examples.en: I chose an open return because I hadn't decided when to leave.
examples.zh: 我还没决定哪趟车回来，所以买了「不指定返程班次的往返票」。

examples.en: The agent pointed out the dates printed on my open return.
examples.zh: 售票员指出了「不指定返程班次的往返票」上印的日期。

collocations: check the dates on an open return

words.enDefinition: the days on which visitors can enter a place

examples.en: I checked the opening days after deciding to visit the house during our break.
examples.zh: 决定假期去参观老宅后，我查了「开放日期」。

examples.en: The leaflet listed different opening days for the garden and the outdoor market nearby.
examples.zh: 宣传单分别列出了花园和附近露天市场的「开放日期」。

words.enDefinition: The airline that runs a particular flight

examples.en: The operating carrier was listed in small print below the flight in my email.
examples.zh: 邮件在航班下方用小字标出了「实际承运航司」。

examples.en: I checked which operating carrier was named before looking for the check-in area.
examples.zh: 找值机区前，我先查看了列出的「实际承运航司」是哪家。

collocations: the operating carrier of a flight

words.enDefinition: circumstances connected with running the airline's service

examples.en: The announcement said the flight was delayed for operational reasons and gave no further details.
examples.zh: 广播说航班「因运营原因」延误，没给更多细节。

examples.en: The airline cited operational reasons when it moved our departure to the next morning.
examples.zh: 航空公司把出发改到次日早上，说是因为「航班运营原因」。

words.enDefinition: following the same route on the way there and back

examples.en: We chose an out-and-back walk along the river so we could turn around whenever needed.
examples.zh: 我们选了沿河「原路往返的」散步路线，想什么时候折返都行。

examples.en: The out-and-back route gave us another chance to see the old houses in afternoon light.
examples.zh: 这条「原路往返的」路线让我们回程还能看看午后阳光里的老房子。

words.enDefinition: not currently available for passengers to board or travel on

examples.en: The display said “out of service” when the empty bus passed us.
examples.zh: 空车经过时，显示屏写着「停止载客服务」。

examples.en: I missed the earlier bus because two vehicles on that route were out of service.
examples.zh: 那条线路上两辆车都「停止载客服务」，我没赶上前一班车。

collocations: mark a bus out of service
take a vehicle out of service
a bus that is out of service

words.enDefinition: the part of a trip travelling towards the destination

examples.en: I booked the outbound leg first because our field trip had a fixed start date.
examples.zh: 实地考察的开始日期已经定了，所以我先订了「去程」。

examples.en: The outbound leg took us through a different airport from the journey home afterwards.
examples.zh: 「去程」途经的机场和后来回家的路上不一样。

collocations: the outbound leg of a journey

words.enDefinition: a service travelling away from a designated centre or starting terminal

examples.en: I took an outbound service from the city centre to the student residence.
examples.zh: 我从市中心坐「向外开的班次」去学生公寓。

examples.en: The app showed a delay on the outbound service beside the station map.
examples.zh: 应用在车站地图旁显示，有一趟「从中心向外的班次」晚点了。

words.enDefinition: Beyond the area covered by the rental service

examples.en: The map showed my friend's building was outside the service area for these bikes.
examples.zh: 地图显示朋友住的楼「在这批共享单车的服务范围之外」。

examples.en: I saw “Outside the service area” when I tapped the street beside the museum.
examples.zh: 我点击博物馆旁那条街时，看到「超出服务范围」的提示。

collocations: a destination outside the service area
a location outside the service area

words.enDefinition: The first part of a trip from home to a destination

examples.en: I booked the outward journey after confirming the time of my lecture.
examples.zh: 确认上课时间后，我订了「去程」。

examples.en: The email listed the outward journey before the return details.
examples.zh: 邮件先列出「去程」，然后才是返程详情。

words.enDefinition: a flight with more bookings than seats available

examples.en: The agent said it was an overbooked flight and asked us to wait nearby.
examples.zh: 工作人员说这是「超售的航班」，请我们在附近等待。

examples.en: I heard about the overbooked flight when the airline made an announcement at the gate.
examples.zh: 航空公司在登机口广播时，我才知道那是「超售的航班」。

collocations: an announcement about an overbooked flight

words.enDefinition: A shelf above passenger seats for storing small bags

examples.en: I found space on the overhead luggage rack for my small bag.
examples.zh: 我在「头顶行李架」上找到了能放小包的地方。

examples.en: The overhead luggage rack was already full when we boarded the train.
examples.zh: 我们上火车时，「头顶行李架」已经放满了。

collocations: put a bag on the overhead luggage rack
room in the overhead luggage rack

words.enDefinition: a wait between flights that lasts overnight

examples.en: I had an overnight layover and booked a small room near the airport.
examples.zh: 我的「转机等候要过夜」，就在机场附近订了一间小房间。

examples.en: We packed snacks for the overnight layover because the next flight left early in the morning.
examples.zh: 下一趟航班清早出发，所以我们给「过夜转机等候」准备了零食。

words.enDefinition: a trip that includes a night away from home

examples.en: We turned the visit into an overnight trip so we could see the town after dark.
examples.zh: 为了看看天黑后的小镇，我们把这趟参观改成了「在外过夜的旅行」。

examples.en: I took just one bag for the overnight trip with my project group.
examples.zh: 我和项目组一起「在外过夜旅行」，只带了一个包。

words.enDefinition: a driving licence issued in a country other than the one currently being discussed

examples.en: The rental desk asked which country had issued my overseas driving licence.
examples.zh: 租车柜台问我的「境外签发的驾驶执照」是哪个国家发的。

examples.en: I brought my overseas driving licence to the appointment at the transport office.
examples.zh: 我带着「境外签发的驾驶执照」去交通办事处赴约。

collocations: drive on an overseas driving licence

words.enDefinition: A counter that accepts unusually large checked baggage

examples.en: The agent asked me to take the case to the oversize baggage desk.
examples.zh: 工作人员请我把箱子带到「超尺寸行李柜台」。

examples.en: We waited by the oversize baggage desk while a friend fetched the equipment case.
examples.zh: 朋友去拿器材箱时，我们在「超尺寸行李柜台」旁边等。

collocations: go to the oversize baggage desk
signs for the oversize baggage desk

words.enDefinition: the arrivals location for collecting large checked items

examples.en: My instrument case came out at oversized baggage collection on the far side of arrivals.
examples.zh: 我的乐器盒在到达大厅远端的「超大件行李领取处」出来了。

examples.en: I asked where oversized baggage collection was because my suitcase had already appeared on the belt.
examples.zh: 我的箱子已经上了转盘，我就问「超大件行李领取处」在哪儿。

collocations: the sign for oversized baggage collection

words.enDefinition: Bags or items larger than the operator's ordinary luggage limits

examples.en: My friend asked whether her instrument case counted as oversized luggage.
examples.zh: 朋友问她的乐器盒算不算「超尺寸行李」。

examples.en: The coach operator listed oversized luggage separately in its luggage guide.
examples.zh: 长途大巴运营方在行李指南里单独列出了「超尺寸行李」。

words.enDefinition: Baggage heavier than the accepted weight limit

examples.en: The agent told me which counter dealt with overweight baggage at this airport.
examples.zh: 工作人员告诉我，这座机场哪个柜台办理「超重行李」。

examples.en: My email showed the airline's charge for overweight baggage under the other fees.
examples.zh: 我的邮件在其他费用下方列出了航司的「超重行李」收费。

words.enDefinition: take only a small amount of luggage on a trip

examples.en: I tried to pack light because we would carry our bags all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们整个下午都要背着包，我就尽量「轻装出行」。

examples.en: We can pack light for this outing and leave the larger bags at home.
examples.zh: 这次出游可以「轻装出行」，大一点的包留在家里。

words.enDefinition: a trip plan with many activities and little spare time

examples.en: We had a packed itinerary on Saturday, so we kept Sunday free for resting.
examples.zh: 周六「行程排得很满」，所以我们留出周日休息。

examples.en: With a packed itinerary, we only spent a few minutes in each room.
examples.zh: 由于「行程排得很满」，我们在每个房间只停了几分钟。

collocations: a packed itinerary for one day

words.enDefinition: A small fabric case for organizing suitcase contents

examples.en: I put my socks in a packing cube to keep the suitcase organized.
examples.zh: 我把袜子放进「行李分装袋」，让行李箱里更整齐。

examples.en: My packing cube was easy to find when I opened the suitcase at check-in.
examples.zh: 值机时我打开行李箱，很容易就找到了「行李分装袋」。

words.enDefinition: a small area where a piece of the vehicle's paint has come off

examples.en: I showed the clerk the paint chip beside the rear passenger door.
examples.zh: 我给柜台人员看了后排乘客车门旁一处「小块车漆剥落」。

examples.en: The paint chip was marked on the condition report as an existing defect.
examples.zh: 这处「小块车漆剥落」在车况记录上标成了原有瑕疵。

words.enDefinition: a wide view covering much of the surrounding area

examples.en: The hill gave us a panoramic view of the harbour and the surrounding streets.
examples.zh: 在山丘上，我们看到了港口和周边街道「开阔的全景」。

examples.en: I stayed longer for the panoramic view once the clouds began to move away.
examples.zh: 云开始散开后，我留下来多看了一会儿这片「开阔的全景」。

collocations: a panoramic view of the city

words.enDefinition: A boarding pass printed or issued on paper

examples.en: I kept the paper boarding pass in the front pocket of my backpack.
examples.zh: 我把「纸质登机牌」放在背包前袋里。

examples.en: The agent printed a paper boarding pass when my phone ran out of power.
examples.zh: 我的手机没电后，工作人员给我打印了一张「纸质登机牌」。

words.enDefinition: a printed ticket that can be shown or used for a journey

examples.en: I bought a paper ticket because my phone had run out of power.
examples.zh: 手机没电了，我买了一张「纸质车票」。

examples.en: The station machine printed a paper ticket and a separate payment receipt.
examples.zh: 车站机器打出一张「纸质车票」和一张单独的付款收据。

collocations: show a paper ticket at the gate

words.enDefinition: a physical arm or gate controlling vehicle entry or exit at a parking site

examples.en: The parking barrier lifted when the machine recognized our ticket at the exit.
examples.zh: 出口机器识别停车票后，「停车场闸杆」抬了起来。

examples.en: We waited for the parking barrier while the attendant checked the registration number.
examples.zh: 管理员核对车牌号时，我们在「停车场闸杆」前等候。

collocations: a parking barrier at the exit

words.enDefinition: a brake used to keep a parked vehicle from moving

examples.en: The instructor showed me where the parking brake switch was on this car.
examples.zh: 教练指给我看，这辆车上的「驻车制动器」开关在哪里。

examples.en: The rental had a button for the parking brake near the gear selector.
examples.zh: 租来的车在挡位选择器附近有个「驻车制动器」按钮。

words.enDefinition: a small display set to show when a vehicle arrived in a timed parking space

examples.en: The visitor guide showed a parking disc in its example of short-stay parking.
examples.zh: 游客指南在短时停车的例子里展示了一个「停车时间盘」。

examples.en: I asked what time to set on the parking disc shown in the guide.
examples.zh: 我问指南图示里的「停车时间盘」应该设置成什么时间。

collocations: a parking disc in the windshield

words.enDefinition: a document or record allowing a person or vehicle to park under stated conditions

examples.en: I applied for a parking permit after moving into the new student residence.
examples.zh: 搬进新的学生公寓后，我申请了「停车许可证」。

examples.en: The map showed which lots accepted the parking permit connected with my account.
examples.zh: 地图标出了哪些停车场认可我账号里的「停车许可证」。

words.enDefinition: a rule limiting where, when or under what conditions a vehicle may park

examples.en: I checked the parking restriction printed below the main sign near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我查了入口附近主标识下方印的「停车限制」。

examples.en: The map explained which parking restriction applied during the street festival that weekend.
examples.zh: 地图说明，那周末街头节庆期间会实行哪种「停车限制」。

words.enDefinition: a published schedule of charges for parking

examples.en: The parking tariff was printed near the upper corner of the sign.
examples.zh: 「停车收费标准」印在标识上角附近。

examples.en: I compared the parking tariff for weekdays with the rates shown for Sundays.
examples.zh: 我比较了工作日的「停车收费标准」和周日列出的价格。

words.enDefinition: an official notice imposing or recording a charge for a parking violation

examples.en: I asked which restriction the parking ticket referred to on that street.
examples.zh: 我问「停车违章罚单」指的是那条街上的哪项限制。

examples.en: The rental office sent me a copy of the parking ticket with its invoice.
examples.zh: 租车办公室把「停车违章罚单」副本连同账单发给了我。

words.enDefinition: confirmation from a business or venue that reduces or covers a customer's parking charge

examples.en: The café offered parking validation for visitors who used the nearby garage.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆给使用附近停车楼的顾客办理「停车费减免确认」。

examples.en: I asked at reception whether the student event included parking validation for guests.
examples.zh: 我在接待处问，学生活动有没有给来宾提供「停车费减免确认」。

words.enDefinition: Words addressing travelers headed to a certain destination

examples.en: The announcement began "Passengers for Riverside" before naming another platform.
examples.zh: 广播先说「前往河畔站的乘客」，然后报了另一个站台。

examples.en: I heard "Passengers for Central" and listened for the platform number.
examples.zh: 听到「前往中央站的乘客」后，我接着听广播报哪个站台。

words.enDefinition: An inspection of a passenger's passport

examples.en: The airline arranged a passport check at the counter for passengers on this flight.
examples.zh: 航空公司安排这趟航班的乘客在柜台接受「护照核对」。

examples.en: I put my passport away when the agent finished the passport check at the desk.
examples.zh: 工作人员在柜台完成「护照核对」后，我把护照收了起来。

collocations: a passport check at the counter

words.enDefinition: A point where two or more paths meet

examples.en: I saw the yellow route marker at the path junction beside the pond.
examples.zh: 我在池塘旁的「小路交汇处」看到了黄色路线标记。

examples.en: We agreed to meet at the path junction near the old stone wall.
examples.zh: 我们约在旧石墙旁的「小路交汇处」碰面。

words.enDefinition: a parking system where drivers pay and display a ticket in the vehicle

examples.en: The small UK car park used pay-and-display instead of a barrier at the exit.
examples.zh: 这个英国小停车场实行「缴费后展示票据」，出口没有闸杆。

examples.en: I asked the attendant which sign explained the pay-and-display system beside the library.
examples.zh: 我问管理员，图书馆旁哪块牌子介绍了「缴费后展示票据」的制度。

words.enDefinition: To pay the booking amount at the accommodation itself

examples.en: The confirmation said we would pay at the property after showing our booking.
examples.zh: 确认信息说，出示订单后我们要「到住宿地点付款」。

examples.en: I chose to pay at the property because my friend was handling the booking.
examples.zh: 朋友负责订房，我选择「到住宿地点付款」。

collocations: choose to pay at the property
prefer to pay at the property
an option to pay at the property

words.zhGloss: 按车牌号计收的通行费
words.enDefinition: an electronic toll linked to the vehicle's registration plate
acceptedZhAnswers: 按车牌号计收的通行费

examples.en: The notice described a pay-by-plate toll for vehicles without a transponder.
examples.zh: 通知说明，没有感应装置的车辆走的是「按车牌号计收的通行费」的方式。

examples.en: I asked where the pay-by-plate toll was recorded on our rental invoice.
examples.zh: 我问租车账单上的哪一项是「按车牌号计收的通行费」。

collocations: an invoice for a pay-by-plate toll

words.enDefinition: a fare charged for travel during designated busier times

examples.en: The machine showed a peak fare for the time I had selected.
examples.zh: 售票机为我选的时段显示了「高峰时段车费」。

examples.en: I checked whether the price on my trip history was a peak fare.
examples.zh: 我核对了乘车记录上的价格是不是「高峰时段车费」。

words.enDefinition: transport service scheduled for the busiest times of day

examples.en: The peak service stopped outside the library while other buses bypassed campus.
examples.zh: 「高峰时段运营」里，车停图书馆门口，其他公交则绕过学校。

examples.en: The leaflet showed how the peak service differed from the midday timetable.
examples.zh: 宣传单显示，「高峰时段运营」与中午的时刻表有什么不同。

words.enDefinition: A bicycle whose motor assists when you pedal

examples.en: The app marked each pedal-assist bike with a different symbol on the map.
examples.zh: 应用用不同的符号在地图上标出每辆「脚踏助力自行车」。

examples.en: I asked which station had a pedal-assist bike available for our afternoon trip.
examples.zh: 我问哪个站有「脚踏助力自行车」可用，方便我们下午出门。

words.enDefinition: Access to a place for people on foot

examples.en: The garden map showed pedestrian access beside the main gate near our flat.
examples.zh: 花园地图标出了我住处附近大门旁的「行人通道」。

examples.en: I asked whether there was pedestrian access from the park into the courtyard.
examples.zh: 我问从公园到院子有没有「行人通道」。

words.enDefinition: A timer on a pedestrian signal showing time remaining

examples.en: The pedestrian countdown was displayed underneath the walking figure on the sign.
examples.zh: 「行人过街信号倒计时」显示在牌子的行走小人下方。

examples.en: The orientation leaflet showed a pedestrian countdown beside a diagram of the junction.
examples.zh: 迎新宣传页在路口示意图旁展示了「行人过街信号倒计时」。

collocations: a crossing with a pedestrian countdown

words.enDefinition: A button used to request a crossing signal

examples.en: The pedestrian crossing button was on a post beside the corner flowerbed.
examples.zh: 「行人过街按钮」在拐角花坛旁的一根柱子上。

examples.en: I asked what the light beside the pedestrian crossing button meant in that diagram.
examples.zh: 我问示意图中「行人过街按钮」旁边的灯表示什么。

collocations: a pedestrian crossing button on a post
the light beside the pedestrian crossing button

words.enDefinition: A replacement route for people on foot

examples.en: The notice showed a pedestrian diversion around the construction site beside the park.
examples.zh: 告示在公园旁的施工区周围标出了一条「行人绕行路线」。

examples.en: I checked where the pedestrian diversion ended before leaving to meet my roommate.
examples.zh: 出发见室友前，我查了「行人绕行路线」在哪里结束。

words.enDefinition: A street set aside for people walking

examples.en: The market stalls were set up along a pedestrian-only street behind the gallery.
examples.zh: 摊位摆在美术馆后面一条「仅供行人通行的街道」上。

examples.en: One side of the square opened onto a pedestrian-only street with several cafés.
examples.zh: 广场的一侧通向一条有几家咖啡馆的「行人专用街道」。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement that gives people on foot precedence

examples.en: The town map marked pedestrian priority in the square beside the public library.
examples.zh: 镇上的地图把公共图书馆旁的广场标为「行人优先」。

examples.en: A sign at the entrance explained the pedestrian priority area around the market.
examples.zh: 入口处的牌子说明了市场周围的「行人优先」区。

words.enDefinition: A raised space between lanes for people crossing

examples.en: The photograph showed a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the wide road.
examples.zh: 照片显示，宽阔的道路中间有一处「行人过街安全岛」。

examples.en: I saw the pedestrian refuge island marked on the accessibility map outside the hall.
examples.zh: 我在大厅外的无障碍地图上看到了「行人过街安全岛」的标记。

collocations: a pedestrian refuge island in the road

words.enDefinition: A traffic signal intended for people walking

examples.en: We waited beside the pedestrian signal while my classmate checked the meeting address.
examples.zh: 同学核对碰面地址时，我们在「行人过街信号灯」旁等。

examples.en: The diagram showed the pedestrian signal on the opposite side of the road.
examples.zh: 示意图标出了马路对面的「行人过街信号灯」。

collocations: a pedestrian signal at a crossing

words.enDefinition: parking available only to vehicles covered by the required permit

examples.en: The sign at the back of the residence said permit-only parking.
examples.zh: 学生公寓后面的牌子写着「仅限持证停车」。

examples.en: The visitor map shaded permit-only parking differently from public parking near the library.
examples.zh: 访客地图用不同底色区分了「仅限持证停车」和图书馆附近的公共停车。

words.zhGloss: 小件随身物品（登机行李）
words.enDefinition: A small bag counted separately from regular cabin baggage
acceptedZhAnswers: 小件随身物品（登机行李）

examples.en: The booking showed a personal item on its own line under baggage.
examples.zh: 预订信息在行李一栏里单列了「小件随身物品」。

examples.en: I asked whether this little laptop bag counted as a personal item.
examples.zh: 我问这个小电脑包能不能算作「小件随身物品」。

words.enDefinition: An identity document that displays the holder's photograph

examples.en: The airline message said to have a photo ID ready at the counter.
examples.zh: 航空公司的消息说，到柜台时要备好「带照片的身份证明」。

examples.en: I checked that my photo ID was in the same pouch as my ticket.
examples.zh: 我确认「带照片的身份证明」和机票放在同一个袋子里。

words.enDefinition: a brief pause during a trip to take pictures

examples.en: We made a photo stop by the old bridge while the light was still good.
examples.zh: 趁光线还好，我们在旧桥旁「停留拍了会儿照」。

examples.en: The guide allowed a photo stop before our group entered the garden through the side gate.
examples.zh: 从侧门进花园之前，导游「留了一段时间给我们拍照」。

words.enDefinition: a place set aside for eating meals outdoors

examples.en: We ate lunch in the picnic area before walking back to look around the market.
examples.zh: 我们在「野餐区」吃午饭，再走回去逛市场。

examples.en: The picnic area near the garden entrance had a few tables under the trees.
examples.zh: 花园入口附近的「野餐区」有几张桌子摆在树下。

words.enDefinition: One separate bag, suitcase or similar item

examples.en: I had one piece of luggage to check and a small backpack to carry.
examples.zh: 我有「一件行李」要托运，还有个小背包随身带。

examples.en: The volunteer counted each piece of luggage before we loaded the airport bus.
examples.zh: 我们把东西搬上机场公交之前，志愿者清点了「每件行李」。

words.enDefinition: Scheduled work on railway infrastructure that may change train services

examples.en: The website showed planned engineering works between two stops on my journey.
examples.zh: 网站上显示，我要经过的两站之间有「计划内铁路施工」。

examples.en: The station put up notices about planned engineering works for the weekend.
examples.zh: 车站张贴了周末「计划内铁路施工」的通知。

collocations: planned engineering works on the line
a notice about planned engineering works
timetable changes for planned engineering works

words.enDefinition: a scheduled interruption or restriction, often for maintenance, announced in advance

examples.en: The operator posted a planned service disruption for the weekend road repairs.
examples.zh: 运营商发布了周末修路期间「预先公布的运营中断」。

examples.en: I checked whether the planned service disruption would affect the bus to campus.
examples.zh: 我查了这次「预先公布的运营中断」会不会影响去学校的公交。

collocations: check for a planned service disruption

words.enDefinition: An update assigning a train to a platform different from the previous one

examples.en: The board showed a platform change just as we reached the stairs.
examples.zh: 我们刚到楼梯边，显示屏就显示了「站台变更」。

examples.en: I told my roommate about the platform change before she left the café.
examples.zh: 室友离开咖啡馆前，我把「站台变更」的消息告诉了她。

collocations: a notice about a platform change

words.enDefinition: One of the far ends of a railway platform

examples.en: We walked toward the platform end before the train pulled in.
examples.zh: 列车进站前，我们走向了「站台端头」。

examples.en: The platform end nearest our carriage had a long row of seats.
examples.zh: 离我们车厢最近的「站台端头」有一长排座位。

collocations: a sign at the platform end

words.enDefinition: A number identifying the station platform assigned to a service

examples.en: The platform number appeared on our screen while we were buying coffee.
examples.zh: 我们买咖啡时，屏幕上显示了「站台编号」。

examples.en: I repeated the platform number to my friend over the phone.
examples.zh: 我在电话里把「站台编号」又跟朋友说了一遍。

words.enDefinition: A polite request to open a bag

examples.en: The officer said, “Please open your bag,” and pointed to the suitcase beside me.
examples.zh: 安检员说：「请打开您的包」，同时指了指我身旁的行李箱。

examples.en: I heard “Please open your bag” and asked the officer which bag she meant.
examples.zh: 我听到「请打开您的包」，就问安检员说的是哪一件。

words.enDefinition: a car-sharing model that allows pickup and return at different permitted locations

examples.en: I compared point-to-point car share with the return-to-origin option for that errand.
examples.zh: 那次要出门办事，我比较了「异地归还式共享汽车」和原处归还的选项。

examples.en: The service map showed where point-to-point car share pickups and returns were allowed.
examples.zh: 服务地图标明了在哪些地方可以取还「异地归还式共享汽车」。

words.enDefinition: Assistance carrying luggage into or around a hotel

examples.en: I asked whether porter service was available for my friend's group.
examples.zh: 我问能不能给我朋友一行提供「行李搬运服务」。

examples.en: The welcome card listed porter service under the reception information.
examples.zh: 欢迎卡在前台信息下面列出了「行李搬运服务」。

words.enDefinition: a test assessing a person's ability to control a vehicle and drive safely in practice

examples.en: I booked my practical driving test for the morning after lectures ended.
examples.zh: 我把「实际驾驶考试」约在课程结束后的一天上午。

examples.en: The driving school helped me find the address for my practical driving test.
examples.zh: 驾校帮我找到了「实际驾驶考试」的地址。

words.zhGloss: 常规分组前的登机安排
words.enDefinition: Boarding offered before the regular groups are called
acceptedZhAnswers: 常规分组前的登机安排

examples.en: The agent made a preboarding announcement before calling the first regular group.
examples.zh: 工作人员在叫第一批常规登机组之前，播报了「常规分组前的登机安排」。

examples.en: My friend asked about preboarding when she arranged assistance with the airline.
examples.zh: 朋友向航空公司安排协助服务时，询问了「常规分组前的登机安排」。

words.enDefinition: Baggage paid for in advance of drop-off

examples.en: I showed the email confirming prepaid baggage when I reached the airline counter.
examples.zh: 到航空公司柜台时，我出示了确认「行李费用已预付」的邮件。

examples.en: The app showed prepaid baggage below the names of the people on the booking.
examples.zh: 应用在预订乘客姓名下方显示了「已预付费用的行李」。

words.enDefinition: A reservation paid for before arriving at the accommodation

examples.en: The receptionist looked up my prepaid booking when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到了以后，前台人员查了我的「预付房费的预订」。

examples.en: I kept the confirmation showing the dates of my prepaid booking.
examples.zh: 我留着确认信息，上面写着「预付房费的预订」的日期。

words.enDefinition: an option to pay in advance for fuel supplied with a rented vehicle

examples.en: The agent offered prepaid fuel when we collected the car near the station.
examples.zh: 我们在车站附近取车时，代理提出可选「预付燃油」。

examples.en: I asked which amount on the quote was for the prepaid fuel option.
examples.zh: 我问报价上哪项是「预付燃油」选项的金额。

words.enDefinition: A travel document provided electronically for someone to print themselves

examples.en: I found the print-at-home ticket attached to the email from the operator.
examples.zh: 我在运营方发来的邮件附件中找到了「自行打印的车票」。

examples.en: My flatmate looked for the print-at-home ticket before we went to the station.
examples.zh: 我们去车站前，室友找了一下「自行打印的车票」。

words.enDefinition: The option to board before some other passengers

examples.en: The app showed whether priority boarding was included with the fare I had chosen.
examples.zh: 应用显示了我选的票价类型是否包含「优先登机」。

examples.en: I asked at the counter where the priority boarding line would start.
examples.zh: 我在柜台问「优先登机」的队伍从哪里开始排。

words.enDefinition: a seat reserved or marked for passengers who may need it more

examples.en: I moved my bag off the priority seat when more passengers boarded.
examples.zh: 更多乘客上车时，我把包从「优先座位」上挪开。

examples.en: The priority seat had a bright blue sign above it near the door.
examples.zh: 靠门的「优先座位」上方有块亮蓝色的牌子。

words.enDefinition: a tour provided exclusively for one visitor or group

examples.en: Our society arranged a private tour so members could focus on the workshop buildings.
examples.zh: 我们社团安排了「专为一组安排的导览」，让成员能重点看那些工坊建筑。

examples.en: I asked about a private tour before deciding to join the larger group instead.
examples.zh: 我先问了「专为一组安排的导览」，后来决定参加人数更多的团。

collocations: a private tour for our group

words.enDefinition: An instruction asking passengers to go to the gate

examples.en: The announcement said we could proceed to the gate after the screen was updated.
examples.zh: 广播说，屏幕更新后我们可以「前往登机口」。

examples.en: I heard “Proceed to the gate” and checked which flight the announcement named.
examples.zh: 我听到「请前往登机口」，就确认了一下广播里说的是哪个航班。

collocations: ask passengers to proceed to the gate
proceed to the gate for boarding
a notice saying “Proceed to the gate”

words.enDefinition: A wide public walkway often beside water

examples.en: We walked along the promenade before meeting our classmates at the exhibition.
examples.zh: 去展览上和同学碰面前，我们沿「滨水散步道」走了走。

examples.en: The café had a small door opening directly onto the promenade.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆有扇小门，可以直接走上「滨水散步道」。

words.enDefinition: A record showing that someone stayed at an accommodation

examples.en: Our department asked for proof of stay after the conference trip.
examples.zh: 我们开完会回来后，院系要求提供「住宿证明」。

examples.en: The front desk printed my proof of stay before I left.
examples.zh: 我离开前，前台打印了我的「住宿证明」。

collocations: a letter serving as proof of stay

words.enDefinition: an airline report recording luggage that is missing, delayed, or damaged

examples.en: I received a property irregularity report after explaining that my suitcase never reached the carousel.
examples.zh: 我说了自己的箱子始终没出现在转盘上，随后收到了一份「行李异常报告」。

examples.en: The agent checked my property irregularity report before updating the address on the baggage record.
examples.zh: 工作人员先查看了我的「行李异常报告」，再更新行李记录上的地址。

collocations: the reference on a property irregularity report

words.zhGloss: 有隔离设施的自行车道
words.enDefinition: A bike lane physically separated from motor traffic
acceptedZhAnswers: 有隔离设施的自行车道

examples.en: The protected bike lane was easy to spot beside the low concrete barrier.
examples.zh: 矮混凝土隔离栏旁的「有隔离设施的自行车道」很容易认出来。

examples.en: The map marked a protected bike lane along the road beside our campus.
examples.zh: 地图标出了我校旁边那条路上的「有隔离设施的自行车道」。

collocations: a protected bike lane along a road

words.enDefinition: local passenger services available to the public, such as buses and urban trains

examples.en: I started using public transit when I moved into a flat near campus.
examples.zh: 搬进学校附近的公寓后，我开始坐「公共交通」。

examples.en: The city added a public transit route that stops outside the new library.
examples.zh: 市里新增了一条经过新图书馆门口的「公共交通」线路。
