words.enDefinition: A request to add a purchase to one's hotel account

examples.en: I asked the server whether they could put it on my room after dinner.
examples.zh: 吃完晚饭，我问餐厅能不能「记到我的客房账上」。

examples.en: At the hotel café, I asked, "Could you put it on my room for now?"
examples.zh: 在酒店咖啡馆，我问店员能不能先把费用「记到我的客房账上」。

collocations: ask to put it on my room
say "Could you put it on my room?"
ask "Can you put it on my room?"

words.enDefinition: a ticket whose QR code can be scanned to confirm the passenger's right to travel

examples.en: I held the QR code ticket under the scanner at the tram stop.
examples.zh: 我在电车站把「二维码车票」放到扫描器下。

examples.en: The app asked me to open the QR code ticket before reaching the platform.
examples.zh: 应用提示我，在到站台之前打开「二维码车票」。

words.enDefinition: A guest room furnished with at least one queen-size bed

examples.en: The booking page showed a queen room beside the twin option.
examples.zh: 预订页面把「大号床客房」和双床客房选项并排列出。

examples.en: My queen room had enough space for a desk near the door.
examples.zh: 我的「大号床客房」够宽敞，门边还放得下一张书桌。

collocations: a queen room on the upper floor

words.enDefinition: stand in line while waiting to enter a place

examples.en: We had to queue for entry even though we already had our tickets.
examples.zh: 虽然已经有票，我们还是得「为入场排队」。

examples.en: The guide told us where to queue for entry before handing out the maps.
examples.zh: 发地图前，导游告诉我们在哪儿「为入场排队」。

collocations: queue for entry at the gate

words.enDefinition: A train carriage designated for passengers to keep noise low

examples.en: I checked the map to find the quiet carriage before boarding.
examples.zh: 上车前，我看了下图，找到「安静车厢」的位置。

examples.en: The quiet carriage was at the rear of the train today.
examples.zh: 今天「安静车厢」在列车尾部。

collocations: a seat in the quiet carriage

words.enDefinition: The amount charged for a journey by passenger train

examples.en: We compared the rail fare with the cost of taking the coach.
examples.zh: 我们把「铁路票价」和坐长途大巴的费用作了比较。

examples.en: The operator displayed each rail fare beside the departure time.
examples.zh: 运营方在出发时间旁标出了每趟车的「铁路票价」。

words.enDefinition: A staffed station desk answering questions about passenger train services

examples.en: I asked at the rail information desk which train had room for bicycles.
examples.zh: 我在「铁路问讯台」问哪趟列车有地方放自行车。

examples.en: The rail information desk was next to the main doors of the station.
examples.zh: 「铁路问讯台」就在车站正门旁边。

collocations: ask at the rail information desk
directions from the rail information desk

words.enDefinition: A British card linked to discounts on certain railway fares

examples.en: The clerk asked whether my booking included a railcard discount.
examples.zh: 售票员问我的订单有没有使用「英国铁路折扣卡」优惠。

examples.en: I checked the name on my ticket against my railcard.
examples.zh: 我核对了车票姓名是否和「英国铁路折扣卡」上的一致。

words.enDefinition: an alternative activity suitable when the weather is wet

examples.en: We kept the gallery as a rainy-day option in case the garden paths were soaked.
examples.zh: 我们把画廊留作「下雨天的备选安排」，以防花园小路积水。

examples.en: The rainy-day option was a short visit to the town's covered market after lunch.
examples.zh: 「下雨天的备选安排」是午饭后去镇上的室内市场逛一会儿。

collocations: keep a rainy-day option in mind

words.enDefinition: A crossing built higher than the surrounding road

examples.en: The raised crossing outside the hall was nearly level with the footpath.
examples.zh: 大厅外的「抬高式人行横道」和步行小路几乎一样高。

examples.en: I spotted the raised crossing shown on the map beside the garden entrance.
examples.zh: 我看到了地图上标注的「抬高式人行横道」，就在花园入口旁。

collocations: a raised crossing near a building

words.enDefinition: A way to enter or reach somewhere using a ramp

examples.en: I asked whether there was ramp access from the riverside path into the garden.
examples.zh: 我问能不能从河边小路「经坡道通行」进入花园。

examples.en: The map showed ramp access at the entrance facing the university sports hall.
examples.zh: 地图显示，面向学校体育馆的那个入口「可经坡道通行」。

words.enDefinition: the predicted distance a vehicle can travel on its remaining fuel or charge

examples.en: The range estimate on the dashboard changed after we drove up a long hill.
examples.zh: 开过一段长坡后，仪表盘上的「预计续航里程」变了。

examples.en: I checked the range estimate before choosing which parking area to use.
examples.zh: 选择停车区之前，我先看了「预计续航里程」。

words.enDefinition: a notice saying visitors can return after leaving the venue

examples.en: The ticket said 'Re-entry allowed,' so we went outside for lunch between the two visits.
examples.zh: 票上写着「允许再次入场」，所以看完一部分后我们出去吃了午饭。

examples.en: I saw 'Re-entry allowed' on the sign and left to meet my friend briefly.
examples.zh: 我看见牌子写着「允许再次入场」，就出去和朋友碰了个面。

collocations: confirm re-entry allowed at the desk

words.enDefinition: estimated arrival times updated using current information about moving vehicles

examples.en: The app shows real-time arrivals for stops close to the student flats.
examples.zh: 应用会显示学生公寓附近各站的「实时到站信息」。

examples.en: We checked real-time arrivals before deciding whether to walk to campus instead.
examples.zh: 我们先看了「实时到站信息」，再决定要不要改成走去学校。

words.enDefinition: A place with its occupant facing away from the direction of travel

examples.en: The only place near my friend was a rear-facing seat.
examples.zh: 朋友附近唯一的空位是一个「逆向座位」。

examples.en: I spotted a rear-facing seat beside the table on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我在示意图上看到桌旁有一个「逆向座位」。

words.enDefinition: The carriages forming the back section of a passenger train

examples.en: The display showed where the rear portion would stop on the platform.
examples.zh: 显示屏标出了「列车后部」会停在站台的哪个位置。

examples.en: My flatmate asked whether we were in the rear portion of the train.
examples.zh: 室友问我们是不是在「列车后部」。

collocations: the rear portion of the train

words.enDefinition: an interior mirror that gives a driver a view through the back window

examples.en: The rental tag was attached to the rearview mirror when we collected the car.
examples.zh: 我们取车时，租车标签挂在「车内后视镜」上。

examples.en: I adjusted the rearview mirror before leaving the parking space with the instructor.
examples.zh: 和教练一起驶出车位之前，我调整了「车内后视镜」。

words.enDefinition: make a replacement booking when your original flight changes

examples.en: I needed to rebook a flight after the airline cancelled our original departure.
examples.zh: 航空公司取消了我们原定的航班后，我需要「改订另一班飞机」。

examples.en: The agent helped me rebook a flight that would get me home before class.
examples.zh: 工作人员帮我「改订另一班飞机」，这样我能在上课前到家。

words.enDefinition: a confirmation that a changed booking has been made

examples.en: I waited for rebooking confirmation before making any changes to my train ticket home.
examples.zh: 我等收到「改订航班确认通知」后，才改了回家的火车票。

examples.en: The rebooking confirmation showed the new arrival airport below the updated flight number.
examples.zh: 「改订航班确认通知」在新的航班号下方列出了新的到达机场。

words.enDefinition: The times when staff are available at a property's reception desk

examples.en: I checked the reception hours before booking a train that arrived late.
examples.zh: 我查了「前台开放时间」，才选了晚到的火车。

examples.en: The hostel posted its reception hours beside the main entrance.
examples.zh: 旅舍在正门旁贴出了「前台开放时间」。

words.enDefinition: tilt the back of your seat farther back

examples.en: You can recline your seat a little once I've finished writing in my notebook.
examples.zh: 等我在本子上写完，你可以稍微「把座椅靠背向后调」。

examples.en: Would you mind waiting to recline your seat until the meal service is over?
examples.zh: 能等送餐结束后再「把座椅靠背向后调」吗？

collocations: ask if you can recline your seat

words.enDefinition: A seat with a back that can tilt backward

examples.en: The coach ticket listed a reclining seat among the available features.
examples.zh: 长途大巴车票上列出的设施包括「可调靠背座椅」。

examples.en: My flatmate chose a reclining seat near the front of the coach.
examples.zh: 室友选了大巴靠前位置的「可调靠背座椅」。

collocations: a reclining seat on a coach

words.enDefinition: a period or pattern with fewer transport services than normally run

examples.en: The notice warned of reduced service while one platform was being repaired.
examples.zh: 通知提醒，一个站台维修期间将「减班运行」。

examples.en: We left earlier because there would be reduced service over the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期会「减班运行」，所以我们提早出发了。

words.enDefinition: A wheeled cart selling drinks and light food to passengers

examples.en: The refreshment trolley came past us after the train left the city.
examples.zh: 列车离开市区后，「车上茶点推车」从我们身边经过。

examples.en: My friend asked whether the refreshment trolley sold cups of tea.
examples.zh: 朋友问「车上茶点推车」有没有茶卖。

collocations: buy tea from the refreshment trolley

words.enDefinition: a fee charged when the rental company adds fuel after a vehicle is returned

examples.en: The invoice showed a refueling charge below the basic daily rental rate.
examples.zh: 账单在基本日租费率下面列了一笔「补加燃油费」。

examples.en: I asked the agent what the refueling charge covered on my final invoice.
examples.zh: 我问代理，最终账单上的「补加燃油费」包含哪些费用。

words.enDefinition: A passenger train connecting places within a particular region

examples.en: We took a regional train to a town down the coast.
examples.zh: 我们坐「区域列车」去了沿海的一个小镇。

examples.en: The regional train stopped in the town where my friend lives.
examples.zh: 「区域列车」在我朋友住的那个小镇停靠。

words.enDefinition: A person whose name is recorded as staying at a property

examples.en: The hotel emailed the directions to the registered guest named on the booking.
examples.zh: 酒店把路线发给了订单上的「已登记住客」。

examples.en: I checked whether my roommate was listed as a registered guest.
examples.zh: 我核对了室友是不是列为「已登记住客」。

collocations: a registered guest at the hotel

words.enDefinition: a replacement ticket issued after an existing booking is changed

examples.en: I downloaded the reissued ticket so I could check the new dates without internet access.
examples.zh: 我下载了「重新出票后的机票」，这样没网也能查新的日期。

examples.en: The reissued ticket arrived shortly after I agreed to travel the next morning instead.
examples.zh: 我同意改成第二天早上出发后不久，就收到了「重新出票后的机票」。

words.enDefinition: meet up with your group again after being apart

examples.en: I went back to rejoin the group after looking at the upstairs display.
examples.zh: 我看完楼上的展区后，就「回到队伍中」了。

examples.en: We could rejoin the group at the town gate after picking up some lunch.
examples.zh: 买完午饭后，我们可以在城门「回到队伍中」。

words.enDefinition: to add more money or value to a card used for transport fares

examples.en: The kiosk showed me where to reload a transit card before boarding.
examples.zh: 售票亭提示我上车前在哪里「为公交卡充值」。

examples.en: I needed to reload a transit card after seeing a low balance message.
examples.zh: 看到余额偏低的提示后，我得「为公交卡充值」。

collocations: reload a transit card at a kiosk
need to reload a transit card

words.enDefinition: a stop that has been moved to a different place from its former location

examples.en: The notice gave a map of the relocated stop behind the library.
examples.zh: 通知附了地图，标出图书馆后面的「已迁移的停靠站」。

examples.en: I checked whether the relocated stop still served buses heading toward campus.
examples.zh: 我确认了「已迁移的停靠站」是否还停开往学校的公交车。

collocations: a map of the relocated stop

words.enDefinition: stay in your seat without standing up

examples.en: Please remain seated until the aircraft has come to a complete stop at the gate.
examples.zh: 飞机在登机口完全停稳前，「请留在座位上」。

examples.en: The crew asked us to remain seated while a few passengers collected their bags first.
examples.zh: 有几位乘客先取行李时，乘务组请我们「留在座位上」。

words.enDefinition: an aircraft parking position away from the terminal building

examples.en: We parked at a remote stand, and a bus took us to the terminal.
examples.zh: 飞机停在「远机位」，一辆巴士把我们送到航站楼。

examples.en: The plane arrived at a remote stand after the gates near arrivals filled up.
examples.zh: 到达区附近的登机口停满后，飞机停到了一个「远机位」。

collocations: a bus from a remote stand

words.enDefinition: To take an earlier label off a bag

examples.en: The agent asked me to remove an old tag from my suitcase handle.
examples.zh: 工作人员让我从行李箱提手上「取下旧行李标签」。

examples.en: I stopped to remove an old tag before attaching the new one at bag drop.
examples.zh: 在托运处贴上新标签前，我停下来「取下旧行李标签」。

collocations: ask someone to remove an old tag
stop to remove an old tag
remove an old tag from a suitcase

words.enDefinition: a contract stating the terms for using a rented vehicle

examples.en: I saved a copy of the rental agreement in my travel folder.
examples.zh: 我在旅行文件夹里留了一份「租车协议」副本。

examples.en: The rental agreement listed the rate and the time to return the car.
examples.zh: 「租车协议」列明了费用标准和还车时间。

collocations: the terms of a rental agreement

words.enDefinition: A bicycle available to use for a fee

examples.en: The rental bike had a basket large enough for my small backpack.
examples.zh: 这辆「租赁自行车」有个车篮，装得下我的小背包。

examples.en: I asked whether the rental bike was available for the afternoon ride.
examples.zh: 我问下午骑行能不能用这辆「租赁自行车」。

words.enDefinition: a car that someone pays to use for an agreed period

examples.en: The rental car was in a numbered space beside the pick-up office.
examples.zh: 「租来的汽车」停在取车办公室旁一个有编号的车位里。

examples.en: We returned the rental car before taking the bus back to campus.
examples.zh: 坐公交回学校之前，我们还了「租来的汽车」。

words.enDefinition: a category used by rental companies to group vehicles with similar size or features

examples.en: I asked whether the rental class guaranteed a particular model or only a category.
examples.zh: 我问「租车车型等级」能否保证拿到某一型号，还是只代表车型类别。

examples.en: The website changed the rental class after the smaller vehicles became unavailable.
examples.zh: 小车型无车可租后，网站改了「租车车型等级」。

collocations: cars in the same rental class

words.enDefinition: the desk where a customer completes a car rental or returns the keys

examples.en: I waited at the rental counter while my classmate found the booking email.
examples.zh: 同学找预约邮件时，我在「租车服务柜台」等着。

examples.en: The rental counter was on the ground floor beside the station exit.
examples.zh: 「租车服务柜台」在底层，就在车站出口旁。

collocations: check in at the rental counter

words.enDefinition: an approved arrangement to keep a rented vehicle beyond the original ending time

examples.en: I requested a rental extension when our evening train was cancelled suddenly.
examples.zh: 晚上的火车突然取消，我申请「延长租车期限」。

examples.en: The agent emailed a rental extension with a revised time to return the car.
examples.zh: 代理发来「延长租车期限」的邮件，里面写了新的还车时间。

collocations: the cost of a rental extension

words.enDefinition: an insurance policy that covers specified risks from renting or using a vehicle

examples.en: I asked whether the rental insurance was included in the price shown online.
examples.zh: 我问网上显示的价格是否包含「租车保险」。

examples.en: The rental insurance summary listed coverage for different kinds of loss separately.
examples.zh: 「租车保险」摘要把不同损失类型的保障分开列出。

words.enDefinition: the interval during which the customer is allowed to keep the rented vehicle

examples.en: I checked that the rental period covered both days of our weekend trip.
examples.zh: 我确认了「租车期限」涵盖周末旅行的两天。

examples.en: The agreement listed the end of the rental period alongside the return location.
examples.zh: 协议把「租车期限」的结束时间和还车地点列在一起。

collocations: the end of the rental period

words.enDefinition: A timer showing the duration of a rental

examples.en: The rental timer was visible at the top of the app screen.
examples.zh: 「租用计时器」显示在应用屏幕顶部。

examples.en: I checked whether the rental timer had stopped after returning the bicycle.
examples.zh: 归还自行车后，我查看了「租用计时器」有没有停。

words.enDefinition: To take items out and pack the bag again

examples.en: The agent offered a nearby table where you could repack your bag if necessary.
examples.zh: 工作人员说，如有需要，可以在旁边那张桌子上「重新收拾行李」。

examples.en: Where can you repack your bag if the zip cannot close all the way?
examples.zh: 如果拉链拉不到头，可以在哪儿「重新收拾行李」？

collocations: use a table to repack your bag

words.enDefinition: a bus operating instead of another service that is temporarily unavailable

examples.en: A replacement bus took us past the stations affected by weekend track work.
examples.zh: 一辆「临时代运公交车」把我们带过周末轨道施工影响的几个车站。

examples.en: We found the replacement bus outside the station after following the temporary signs.
examples.zh: 我们顺着临时指示牌，在车站外找到了「临时代运公交车」。

words.enDefinition: a different flight arranged in place of the original one

examples.en: The replacement flight went to the same city but left from a different terminal.
examples.zh: 「替代航班」还是飞往同一个城市，但从另一座航站楼出发。

examples.en: I told my friend the replacement flight would arrive too late for our bus.
examples.zh: 我告诉朋友，「替代航班」到得太晚，我们赶不上那班公交。

words.enDefinition: To tell the provider that a bicycle is damaged

examples.en: I found the button to report a damaged bike on the support page.
examples.zh: 我在客服页面找到了「报告单车损坏」的按钮。

examples.en: The app asked for a photo when I tried to report a damaged bike.
examples.zh: 我试着「报告单车损坏」时，应用让我上传照片。

collocations: use the app to report a damaged bike
ask how to report a damaged bike
a form to report a damaged bike

words.enDefinition: To print another copy of a boarding pass

examples.en: I asked the airline agent to reprint a boarding pass that had torn.
examples.zh: 登机牌撕破了，我请航空公司工作人员帮我「重新打印一张登机牌」。

examples.en: Can I reprint a boarding pass at the same machine I used earlier?
examples.zh: 我能在之前用过的同一台机器上「重新打印登机牌」吗？

collocations: ask someone to reprint a boarding pass
need to reprint a boarding pass
reprint a boarding pass at the counter

words.enDefinition: To ask staff to provide clean towels during your stay

examples.en: The welcome note explained how to request fresh towels from the front desk.
examples.zh: 欢迎提示说明了怎么向前台「请换干净毛巾」。

examples.en: I called the service desk to request fresh towels for both of us.
examples.zh: 我给服务台打电话，请帮我们两个人「换干净毛巾」。

collocations: ask how to request fresh towels
use the app to request fresh towels

words.enDefinition: a stop where a vehicle stops only when a passenger signals or requests it

examples.en: The small stop outside our village was marked as a request stop.
examples.zh: 我们村外那个小站标的是「按需停靠站」。

examples.en: I asked the driver how to get off at the next request stop.
examples.zh: 我问司机，想在下一个「按需停靠站」下车该怎么做。

collocations: get off at a request stop

words.zhGloss: 把我的行程改为经某地转机
words.enDefinition: asks to change your travel route through a different airport
acceptedZhAnswers: 把我的行程改为经某地转机

examples.en: Could you reroute me via another airport if this connection will not be possible?
examples.zh: 要是这次转机赶不上，能「把我的行程改为经另一个机场转机」吗？

examples.en: The agent offered to reroute me via Dublin after the second flight was cancelled.
examples.zh: 第二趟航班取消后，工作人员提出「把我的行程改为经都柏林转机」。

collocations: can you reroute me via another airport?
would it be possible to reroute me via Boston?
ask the airline to reroute me via another city

words.enDefinition: A formal change to the details of an accommodation booking

examples.en: The hotel sent a reservation amendment email after we changed dates.
examples.zh: 我们改过日期后，酒店发了一封「订房信息修改」的邮件。

examples.en: I asked whether the reservation amendment changed which room we would get.
examples.zh: 我问「订房信息修改」后，给我们的房间是否也会变。

words.enDefinition: An email acknowledging the details of a hotel or hostel booking

examples.en: I opened the reservation confirmation email to check which property we had booked.
examples.zh: 我打开「订房确认邮件」，确认我们订的是哪家住宿。

examples.en: My roommate forwarded the reservation confirmation email before we left campus.
examples.zh: 离开学校前，室友把「订房确认邮件」转发给了我。

collocations: a copy of the reservation confirmation email

words.enDefinition: To arrange for a bike to be held for you

examples.en: Can I reserve a bike before heading to the docking station near my flat?
examples.zh: 我去住处附近的停靠点之前，可以先「预约一辆单车」吗？

examples.en: The app let me reserve a bike while I waited for my classmate.
examples.zh: 应用允许我在等同学时「预约一辆单车」。

collocations: use the app to reserve a bike

words.enDefinition: A particular place held for a passenger on a service

examples.en: I found my reserved seat by checking the number above the window.
examples.zh: 我看了窗户上方的编号，找到了「已预订座位」。

examples.en: The clerk asked whether the ticket showed my reserved seat.
examples.zh: 售票员问车票上是否显示了我的「已预订座位」。

words.enDefinition: A separately listed charge associated with staying at certain properties

examples.en: I asked what the resort fee on the hotel confirmation covered.
examples.zh: 我问酒店确认信息上的「度假酒店附加费」包括什么。

examples.en: The confirmation showed a resort fee on a separate line.
examples.zh: 确认信息单独列了一行「度假酒店附加费」。

collocations: ask what the resort fee covers

words.enDefinition: To give a hired bicycle back after using it

examples.en: I checked whether I could return a bike at the station beside the market.
examples.zh: 我查看了能不能在市场旁的停靠点「归还一辆单车」。

examples.en: My classmate asked where to return a bike that we'd rented for the afternoon.
examples.zh: 同学问，下午租的自行车该到哪里「归还」。

collocations: return a bike to the station
look for a place to return a bike
ask where to return a bike

words.enDefinition: The part of a trip that brings someone back

examples.en: The return leg started at a different station from our outward trip.
examples.zh: 「返程段」和我们去时的出发车站不同。

examples.en: I asked which coach was listed for the return leg of our trip.
examples.zh: 我问我们的「返程段」写的是哪趟大巴。

collocations: the return leg of a journey

words.enDefinition: fly back to the airport where the flight began

examples.en: We had to return to the departure airport after the crew announced a change of plan.
examples.zh: 机组广播说计划有变，我们的「飞机折返出发机场」。

examples.en: The captain said we would return to the departure airport instead of continuing south.
examples.zh: 机长说「飞机将折返出发机场」，原定往南的行程中止。

collocations: decide to return to the departure airport
have to return to the departure airport
ask why the plane will return to the departure airport

words.enDefinition: move back to the boarding gate after leaving it

examples.en: The captain announced that we needed to return to the gate for another check.
examples.zh: 机长广播说，「飞机要返回登机口」再做一次检查。

examples.en: Our plane had to return to the gate before it could depart that evening.
examples.zh: 我们的「飞机不得不返回登机口」，后来才能在当晚出发。

collocations: need to return to the gate
decide to return to the gate
ask the aircraft to return to the gate

words.enDefinition: An area where a rental bicycle can be returned

examples.en: The app showed a return zone beside the gate near the riverside park.
examples.zh: 应用在河边公园附近的门旁标出了一处「单车可归还区」。

examples.en: I asked whether the return zone was the entire square or one marked corner.
examples.zh: 我问「单车可归还区」是整个广场，还是标出的那个角落。

words.enDefinition: a card that can be used repeatedly to pay or record fares on public transport

examples.en: I bought a reusable transit card because I planned to take buses every week.
examples.zh: 我计划每周都坐公交，所以买了一张「可重复使用的公交卡」。

examples.en: The visitor office explained where to buy a reusable transit card near campus.
examples.zh: 访客服务处解释了学校附近去哪儿买「可重复使用的公交卡」。

words.enDefinition: A list of rides taken on an account

examples.en: I looked at my ride history to find the station I used last week.
examples.zh: 我查看自己的「骑行记录」，想找上周用过的停靠点。

examples.en: The app showed my ride history after I signed in on my new phone.
examples.zh: 我在新手机上登录后，应用显示了我的「骑行记录」。

collocations: an entry in your ride history

words.enDefinition: A status showing that a ride is temporarily paused

examples.en: The screen said “Ride paused” while I looked for my friend outside the museum.
examples.zh: 我在博物馆外找朋友时，屏幕显示「骑行已暂停」。

examples.en: I saw “Ride paused” beside the timer before reopening the map in the app.
examples.zh: 我在应用里重新打开地图之前，看到计时器旁显示「骑行已暂停」。

words.enDefinition: A brief record of a completed bicycle ride

examples.en: My ride summary showed the two locations where I started and finished.
examples.zh: 「单次骑行详情」显示了我出发和结束的两个地点。

examples.en: I opened the ride summary to check the distance shown in the app.
examples.zh: 我打开「单次骑行详情」，查看应用里显示的骑行距离。

words.enDefinition: help provided when a vehicle breaks down or has a problem on the road

examples.en: The rental agreement gave a number for roadside assistance in a separate box.
examples.zh: 租车协议用单独的方框列了「道路救援服务」的联系电话。

examples.en: We called roadside assistance after the car would not start near our hostel.
examples.zh: 汽车在旅舍附近启动不了，于是我们联系了「道路救援服务」。

words.enDefinition: Work carried out to build or repair roads

examples.en: The signs for the roadworks were visible from the path outside the garden.
examples.zh: 从花园外的小路能看到「道路施工」的标牌。

examples.en: I checked the map while my classmate read the notice about the roadworks.
examples.zh: 同学读「道路施工」告示时，我查看了地图。

words.zhGloss: 可推轮椅进入的淋浴间
words.enDefinition: A shower designed for wheelchair entry without a raised step
acceptedZhAnswers: 可推轮椅进入的淋浴间

examples.en: The room photos showed a roll-in shower beside the bathroom sink.
examples.zh: 客房照片里，浴室洗手池旁有「可推轮椅进入的淋浴间」。

examples.en: I asked the hotel to confirm the roll-in shower in our room.
examples.zh: 我请酒店确认，我们的客房有没有「可推轮椅进入的淋浴间」。

collocations: book a room with a roll-in shower

words.enDefinition: An extra bed on wheels that can be moved or folded

examples.en: The hotel brought a rollaway bed when another friend joined us.
examples.zh: 又一位朋友加入后，酒店送来了一张「带轮移动加床」。

examples.en: I asked whether the room had space for a rollaway bed.
examples.zh: 我问客房里能不能放下一张「带轮移动加床」。

words.enDefinition: An outdoor area on a building's roof used by guests

examples.en: We went up to the rooftop terrace after breakfast at the hostel.
examples.zh: 我们在旅舍吃完早餐后去了「屋顶露台」。

examples.en: The map showed how to reach the rooftop terrace from reception.
examples.zh: 示意图标出了从前台怎么到「屋顶露台」。

collocations: a hostel with a rooftop terrace

words.enDefinition: The process or result of allocating a particular room to a guest

examples.en: I checked the room assignment against the room type we booked.
examples.zh: 我拿预订的房型核对了「客房分配」。

examples.en: The hotel changed our room assignment after another room became available.
examples.zh: 另一间客房空出来以后，酒店更改了我们的「客房分配」。

words.enDefinition: The amount charged for using a particular guest room

examples.en: I checked the room charge against the rate on my booking.
examples.zh: 我把「客房费用」和订单上的房价核对了一下。

examples.en: The room charge appeared on the first line of the statement.
examples.zh: 「客房费用」出现在消费明细的第一行。

collocations: a room charge for one night

words.enDefinition: A key or electronic device used by a guest to enter their room

examples.en: The receptionist gave each of us a room key in an envelope.
examples.zh: 前台人员给了我们每人一把装在信封里的「客房钥匙」。

examples.en: I asked where to return the room key in the morning.
examples.zh: 我问早上要到哪里归还「客房钥匙」。

words.enDefinition: A message indicating that a booked room cannot yet be occupied

examples.en: My booking screen showed "Room not ready," so I waited in reception.
examples.zh: 订单页面显示「客房还没准备好」，我就在前台区域等。

examples.en: The message said "Room not ready" when we arrived before lunch.
examples.zh: 我们午饭前到达时，消息显示「客房还没准备好」。

collocations: tell guests their room is not ready
a room not ready at check-in
a note marked room not ready

words.enDefinition: The number identifying a particular guest room in a property

examples.en: I checked my room number on the envelope from reception.
examples.zh: 我查看了前台给的信封上的「客房号」。

examples.en: The porter asked for our room number before carrying the bags upstairs.
examples.zh: 行李员把包提上楼前，问了我们的「客房号」。

words.enDefinition: A price for accommodation without meals included in the rate

examples.en: We chose a room-only rate because breakfast was available on campus.
examples.zh: 学校有早餐可买，我们就选了「只含住宿的房价」。

examples.en: The booking screen listed the room-only rate below the breakfast option.
examples.zh: 预订页面在含早餐的选项下方列出了「只含住宿的房价」。

words.enDefinition: A hotel service that delivers food or drinks to guest rooms

examples.en: My roommate looked at the room service menu while I unpacked.
examples.zh: 我收拾行李时，室友在看「客房送餐服务」的菜单。

examples.en: I called room service to ask when breakfast could be delivered.
examples.zh: 我打电话给「客房送餐服务」，问什么时候能把早餐送上来。

words.enDefinition: The category describing a guest room's beds, layout, or features

examples.en: I checked the room type before sending the reservation to my roommate.
examples.zh: 我核对了「预订房型」，才把订单转发给室友。

examples.en: The front desk asked which room type we had reserved online.
examples.zh: 前台问我们网上订的是哪种「预订房型」。

words.enDefinition: A change to a higher category of guest room

examples.en: The receptionist explained what the room upgrade would change about our booking.
examples.zh: 前台人员解释了这次「客房升级」会让我们的订单有哪些变化。

examples.en: I asked whether our room upgrade applied to both nights.
examples.zh: 我问我们的「客房升级」是不是两晚都适用。

words.enDefinition: A small private sleeping compartment on certain American trains

examples.en: The Amtrak booking page showed a roomette beside the seating options.
examples.zh: Amtrak 的订票页在座席选项旁列了「小型卧铺包间」。

examples.en: I asked how much space the roomette had for our bags.
examples.zh: 我问「小型卧铺包间」能放下多少行李。

words.enDefinition: To turn a map to face a different direction

examples.en: I had to rotate the map so the street in front of me matched it.
examples.zh: 我得「旋转地图」，让图上的方向和眼前街道一致。

examples.en: Can you rotate the map until the bridge appears at the top?
examples.zh: 你能「旋转地图」，把桥转到画面上方吗？

collocations: rotate the map on your screen

words.enDefinition: a car-sharing model that starts and ends a booking in the same designated place

examples.en: The round-trip car share required us to bring the vehicle back to campus.
examples.zh: 「原点归还式共享汽车」要求我们把车开回学校。

examples.en: I used a round-trip car share for an errand close to our flat.
examples.zh: 我用「原点归还式共享汽车」在公寓附近办了点事。

words.enDefinition: a temporary change to a transport route to avoid a blocked section

examples.en: The notice showed a route diversion around the construction near the library.
examples.zh: 通知说，图书馆附近施工期间「线路会临时绕行」。

examples.en: The driver announced a route diversion because the market street was closed.
examples.zh: 市场那条街封了，司机通知大家「线路会临时绕行」。

words.enDefinition: A sign or symbol indicating a particular route

examples.en: A route marker beside the bench showed which path led around the pond.
examples.zh: 长椅旁的「路线标记」指明了哪条路绕着池塘走。

examples.en: The route marker at the next junction matched the one on our paper map.
examples.zh: 下一个交汇处的「路线标记」和纸质地图上的一样。

collocations: a route marker on a post

words.enDefinition: the number or code identifying a particular transport route

examples.en: I copied the route number from the screen before leaving the stop.
examples.zh: 离开站台前，我记下了屏幕上的「公交线路编号」。

examples.en: The driver asked which route number was printed on my travel directions.
examples.zh: 司机问我乘车路线说明上印的是哪个「公交线路编号」。

words.enDefinition: a tool that suggests ways to travel between locations using available routes

examples.en: I used a route planner to find the quickest trip home after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我用「线路规划工具」找最快的回家路线。

examples.en: The route planner offered a bus connection instead of the usual tram.
examples.zh: 「线路规划工具」推荐了换乘公交，没推荐平时坐的电车。

words.enDefinition: A view of the planned route before starting

examples.en: The route preview showed a bridge halfway between the library and our destination.
examples.zh: 「路线预览」显示，图书馆和目的地之间的中途有一座桥。

examples.en: I opened the route preview to check which streets the app had chosen.
examples.zh: 我打开「路线预览」，确认应用选了哪几条街。

collocations: a route preview on the map

words.enDefinition: the final stop at one end of a scheduled transport route

examples.en: The driver announced that the next stop was the route terminus after the market.
examples.zh: 司机播报，过了市场之后下一站就是「线路终点站」。

examples.en: We found a covered waiting area next to the route terminus outside town.
examples.zh: 我们在城外「线路终点站」旁找到了有顶棚的候车区。

words.enDefinition: A reservation made on the first day of the planned stay

examples.en: We made a same-day booking after our last train was cancelled.
examples.zh: 末班列车取消后，我们临时「当天订当天入住」。

examples.en: I asked whether the hostel still accepted a same-day booking that evening.
examples.zh: 我问旅舍那天晚上还接不接受「当天订当天入住」。

words.enDefinition: a change of flights within one airport terminal

examples.en: I booked a same-terminal connection because my first flight was scheduled to arrive after dark.
examples.zh: 第一趟航班预计天黑后才到，所以我订了「同一航站楼内转机」的行程。

examples.en: The agent found a same-terminal connection that left us more time between the flights.
examples.zh: 工作人员找到了「同一航站楼内转机」的行程，两趟航班之间留给我们的时间也更多。

words.enDefinition: a change between flights included on one ticket

examples.en: I chose a same-ticket connection so both flights would appear under one ticket number.
examples.zh: 我选了「同一张机票上的转机」，这样两趟航班都用一个机票号码。

examples.en: The agent confirmed that the route included a same-ticket connection at the first airport.
examples.zh: 工作人员确认，这条路线在第一个机场有「同一张机票上的转机」。

collocations: a same-ticket connection through a hub

words.enDefinition: A temporary structure used to support workers or materials

examples.en: The route notice mentioned scaffolding beside the corner of the old gallery.
examples.zh: 路线告示提到，老美术馆拐角旁搭了「脚手架」。

examples.en: I could see scaffolding above the temporary walkway on that side of the street.
examples.zh: 我看到街道那一侧的临时步行通道上方有「脚手架」。

words.enDefinition: To read a bicycle's code with a device

examples.en: The app asked me to scan the bike code when I picked a bicycle.
examples.zh: 我选好自行车时，应用让我「扫描单车码」。

examples.en: Where do I scan the bike code if this label is hard to read?
examples.zh: 如果这张标签看不清，我要在哪里「扫描单车码」？

collocations: prompt someone to scan the bike code
use the app to scan the bike code
try to scan the bike code

words.enDefinition: To present a boarding pass for electronic reading

examples.en: The sign asked you to scan your boarding pass at the gate reader.
examples.zh: 告示请旅客在登机口的读卡器上「扫描登机牌」。

examples.en: Where should you scan your boarding pass when the gate staff call your group?
examples.zh: 登机口工作人员叫到你的组时，你该去哪儿「扫描登机牌」？

collocations: scan your boarding pass at the gate
ask you to scan your boarding pass
ready to scan your boarding pass

words.enDefinition: a place where you can enjoy an especially attractive view

examples.en: We paused at a scenic viewpoint overlooking the river before walking back into town.
examples.zh: 走回镇上之前，我们在一个俯瞰河流的「观景点」停了一会儿。

examples.en: The map showed a scenic viewpoint at the end of the gardens' main path.
examples.zh: 地图上显示，花园主路尽头有一个「观景点」。

words.enDefinition: the time a particular vehicle or service is timetabled to depart

examples.en: The scheduled departure was written above the adjusted time on the app.
examples.zh: 应用把「计划发车时间」写在调整后的时间上方。

examples.en: I arrived ten minutes before the scheduled departure of the afternoon bus.
examples.zh: 我在下午那班公交「计划发车时间」前十分钟到了。

words.enDefinition: the planned time gap between consecutive vehicles serving the same route and direction

examples.en: I checked the scheduled headway to see how long the usual wait was.
examples.zh: 我查了「计划发车间隔」，看平时一般等多久。

examples.en: The scheduled headway was longer on Sundays than during the weekday rush.
examples.zh: 周日的「计划发车间隔」比工作日高峰期更长。

words.enDefinition: A designated line and area for security screening

examples.en: An officer directed us to a screening lane with an open entrance.
examples.zh: 安检员引导我们走进一条入口开着的「安检通道」。

examples.en: The sign above the screening lane was hard to see from the queue.
examples.zh: 排队时很难看清「安检通道」上方的牌子。

words.enDefinition: An officer carrying out security screening

examples.en: I asked a screening officer which desk could answer my question.
examples.zh: 我问一位「安检人员」，哪个服务台能回答我的问题。

examples.en: The screening officer pointed toward the tray I had left by the belt.
examples.zh: 「安检人员」指了指我落在传送带旁的托盘。

collocations: a screening officer at the checkpoint

words.zhGloss: 随季节变化的开放时间
words.enDefinition: times when a place opens that differ by season
acceptedZhAnswers: 随季节变化的开放时间

examples.en: The garden has seasonal opening hours, so we looked up the spring schedule first.
examples.zh: 花园的「开放时间随季节变化」，所以我们先查了春季的安排。

examples.en: I noticed the seasonal opening hours when we tried to plan a late visit.
examples.zh: 我们想安排晚一点的参观时，我注意到了「随季节变化的开放时间」。

words.enDefinition: A notice that a seat will be allocated at the gate

examples.en: The app showed “Seat assigned at gate” where I normally saw my seat number.
examples.zh: 应用在通常显示座位号的地方写着「座位在登机口分配」。

examples.en: My boarding pass said “Seat assigned at gate,” so I asked the airline agent.
examples.zh: 我的登机牌上写着「座位在登机口分配」，我就去问了航空公司工作人员。

collocations: a boarding pass marked “Seat assigned at gate”
a message saying “Seat assigned at gate”

words.enDefinition: The seat allocated to a particular passenger

examples.en: I checked my seat assignment because my classmate and I wanted to sit together.
examples.zh: 因为我和同学想坐在一起，我看了自己「分配到的座位」。

examples.en: The seat assignment in the app had a different row from my original selection.
examples.zh: 应用里「分配到的座位」和我最初选的座位不在同一排。

words.enDefinition: A sign reminding passengers about seat belts inside a vehicle

examples.en: I saw a seat belt sign near the door of the coach.
examples.zh: 我在长途大巴车门旁看到了「安全带提示牌」。

examples.en: The seat belt sign was printed on a card above our seats.
examples.zh: 「安全带提示牌」印在我们座位上方的一张卡片上。

collocations: a seat belt sign above a seat

words.enDefinition: A diagram showing the location of seats within a vehicle

examples.en: I opened the seat map to find a seat beside my friend.
examples.zh: 我打开「座位示意图」，找朋友旁边的座位。

examples.en: The seat map showed the table seats at one end of the carriage.
examples.zh: 「座位示意图」显示，带桌座位在车厢的一端。

collocations: choose a seat from the seat map

words.enDefinition: An arrangement holding a place on a particular departure for someone

examples.en: The email had my ticket and a separate seat reservation for the train.
examples.zh: 邮件里有车票，还有单独的一份列车「座位预订」。

examples.en: I checked the seat reservation before choosing where to wait on the platform.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「座位预订」，再决定在站台哪个位置候车。

words.enDefinition: A small display indicating whether and when a seat is reserved

examples.en: I looked at the seat reservation display before sitting by the window.
examples.zh: 在靠窗坐下前，我看了看「座位预订显示屏」。

examples.en: My friend checked which stations appeared on the seat reservation display above us.
examples.zh: 朋友核对了头顶「座位预订显示屏」上显示的是哪几站。

collocations: a seat reservation display above each seat

words.enDefinition: The process of choosing where to sit when booking travel

examples.en: The seat selection screen showed which seats faced the front of the train.
examples.zh: 「座位选择」页面显示了哪些座位面朝列车前方。

examples.en: I asked whether seat selection was available for the long coach journey.
examples.zh: 我问这趟长途大巴是否提供「座位选择」。

collocations: choose from the seat selection screen

words.enDefinition: a pocket on the back of the seat in front

examples.en: I put the magazine in the seatback pocket while my tray was being cleared.
examples.zh: 乘务员收餐盘时，我把杂志放进了「前排椅背储物袋」。

examples.en: I checked the seatback pocket twice before getting off the plane after our group trip.
examples.zh: 小组旅行结束下飞机前，我检查了两遍「前排椅背储物袋」。

words.enDefinition: a display built into the back of the seat in front

examples.en: The seatback screen showed our location while we were still flying above the coast.
examples.zh: 飞过海岸上空时，「前排椅背屏幕」显示了我们所在的位置。

examples.en: I used the seatback screen to check how much time was left in the flight.
examples.zh: 我用「前排椅背屏幕」看了离航班结束还有多长时间。

words.zhGloss: 有防盗设施的自行车停放区
words.enDefinition: Bicycle parking with additional protection against theft
acceptedZhAnswers: 有防盗设施的自行车停放区

examples.en: I checked the gallery website for secure bike parking near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我在美术馆网站上查了入口附近有没有「带防盗设施的自行车停放区」。

examples.en: The map showed secure bike parking behind the library rather than out front.
examples.zh: 地图显示「有防盗设施的自行车停放区」在图书馆后面，不在正门外。

collocations: a space with secure bike parking

words.enDefinition: A point where security checks take place

examples.en: I followed the signs to the security checkpoint after leaving the check-in area.
examples.zh: 离开值机区后，我沿着指示牌走向「安检口」。

examples.en: My friend waited at the security checkpoint while I found my boarding pass.
examples.zh: 我找登机牌时，朋友在「安检口」等着。

words.enDefinition: A line of people waiting for security screening

examples.en: We joined the security queue together after the agent printed both boarding passes.
examples.zh: 工作人员打出两张登机牌后，我们一起排进了「安检队伍」。

examples.en: I saw my classmate near the end of the security queue by the sign.
examples.zh: 我在牌子旁的「安检队伍」队尾附近看见了同学。

collocations: the end of the security queue

words.enDefinition: Inspection of passengers or belongings for security purposes

examples.en: The airport map showed where security screening took place before the gate area.
examples.zh: 机场地图标出了走到登机口区域之前在哪里进行「安全检查」。

examples.en: My classmate asked an officer where we should wait for security screening.
examples.zh: 同学问安检人员，我们应该在哪里等候「安全检查」。

words.enDefinition: A tray for belongings during screening

examples.en: I checked the security tray again before leaving the area by the belt.
examples.zh: 我离开传送带旁的区域前，又看了一下「安检托盘」。

examples.en: An officer handed my classmate a security tray from the stack on the table.
examples.zh: 安检人员从桌上的一摞托盘里拿了个「安检托盘」给我同学。

words.enDefinition: A system opening only certain train doors at a station

examples.en: The conductor made an announcement about selective door opening before we arrived.
examples.zh: 到站前，列车长广播了「部分车门开启」的情况。

examples.en: I asked which sign explained selective door opening for the next station.
examples.zh: 我问哪块牌子说明下一站「部分车门开启」的安排。

collocations: a train with selective door opening
an announcement about selective door opening

words.enDefinition: Short-stay lodging with facilities for guests to make their own meals

examples.en: We booked self-catering accommodation for the weekend before the conference.
examples.zh: 我们为开会前的周末订了「可自行做饭的住宿」。

examples.en: The listing showed the kitchen available with the self-catering accommodation.
examples.zh: 住宿页面展示了这套「可自行做饭的住宿」配备的厨房。

words.enDefinition: A way of checking in without using a staffed desk

examples.en: Our host sent the self check-in instructions before we left campus.
examples.zh: 离开学校前，接待方发来了「自助办理入住」的说明。

examples.en: I asked whether self check-in was available at the main entrance.
examples.zh: 我问正门那里能不能「自助办理入住」。

words.enDefinition: A machine or area for checking bags independently

examples.en: I used the self-service bag drop after printing my label at the terminal.
examples.zh: 在航站楼打印标签后，我用了「自助托运点」。

examples.en: The volunteer pointed out the self-service bag drop beside the staffed airline counter.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我看人工航空柜台旁的「自助托运点」。

collocations: staff near the self-service bag drop

words.enDefinition: Passenger check-in using a machine without a desk agent

examples.en: I used self-service check-in to print a boarding pass at the airport.
examples.zh: 我在机场用「自助值机」打印了登机牌。

examples.en: A volunteer showed me where the self-service check-in machines were near the entrance.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我看入口附近的「自助值机」机器在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: a transfer between flights that the traveler arranges independently

examples.en: The itinerary said self-transfer, so I asked what the change at that airport involved.
examples.zh: 行程单写着「自行转机」，所以我问了在那个机场换乘具体要做什么。

examples.en: I chose a self-transfer because I wanted to book the second leg at a different time.
examples.zh: 我想把第二段航程订在另一个时间，所以选了「自行转机」。

words.enDefinition: a transit pass that covers eligible trips for an academic semester

examples.en: My semester transit pass arrived after I confirmed my university registration online.
examples.zh: 我在网上确认大学注册后，收到了「学期公交乘车证」。

examples.en: The university showed me how the semester transit pass appeared in the app.
examples.zh: 学校给我看了「学期公交乘车证」在应用里是什么样。

words.enDefinition: a notice saying an extra ticket is needed for something

examples.en: The exhibition page said 'Separate ticket required' for the rooms on the upper floor.
examples.zh: 展览页面写着，上楼参观那些房间「需另购门票」。

examples.en: I noticed 'Separate ticket required' beside the tower on the visitor map at the entrance.
examples.zh: 我在入口的游客游览图上看到，塔旁边标了「需另购门票」。

collocations: a sign saying separate ticket required
an exhibit marked separate ticket required
see separate ticket required on the map

words.enDefinition: individual tickets bought separately for different parts of a trip

examples.en: I booked separate tickets because my friend was only joining me for the second flight.
examples.zh: 我这两段机票是「分开买的」，因为我朋友只和我一起乘第二趟航班。

examples.en: The two flights were on separate tickets, so I had two different booking references.
examples.zh: 两趟航班用的是「分开买的机票」，所以我有两个不同的预订编号。

words.enDefinition: a notice warning travellers about changes or problems affecting a transport service

examples.en: I received a service alert while waiting for the bus after class.
examples.zh: 下课后等公交时，我收到一条「运营变动提醒」。

examples.en: The service alert explained which stops were closed during the street festival.
examples.zh: 「运营变动提醒」说明街头节庆期间哪些站会关闭。

words.enDefinition: how often buses, trains or other vehicles are scheduled to arrive or depart

examples.en: I checked the service frequency before choosing a placement across town.
examples.zh: 选择在城里另一头实习前，我查了「班次频率」。

examples.en: The leaflet showed a lower service frequency during the university holidays.
examples.zh: 宣传单显示，学校放假期间的「班次频率」较低。

words.enDefinition: Words announcing that transport begins running again after an interruption

examples.en: The notice said "Service resumes tomorrow" after listing the station names.
examples.zh: 通知列出车站名称后写着「明天服务恢复」。

examples.en: I read "Service resumes later today" on the operator's website.
examples.zh: 我在运营方网站上看到「今天晚些时候服务恢复」。

words.expression: set aside a day for sightseeing
words.lemma: set aside a day for sightseeing
words.enDefinition: reserve an entire day to visit places of interest
acceptedEnVariants: set aside a day for sightseeing

examples.en: We agreed to set aside a day for sightseeing before our group workshop began.
examples.zh: 我们约好在小组工作坊开始前，「留出一天观光」。

examples.en: I decided to set aside a day for sightseeing after visiting my old roommate.
examples.zh: 拜访以前的室友后，我决定「留出一天观光」。

collocations: plan to set aside a day for sightseeing
decide to set aside a day for sightseeing
try to set aside a day for sightseeing

words.enDefinition: A label stating passengers can leave but cannot board at a stop

examples.en: The coach timetable marked our stop "Set down only" on that trip.
examples.zh: 长途大巴时刻表把我们那一站标为「仅供下客」。

examples.en: I asked what "Set down only" meant on the sign behind us.
examples.zh: 我问身后的标牌上「仅供下客」是什么意思。

collocations: a platform listed as set down only

words.enDefinition: tell the others to begin the trip while you catch up separately

examples.en: Please set off without me if the guide is ready before I get there.
examples.zh: 如果我到之前导游就准备好了，「不用等我，你们先出发」。

examples.en: You can set off without me because I'll join you at the next stop.
examples.zh: 「不用等我，你们先出发」，我会在下一站和你们会合。

collocations: you can set off without me
feel free to set off without me

words.enDefinition: A room where people staying at an accommodation can sit together

examples.en: We talked in the shared lounge after the conference finished.
examples.zh: 会议结束后，我们在「共用休息室」里聊了一会儿。

examples.en: The shared lounge had shelves with books and a few games.
examples.zh: 「共用休息室」的架子上有书和几盒游戏。

collocations: a hostel with a shared lounge

words.enDefinition: A path open to walkers and cyclists

examples.en: The map marked a shared-use path between the river and the sports grounds.
examples.zh: 地图在河流和运动场之间标出了一条「步行骑行共用道」。

examples.en: We picked a meeting point beside the shared-use path near the bridge.
examples.zh: 我们选了桥附近「步行骑行共用道」旁的一处地点碰面。

collocations: a sign for a shared-use path

words.enDefinition: A train made up of fewer carriages than usually run

examples.en: The board warned that the next train was in short formation.
examples.zh: 显示屏提醒，下一趟列车采用「缩短编组」。

examples.en: I heard the announcement about a short formation just before boarding.
examples.zh: 我上车前刚好听到关于「缩短编组」的广播。

collocations: a short formation on this service

words.enDefinition: Cancellation of a travel service with little warning to passengers

examples.en: The short-notice cancellation meant our group had to choose another departure.
examples.zh: 因为「临时通知取消」，我们一行只好选另一个班次。

examples.en: I read about a short-notice cancellation just before leaving for the station.
examples.zh: 出发去车站前，我看到有一趟车「临时通知取消」。

collocations: a short-notice cancellation of a train

words.enDefinition: a scheduled service that turns back before reaching the usual end of its route

examples.en: A sign marked this as a short-turn service ending before the university stop.
examples.zh: 牌子注明这是「提前折返班次」，终点在学校站之前。

examples.en: I let the short-turn service go because it did not reach my destination.
examples.zh: 我没上这趟「提前折返班次」，因为它不到我的目的地。

words.enDefinition: To arrange to leave a property before the original departure date

examples.en: The guesthouse guide explains whom to contact if you shorten your stay.
examples.zh: 小旅馆指南写明了需要「缩短住宿」时该联系谁。

examples.en: The receptionist asked whether you wanted to shorten your stay by one night.
examples.zh: 前台人员问你是不是想「缩短住宿」，少住一晚。

collocations: check whether you can shorten your stay

words.zhGloss: 旅游淡旺季之间的时段
words.enDefinition: the period between the busiest and quietest travel seasons
acceptedZhAnswers: 旅游淡旺季之间的时段

examples.en: We went in the shoulder season, when the town was lively and queues were short.
examples.zh: 我们在「旅游淡旺季之间的时段」去的，镇上挺热闹，队却不长。

examples.en: A shoulder season visit worked for us because our break started earlier that year.
examples.zh: 那年我们的假期开始得早，所以可以在「旅游淡旺季之间的时段」去。

words.enDefinition: To present your travel ticket when a transport worker asks

examples.en: The notice asks you to show your ticket at the coach door.
examples.zh: 告示要求在长途大巴车门处「出示车票」。

examples.en: The driver asked passengers to show your ticket before taking their seats.
examples.zh: 长途大巴司机请乘客先「出示车票」，然后再就座。

collocations: show your ticket to the conductor

words.enDefinition: A smaller street leading off a main street

examples.en: The community garden entrance was on a side street behind the library.
examples.zh: 社区花园的入口在图书馆后面的一条「从主路岔出的小街」上。

examples.en: I nearly missed the side street because the street name faced the other direction.
examples.zh: 我差点错过那条「岔出的小街」，因为路名牌朝着另一边。

collocations: a side street off the main road

words.enDefinition: a short visit added to the main journey

examples.en: We took a side trip to the old pier on our way to the gardens.
examples.zh: 去花园的路上，我们「顺道去了一趟」旧码头。

examples.en: My friend suggested a side trip when we saw signs for the sculpture park.
examples.zh: 看到通往雕塑公园的指示牌时，朋友建议「顺道去一趟」。

words.enDefinition: visiting interesting or well-known places as a traveler

examples.en: We spent the afternoon sightseeing after our workshop ended earlier than we had expected.
examples.zh: 工作坊比预想的早结束，我们下午就去「观光」了。

examples.en: I saved Saturday for sightseeing because I wanted to explore the city on foot.
examples.zh: 我把周六留给「观光」，想步行逛一逛这座城市。

words.enDefinition: a route past several sights returning to its starting place

examples.en: We planned a sightseeing loop through the old town ending at our starting point.
examples.zh: 我们规划了穿过老城的「环形游览路线」，最后回到出发点。

examples.en: The map suggested a sightseeing loop with two short stops along the river.
examples.zh: 地图推荐了一条「环形游览路线」，沿河有两个短暂停留的地方。

words.zhGloss: 有信号灯控制的过街点
words.enDefinition: A crossing where traffic lights regulate movement
acceptedZhAnswers: 有信号灯控制的过街点

examples.en: The map identified a signal-controlled crossing near the path beside the sports hall.
examples.zh: 地图标出了体育馆旁小路附近一处「有信号灯控制的过街点」。

examples.en: I asked whether there was a signal-controlled crossing between the two campus entrances.
examples.zh: 我问学校两个入口之间有没有「有信号灯控制的过街点」。

collocations: a signal-controlled crossing at a junction

words.enDefinition: A problem with equipment that controls train movements and spacing

examples.en: The announcement mentioned a signal fault on the route ahead.
examples.zh: 广播提到前方线路有「信号故障」。

examples.en: I read about a signal fault before our train reached the station.
examples.zh: 列车到站之前，我看到了关于「信号故障」的消息。

collocations: a delay caused by a signal fault
a notice about a signal fault

words.enDefinition: a ticket that allows you to enter a place once

examples.en: I bought a single-entry ticket because we planned to see everything in one visit.
examples.zh: 我们计划一次看完，就买了「单次入场票」。

examples.en: The single-entry ticket suited our group because nobody wanted to leave halfway through.
examples.zh: 「单次入场票」挺适合我们这一组，因为没人想中途离开。

words.enDefinition: An accommodation arrangement or rate based on one guest staying

examples.en: The booking showed single occupancy even though the room had two beds.
examples.zh: 虽然房间有两张床，订单上还是写着「单人入住」。

examples.en: I asked whether the rate applied to single occupancy for that night.
examples.zh: 我问那个房价是否适用于当晚「单人入住」。

words.enDefinition: A pass covering one bicycle rental ride

examples.en: I chose a single ride pass for the trip from campus to the garden.
examples.zh: 我从学校骑到花园这趟买了张「单次骑行券」。

examples.en: The app showed a single ride pass beside the option for a longer membership.
examples.zh: 应用把「单次骑行券」放在期限较长的会员选项旁。

words.enDefinition: A guest room intended for one person to stay in

examples.en: I booked a single room for the night before my interview.
examples.zh: 我为面试前一晚订了间「单人客房」。

examples.en: The single room shown in the listing was on the top floor.
examples.zh: 住宿页面上那间「单人客房」在顶楼。

collocations: a single room for one night

words.enDefinition: A shared hostel sleeping room with six individual beds

examples.en: I stayed in a six-bed dorm with three students from another university.
examples.zh: 我和另外一所大学的三名学生住在一间「六床多人间」。

examples.en: The hostel had a six-bed dorm on the floor above reception.
examples.zh: 旅舍在前台上一层有一间「六床多人间」。

collocations: book a bed in a six-bed dorm

words.enDefinition: leave out the final scheduled visit from a tour or trip

examples.en: We agreed to skip the last stop because the group needed to get back earlier.
examples.zh: 小组需要早点回去，所以我们同意「略过最后一站」。

examples.en: Our guide offered to skip the last stop and spend longer by the river.
examples.zh: 导游提出「略过最后一站」，在河边多待一会儿。

collocations: decide to skip the last stop
agree to skip the last stop
have to skip the last stop

words.enDefinition: a ticket intended to shorten waiting in the regular entry queue

examples.en: The gallery employee showed us where to use our skip-the-line ticket at the entrance.
examples.zh: 画廊工作人员在入口处告诉了我们在哪里用「免排普通队的门票」。

examples.en: I checked whether the skip-the-line ticket applied to both buildings at the site.
examples.zh: 我查了「免排普通队的门票」是否对景点的两栋楼都适用。

collocations: the lane for a skip-the-line ticket

words.enDefinition: An individual sleeping place in a train carriage

examples.en: I checked whether the sleeper berth was printed on my booking.
examples.zh: 我核对了我的订单上有没有写「列车卧铺铺位」。

examples.en: My flatmate booked a sleeper berth for the journey through the night.
examples.zh: 室友为夜间行程订了一个「列车卧铺铺位」。

collocations: a sleeper berth on a night train

words.enDefinition: An enclosed part of a train fitted with sleeping places

examples.en: I asked where our sleeper compartment was when the train arrived.
examples.zh: 列车进站时，我问了我们的「卧铺包厢」在哪里。

examples.en: The booking showed which carriage contained the sleeper compartment for our group.
examples.zh: 订单上标明我们一行人的「卧铺包厢」在哪节车厢。

words.enDefinition: A train with beds or berths for passengers to sleep in

examples.en: My friend booked a sleeper train for the trip between the cities.
examples.zh: 朋友订了两座城市之间的「卧铺列车」。

examples.en: I asked where the sleeper train would be waiting that evening.
examples.zh: 我问那天晚上「卧铺列车」会停在哪里。

words.enDefinition: an organized tour offered to a limited number of people

examples.en: We booked a small-group tour because everyone wanted to ask questions about the old buildings.
examples.zh: 我们订了「小团导览」，因为大家都有关于老建筑的问题想问。

examples.en: The small-group tour still had space when I checked after my morning lecture.
examples.zh: 我上午下课后查看时，「小团导览」还有空位。

collocations: a small-group tour with a guide

words.enDefinition: a flight with little shaking or sudden movement

examples.en: It was a smooth flight, so I managed to read most of the required chapter.
examples.zh: 这趟「航班飞得平稳」，我读完了指定章节的大部分内容。

examples.en: My friend enjoyed a smooth flight for once and slept until we reached the coast.
examples.zh: 我朋友这次难得遇到「平稳的航班」，一直睡到我们飞抵海岸附近。

words.enDefinition: A suitcase with flexible fabric sides

examples.en: The soft-sided suitcase had a front pocket for the papers I needed at check-in.
examples.zh: 这个「软壳行李箱」有个前袋，可以放我值机需要的文件。

examples.en: My flatmate brought a soft-sided suitcase instead of her usual rigid case.
examples.zh: 室友这次带的是「软壳行李箱」，没带平时那个硬壳箱。

collocations: the pocket of a soft-sided suitcase

words.enDefinition: no more admission tickets remain for that day

examples.en: The museum was sold out for the day, so we visited the gardens instead.
examples.zh: 博物馆「当天门票已经售罄」，我们就改去花园。

examples.en: The tower was sold out for the day by the time we reached the ticket desk.
examples.zh: 我们到售票台时，塔楼「当天门票已经售罄」。

collocations: already sold out for the day
tickets are sold out for the day
the tour is sold out for the day

words.enDefinition: a journey that you make on your own

examples.en: On my first solo trip, I spent as long as I wanted at each stop.
examples.zh: 第一次「独自旅行」时，我每到一处想待多久就待多久。

examples.en: I chose a solo trip because my friends had different reading weeks this year.
examples.zh: 我的朋友今年阅读周的时间不一样，所以我选了「独自旅行」。

words.enDefinition: A phrase used to report an item left by someone

examples.en: I said "Someone left this behind" and handed the scarf to the receptionist.
examples.zh: 我说「有人落下了这个」，把围巾交给前台人员。

examples.en: My roommate said "Someone left this behind" after finding a book near the sofa.
examples.zh: 室友在沙发旁发现一本书后说「有人落下了这个」。

collocations: say "Someone left this behind in the lounge."

words.enDefinition: a shop selling small things visitors buy to remember a place

examples.en: We stopped at the souvenir shop after the tour so I could buy a postcard.
examples.zh: 导览结束后我们去了趟「纪念品商店」，我想买张明信片。

examples.en: The souvenir shop had a print of the bridge we had crossed that morning.
examples.zh: 「纪念品商店」有一张版画，画的是我们上午走过的那座桥。

words.enDefinition: An additional blanket kept available for a guest to use

examples.en: I asked whether the room had a spare blanket for my friend.
examples.zh: 我问房间里有没有「备用毯子」可以给朋友用。

examples.en: The welcome note showed where to find a spare blanket.
examples.zh: 欢迎提示写了到哪里可以找到「备用毯子」。

collocations: a spare blanket in the wardrobe

words.enDefinition: Baggage handled under separate arrangements because of its type

examples.en: The airline page listed sports equipment under special baggage beside the standard bag options.
examples.zh: 航空公司的页面把体育器材归入「特殊行李」，与普通行李选项并列。

examples.en: I asked whether my instrument case counted as special baggage before going to the counter.
examples.zh: 去柜台之前，我问乐器箱算不算「特殊行李」。

words.enDefinition: Separate tickets used for different portions of one rail journey

examples.en: The rail website labeled that option as split tickets for the journey.
examples.zh: 铁路网站把这趟行程的那个选项标为「分段购买的铁路票」。

examples.en: I asked the agent why the email showed two split tickets.
examples.zh: 我问售票员，为什么邮件里有两张「分段购买的铁路票」。

words.enDefinition: A place where a worker helps passengers buy travel tickets

examples.en: I looked for a staffed ticket counter because I had a question.
examples.zh: 我有个问题要问，就找了「人工售票窗口」。

examples.en: The staffed ticket counter was still open after my afternoon class ended.
examples.zh: 下午下课后，「人工售票窗口」还开着。

collocations: ask at a staffed ticket counter
buy from a staffed ticket counter

words.enDefinition: A notice that a route has only stairs

examples.en: I saw a “Stairs only” sign beside the path to the upper garden.
examples.zh: 通往上层花园的小路旁有块牌子，写着「只能走楼梯」。

examples.en: The map labelled the shortcut “Stairs only” near the smaller campus entrance.
examples.zh: 地图在学校较小的入口旁把那条近路标为「只能走楼梯」。

words.enDefinition: An ordinary rail travel class below a higher service tier

examples.en: I checked which carriages were marked standard class before boarding.
examples.zh: 上车前，我核对了哪些车厢标为「标准席」。

examples.en: The UK rail screen showed standard class beside the other class.
examples.zh: 英国的铁路购票屏上把「标准席」和另一等级并排列出。

words.enDefinition: A guest room offered in a property's usual basic category

examples.en: I picked a standard room because I only needed one night.
examples.zh: 我只住一晚，所以选了一间「标准客房」。

examples.en: The standard room I booked overlooked the street where the café was.
examples.zh: 我订的「标准客房」能看到咖啡馆所在的那条街。

words.enDefinition: a list of passengers waiting for a seat to become available

examples.en: I joined the standby list after the agent said the next flight was full.
examples.zh: 工作人员说下一趟航班满了，我就上了「候补名单」。

examples.en: The standby list was visible on a small screen beside the airline desk.
examples.zh: 航空公司柜台旁的小屏幕能看到「候补名单」。

collocations: put someone on the standby list
check your place on the standby list

words.enDefinition: space available for people who are not sitting, especially on transport

examples.en: There was only standing room when the bus reached our university stop.
examples.zh: 公交开到我们学校这站时，只剩「可以站的空间」。

examples.en: We let the next service go because it had very little standing room.
examples.zh: 下一班车几乎没有「可以站的空间」，我们就没上。

words.enDefinition: A short identifier representing a railway station in timetable systems

examples.en: I checked the station code so I could find the right station.
examples.zh: 我核对了「车站代码」，以便找到正确的车站。

examples.en: The booking listed the station code beside the full station name.
examples.zh: 订单在车站全名旁边列出了「车站代码」。

words.enDefinition: the large public area inside a station that connects its entrances and facilities

examples.en: I met my classmate on the station concourse beside the ticket kiosk.
examples.zh: 我在「车站公共大厅」里的售票亭旁和同学见面。

examples.en: The station concourse had a temporary help desk during the street festival.
examples.zh: 街头节庆期间，「车站公共大厅」设了临时咨询台。

words.enDefinition: an access point used to enter a transport station

examples.en: We agreed to meet at the station entrance after our morning lecture.
examples.zh: 早课后，我们约在「车站入口」见面。

examples.en: The station entrance by the park was closed during the repairs.
examples.zh: 维修期间，公园旁的「车站入口」关闭了。

words.enDefinition: a way out of a transport station that leads to the surrounding area

examples.en: I used a different station exit because the one by campus was closed.
examples.zh: 学校边上那个关了，我换了一个「车站出口」。

examples.en: The map showed which station exit led to the library through the park.
examples.zh: 地图标出了从哪个「车站出口」出去能经公园到图书馆。

collocations: follow signs to the station exit

words.enDefinition: A room at a station where passengers can wait for services

examples.en: We waited in the station waiting room because it was cold outside.
examples.zh: 外面很冷，我们就在「车站候车室」里等车。

examples.en: The station waiting room had a screen showing the next few departures.
examples.zh: 「车站候车室」里有块屏幕，显示接下来几趟车的发车信息。

collocations: sit in the station waiting room

words.enDefinition: A surface that rises or falls sharply

examples.en: The route description noted a steep slope near the public garden's back gate.
examples.zh: 路线说明写着，公共花园的后门附近有一段「陡坡」。

examples.en: I could see the steep slope from the bench where my classmate was waiting.
examples.zh: 我从同学等我的长椅那里能看到那段「陡坡」。

collocations: a steep slope on the route
a sign warning of a steep slope

words.enDefinition: A route that does not involve steps

examples.en: I checked whether the step-free route to the museum went through the park.
examples.zh: 我查看了去博物馆的「无台阶路线」会不会穿过公园。

examples.en: The map showed a step-free route between the two sides of campus.
examples.zh: 地图标出了贯通校园两侧的一条「无台阶路线」。

words.enDefinition: To enter a vehicle when it is ready for passengers

examples.en: We waited for the driver to say we could step on board.
examples.zh: 我们等司机告诉我们可以「登车」。

examples.en: My friend checked the train number before she went to step on board.
examples.zh: 朋友先核对了车次号，然后才「登车」。

collocations: invite passengers to step on board
get ready to step on board

words.enDefinition: a spoken or recorded message identifying the next or current stop

examples.en: The stop announcement helped me recognize the street on my first trip.
examples.zh: 第一次坐这趟车时，我靠「到站播报」认出了那条街。

examples.en: I heard the stop announcement just before the bus turned toward campus.
examples.zh: 公交车拐往学校前，我听到了「到站播报」。

words.enDefinition: a period when a particular transit stop is unavailable to passengers

examples.en: The app showed a stop closure outside the library until the following morning.
examples.zh: 应用显示，图书馆外「站点关闭」会持续到第二天早上。

examples.en: I read the stop closure notice before walking to the temporary stop.
examples.zh: 我先读了「站点关闭」通知，再走去临时站。

words.expression: stop for lunch on the way
words.lemma: stop for lunch on the way
words.enDefinition: pause during a trip to have lunch before continuing
acceptedEnVariants: stop for lunch on the way

examples.en: We decided to stop for lunch on the way to the old mill.
examples.zh: 我们决定去旧磨坊「路上停下来吃午饭」。

examples.en: Do we have time to stop for lunch on the way to the second stop?
examples.zh: 去第二站的「路上，我们有时间停下来吃午饭」吗？

collocations: plan to stop for lunch on the way
decide to stop for lunch on the way
have time to stop for lunch on the way

words.enDefinition: a button passengers press to ask the driver to stop at the next designated stop

examples.en: The stop request button was beside the window above my seat.
examples.zh: 「请求下车按钮」在我座位上方、靠窗的位置。

examples.en: I pressed the stop request button after the announcement for the museum.
examples.zh: 听到博物馆站的播报后，我按了「请求下车按钮」。

words.enDefinition: a planned break in a journey at an intermediate place

examples.en: We planned a stopover in Singapore and spent two days with friends before continuing home.
examples.zh: 我们安排在新加坡「中途停留」，和朋友待了两天后再继续回家。

examples.en: I chose an itinerary with a stopover because I wanted to visit my former flatmate.
examples.zh: 我想见见以前的室友，所以选了一条能「中途停留」的行程。

collocations: spend a stopover in a city

words.enDefinition: A train that calls at many stations along its route

examples.en: We switched to a stopping train that stopped near our destination.
examples.zh: 我们改乘了在目的地附近停靠的「沿途多停的列车」。

examples.en: The stopping train made a short stop at my friend's station.
examples.zh: 「沿途多停的列车」在我朋友所在的车站停了一会儿。

words.enDefinition: a card holding a prepaid balance from which fares can be deducted

examples.en: The gate displayed the remaining credit on my stored-value card after the trip.
examples.zh: 乘车结束后，闸机显示了「储值乘车卡」的剩余金额。

examples.en: I asked whether my stored-value card worked on buses in that district.
examples.zh: 我问「储值乘车卡」能不能在那个区坐公交用。

collocations: load money onto a stored-value card

words.enDefinition: A guest room that looks onto a road or street

examples.en: I asked whether the street-facing room had windows we could open.
examples.zh: 我问「临街客房」的窗户能不能打开。

examples.en: Our street-facing room looked onto the street beside the railway station.
examples.zh: 我们的「临街客房」正对着火车站旁边那条街。

collocations: a street-facing room on the second floor

words.enDefinition: A sign displaying the name of a street

examples.en: I looked up at the street name sign to check the address.
examples.zh: 我抬头看了「路名牌」，核对地址。

examples.en: The street name sign was mounted on the wall above the corner door.
examples.zh: 「路名牌」装在拐角那扇门上方的墙上。

collocations: a street name sign on the wall
look for the street name sign

words.enDefinition: a trip organized and led by students

examples.en: I joined a student-led trip to the coast during my first month at university.
examples.zh: 上大学的第一个月，我参加了「学生自行组织的出游」，去了海边。

examples.en: The student-led trip included two visits that our society had arranged in advance.
examples.zh: 这次「学生自行组织的出游」有两场参观，都是社团提前安排的。

collocations: a student-led trip to a town

words.enDefinition: a price offered to students who qualify for it

examples.en: I asked whether the student rate applied to the special tour as well.
examples.zh: 我问那场特别导览是否也有「学生票价」。

examples.en: The website showed a student rate when we checked admission for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 我们查询展览门票时，网站显示了「学生票价」。

words.enDefinition: an amount a place invites visitors to give voluntarily

examples.en: The desk had a sign with a suggested donation beside the entrance to the garden.
examples.zh: 花园入口旁的服务台有块牌子，写着「建议捐款金额」。

examples.en: I noticed the suggested donation while picking up a visitor map at the desk.
examples.zh: 在服务台拿游客游览图时，我注意到了「建议捐款金额」。

collocations: a suggested donation at the entrance

words.enDefinition: A train seat arranged next to a table shared by passengers

examples.en: I chose a table seat so I could review my notes.
examples.zh: 我选了一个「带桌座位」，这样可以复习笔记。

examples.en: The seat map marked each table seat with a small rectangle.
examples.zh: 座位图用小长方形标出了每个「带桌座位」。

collocations: a table seat with space for a laptop

words.enDefinition: To travel by a route avoiding part of the usual way

examples.en: We had to take a detour when the path through the square closed.
examples.zh: 穿过广场的路关闭后，我们得「绕路」。

examples.en: I asked whether we would need to take a detour on the walk back.
examples.zh: 我问走回去时需不需要「绕路」。

collocations: take a detour around the site

words.enDefinition: To turn into the second road or path on the right

examples.en: The directions said to take the second right after passing the campus gate.
examples.zh: 指引说，过了校门后要「在第二个路口右转」。

examples.en: Should I take the second right before I reach the old stone bridge?
examples.zh: 在到旧石桥之前，我应该「在第二个路口右转」吗？

collocations: take the second right after the gate
need to take the second right
remember to take the second right

words.enDefinition: to register the end of a transit trip by touching a card or device to a reader

examples.en: I saw people tap off just before stepping down from the Sydney bus.
examples.zh: 我看到悉尼公交车上的乘客「下车时刷卡」，刷完才走下车。

examples.en: The notice explained why people tap off at that station after their journey.
examples.zh: 通知说明了为什么在那个车站，行程结束要「感应刷卡」。

words.enDefinition: to register the start of a transit trip by touching a card or device to a reader

examples.en: I watched someone tap on at the front of the bus in Sydney.
examples.zh: 在悉尼，我看到有人「上车时刷卡」，读卡器就在公交车前门。

examples.en: The station symbol showed passengers where to tap on before boarding the tram.
examples.zh: 车站标识告诉乘客，上有轨电车前到哪里「刷卡」。

words.enDefinition: a wait on the ground during which passengers cannot leave the plane

examples.en: I read several more pages during the tarmac delay before our flight finally took off.
examples.zh: 飞机终于起飞前遇上「不能下机的地面延误」，我又读了几页书。

examples.en: After landing, a tarmac delay meant we stayed on the plane while waiting for a gate.
examples.zh: 着陆后遇到「不能下机的地面延误」，我们留在飞机上等空出的登机口。

words.enDefinition: a delay while an equipment issue is checked or resolved

examples.en: A technical delay kept the plane at the gate while the crew waited for an update.
examples.zh: 飞机「因技术原因延误」，一直停在登机口，机组正在等消息。

examples.en: The airline posted another estimate after announcing a technical delay on the evening flight.
examples.zh: 航空公司宣布夜间航班「因技术原因延误」后，又公布了一个预计出发时间。

words.enDefinition: A handle that extends and retracts in sections

examples.en: I pulled out the telescoping handle before rolling my suitcase toward the counter.
examples.zh: 我把「可伸缩拉杆」拉出来，再拖着行李箱走向柜台。

examples.en: The telescoping handle on my new suitcase slid down before I put it on the belt.
examples.zh: 我把新行李箱放上传送带前，「可伸缩拉杆」滑下去了。

collocations: a suitcase with a telescoping handle

words.enDefinition: A crossing provided for a limited time

examples.en: The town map marked a temporary crossing near the entrance to the exhibition.
examples.zh: 镇上的地图标出展览入口附近有一个「临时过街点」。

examples.en: I asked where the temporary crossing was after seeing the work on the corner.
examples.zh: 看到拐角处在施工后，我问「临时过街点」在哪儿。

collocations: a sign for a temporary crossing
a temporary crossing near a junction

words.enDefinition: a stop used for a limited period while normal arrangements have changed

examples.en: A yellow sign pointed to the temporary stop beside the university gate.
examples.zh: 一个黄色牌子指向学校大门旁的「临时停靠站」。

examples.en: The temporary stop was across the road while the shelter was being repaired.
examples.zh: 候车亭维修期间，「临时停靠站」设在马路对面。

words.enDefinition: A walking path provided for a limited period

examples.en: The temporary walkway ran between two barriers beside the closed path near campus.
examples.zh: 学校附近关闭的小路旁，两道隔栏之间有条「临时步行通道」。

examples.en: A volunteer showed us where the temporary walkway reached the park entrance.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我们看「临时步行通道」在哪儿接上公园入口。

words.enDefinition: A doorway leading into the passenger terminal

examples.en: My flatmate waited by the terminal entrance while I helped load the bags.
examples.zh: 我帮着搬行李时，室友在「航站楼入口」旁等着。

examples.en: The terminal entrance closest to the bus stop was on the same level.
examples.zh: 离公交站最近的「航站楼入口」就在同一层。

collocations: a sign at the terminal entrance

words.enDefinition: A map of the areas inside a terminal

examples.en: I opened the terminal map to find the closest entrance to our airline's counter.
examples.zh: 我打开「航站楼地图」，查哪个入口离我们航空公司的柜台最近。

examples.en: The terminal map showed an indoor path from the bus stop to check-in.
examples.zh: 「航站楼地图」标出了一条从公交站到值机区的室内路线。

collocations: find something on the terminal map

words.enDefinition: A number identifying a particular terminal

examples.en: I texted the terminal number to my flatmate before we left the house.
examples.zh: 我们出门之前，我发了条消息把「航站楼编号」告诉室友。

examples.en: The terminal number in the app matched the number printed on the airport sign.
examples.zh: 应用里的「航站楼编号」和机场指示牌上印的一样。

collocations: a terminal number on the itinerary

words.enDefinition: a move between different airport terminals during a journey

examples.en: I checked how long the terminal transfer would take before I showed my friend the tickets.
examples.zh: 把机票给朋友看之前，我查了「航站楼之间换乘」要多久。

examples.en: One airport map showed our terminal transfer as a short walk through a covered passage.
examples.zh: 一张机场地图显示，我们这段「航站楼之间换乘」只要走过一小段有顶通道。

collocations: follow signs for a terminal transfer
allow time for a terminal transfer

words.enDefinition: tells visitors that this is the last place on the tour

examples.en: The tour ends here, but you can still look around the garden on your own.
examples.zh: 「导览到这里结束」，大家还可以自己在花园里看看。

examples.en: The tour ends here by the entrance where we met our guide this morning.
examples.zh: 「导览在这个入口结束」，我们今天上午在这里和导游见的面。

collocations: the guide says the tour ends here
the tour ends here by the entrance

words.enDefinition: says a tour is behind its planned schedule

examples.en: The tour is running late, so I told my friends to start lunch without me.
examples.zh: 「导览比计划晚了」，我就让朋友不用等我，先吃午饭。

examples.en: The guide said the tour is running late because the previous group took longer.
examples.zh: 导游说上一组用时比较长，所以「导览比计划晚了」。

collocations: the tour is running late today
the guide says the tour is running late
if the tour is running late

words.zhGloss: 列车将在某站分为两列
words.enDefinition: An announcement that sections of a train will separate at a station
acceptedZhAnswers: 列车将在某站分为两列

examples.en: The conductor said "The train will divide at Central," so I checked my carriage.
examples.zh: 列车长说「列车将在中央站分为两列」，于是我核对了自己的车厢。

examples.en: My friend heard "The train will divide at Riverside" and checked the display.
examples.zh: 朋友听到「列车将在河畔站分为两列」后，看了看显示屏。

collocations: the train will divide at the next station
the train will divide at Riverside
hear that the train will divide at a station

words.enDefinition: An announcement that a train will continue in the opposite direction

examples.en: The conductor said "The train will reverse direction" as we pulled into the station.
examples.zh: 列车进站时，列车长说「列车将换向行驶」。

examples.en: I heard "The train will reverse direction" and checked the route on my phone.
examples.zh: 我听到「列车将换向行驶」后，用手机核对了线路。

collocations: a notice saying "The train will reverse direction."

words.enDefinition: an examination of the knowledge needed for driving, such as road signs and rules

examples.en: I revised the road signs before taking the theory test on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五参加「驾驶理论考试」之前，我复习了道路标志。

examples.en: The driving school sent me a reminder about the theory test next week.
examples.zh: 驾校发消息提醒我，下周要参加「驾驶理论考试」。

words.enDefinition: Words introducing stations served by a particular passenger train

examples.en: The announcement said "This train calls at Riverside," so my friend stayed on.
examples.zh: 广播说「本次列车停靠河畔站」，所以我朋友留在车上。

examples.en: The screen showed "This train calls at Central" under the departure time.
examples.zh: 屏幕在发车时间下面写着「本次列车停靠中央站」。

collocations: this train calls at all stations
this train calls at the following stations
this train calls at two stations

words.enDefinition: An announcement that the service will not carry passengers farther

examples.en: The conductor said, "This train terminates here," just before the doors opened.
examples.zh: 车门打开前，列车长说「本次列车到此终止」。

examples.en: I heard "This train terminates here" and followed my group off the train.
examples.zh: 听到「本次列车到此终止」后，我跟着同行的人下车。

collocations: a notice saying "This train terminates here."

words.enDefinition: One ticket covering a journey that may involve several services

examples.en: I asked whether one through ticket could cover both train services.
examples.zh: 我问一张「全程联票」能不能覆盖两趟列车。

examples.en: The through ticket showed each part of the trip on a separate line.
examples.zh: 「全程联票」每一行分别列了一段行程。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement recognizing certain tickets on another service or operator

examples.en: I asked which services the ticket acceptance notice referred to.
examples.zh: 我问「其他班次认可原票」的通知指哪些班次。

examples.en: The rail website published an update on ticket acceptance for that day.
examples.zh: 铁路网站发布了当天「其他班次认可原票」的最新消息。

words.enDefinition: A booking code used to identify tickets when collecting them

examples.en: I found the ticket collection reference near the bottom of the email.
examples.zh: 我在邮件靠近末尾的地方找到了「取票编号」。

examples.en: The clerk pointed out where the ticket collection reference appeared on my confirmation.
examples.zh: 售票员指出了我的确认信息里「取票编号」的位置。

words.enDefinition: A station area containing ticket counters or machines

examples.en: We met in the ticket hall before heading to the platform.
examples.zh: 去站台之前，我们在「车站售票厅」碰了面。

examples.en: The exit from the ticket hall was beside the information screen.
examples.zh: 「车站售票厅」的出口在信息显示屏旁边。

collocations: a machine in the ticket hall

words.enDefinition: a notice restricting access to people who have tickets

examples.en: The gate said 'Ticket holders only,' so I waited outside with my friend's bag.
examples.zh: 门上写着「仅限持票者入内」，我就拿着朋友的包在外面等。

examples.en: We saw 'Ticket holders only' next to the shorter queue for the tower visit.
examples.zh: 参观塔楼时，我们看到较短的一条队旁边写着「仅限持票者入内」。

collocations: a sign saying ticket holders only
an entrance marked ticket holders only
a queue for ticket holders only

words.enDefinition: a machine from which passengers can buy or collect travel tickets

examples.en: I used the ticket machine to buy a pass before meeting my classmates.
examples.zh: 和同学碰面前，我用「自助售票机」买了张通票。

examples.en: The ticket machine had a different button for discounted student fares.
examples.zh: 「自助售票机」上学生优惠票价有单独的按钮。

collocations: buy a ticket from a ticket machine
a ticket machine at the entrance

words.enDefinition: A number identifying an individual issued ticket

examples.en: I found my ticket number on the receipt attached to the airline email.
examples.zh: 我在航空公司邮件所附的凭据上找到了「机票号码」。

examples.en: The agent checked the ticket number after opening the booking at the counter.
examples.zh: 工作人员在柜台打开预订记录后，核对了「机票号码」。

words.enDefinition: Conditions limiting when or how a travel ticket may be used

examples.en: I asked the agent which ticket restrictions applied to my departure.
examples.zh: 我问售票员，哪些「车票使用限制」适用于我选的班次。

examples.en: The booking displayed the ticket restrictions on a separate page.
examples.zh: 订票系统在单独一页上列出了「车票使用限制」。

words.enDefinition: a device that checks or records the validity of a ticket for travel

examples.en: I held the paper ticket near the ticket validator at the tram stop.
examples.zh: 我在电车站把纸质车票靠近「验票机」。

examples.en: The ticket validator displayed a message after I presented my mobile ticket.
examples.zh: 我出示手机车票后，「验票机」显示了一条信息。

collocations: place a ticket on the ticket validator
a ticket validator on a tram
