words.enDefinition: a parking system that records a vehicle's use without issuing a paper ticket

examples.en: The hotel switched to ticketless parking last term, according to its guest notice.
examples.zh: 酒店的住客通知说，上个学期开始改用「无纸票停车」。

examples.en: I asked how ticketless parking worked when I drove in from the side entrance.
examples.zh: 我问从侧门开进去时，「无纸票停车」系统怎么记录。

words.enDefinition: a change of flights with very little time in between

examples.en: I had a tight connection and asked where my gate was before leaving the plane.
examples.zh: 我这次「转机时间紧」，下飞机前就问了登机口在哪儿。

examples.en: The tight connection left me little time to stop for a snack at the airport.
examples.zh: 这个「时间紧的转机」几乎没给我留时间在机场买点吃的。

words.enDefinition: a system assigning visitors particular times to enter

examples.en: The exhibition uses timed entry, so we booked a visit just before lunch.
examples.zh: 展览采用「分时段入场」，所以我们订在午饭前去看。

examples.en: I checked whether the garden required timed entry when our group changed its plans.
examples.zh: 我们小组改计划时，我查了花园是否要求「分时段入场」。

words.enDefinition: a separate fee for processing a toll payment or notice, often in a rental

examples.en: The rental invoice listed a toll administration fee next to the road charge.
examples.zh: 租车账单在道路通行费旁列了笔「通行费代办手续费」。

examples.en: I asked the rental company to explain the toll administration fee on that line.
examples.zh: 我请租车公司解释那一行的「通行费代办手续费」。

words.enDefinition: a payment notice stating the charges for using a toll road

examples.en: The toll invoice listed the road name and the date of travel.
examples.zh: 「道路通行费账单」列了公路名称和出行日期。

examples.en: I compared the toll invoice with the route shown in our trip history.
examples.zh: 我把「道路通行费账单」和乘车记录显示的线路做了比较。

collocations: a copy of the toll invoice

words.enDefinition: a widened area where vehicles pass through lanes set up to collect tolls

examples.en: The highway widened as we approached the toll plaza before the bridge.
examples.zh: 快到桥前的「收费站广场」时，高速公路变宽了。

examples.en: The map marked the toll plaza with a symbol beside the main road.
examples.zh: 地图在主路旁用一个标志标出了「收费站广场」。

collocations: a toll plaza on the highway

words.enDefinition: a road for which drivers must pay a fee to use it

examples.en: The route planner showed one way that crossed a toll road near the city.
examples.zh: 线路规划工具显示，有条路要经过城市附近的「收费公路」。

examples.en: We noticed that the toll road had a separate sign at the entrance.
examples.zh: 我们注意到「收费公路」在入口有单独的标识。

collocations: avoid a toll road on the map

words.enDefinition: a device in a vehicle that communicates with equipment recording electronic tolls

examples.en: The agent showed me the toll transponder attached near the rearview mirror.
examples.zh: 代理指给我看，后视镜附近装的「电子通行费感应装置」。

examples.en: I asked whether the toll transponder was already included in our rental.
examples.zh: 我问「电子通行费感应装置」是不是已经包含在租车服务里。

collocations: a toll transponder in the vehicle

words.enDefinition: a station or street machine that adds prepaid credit to a travel card

examples.en: The top-up machine showed my current balance after I inserted the card.
examples.zh: 我插入卡后，「公交卡充值机」显示了当前余额。

examples.en: I found the top-up machine just inside the subway entrance near campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校附近的地铁入口里面找到了「公交卡充值机」。

collocations: add money at a top-up machine

words.zhGloss: 英式人行与骑行共用过街点
words.enDefinition: A British signal-controlled crossing for pedestrians and cyclists
acceptedZhAnswers: 英式人行与骑行共用过街点

examples.en: The tour guide in Bristol pointed out the toucan crossing near the harbour.
examples.zh: 布里斯托尔的导游指给我们看港口附近的「行人与骑行者共用过街处」。

examples.en: The label toucan crossing appeared where the cycle route met the main road.
examples.zh: 骑行路线和主路交汇的地方标着「行人与骑行者共用过街处」。

collocations: a toucan crossing on a cycle route
a sign for a toucan crossing

words.enDefinition: make contact with the ground at the end of a flight

examples.en: We were due to touch down just before my first lecture started back home.
examples.zh: 我们预计在我回去后的第一节课开始前「着陆」。

examples.en: The captain said we would touch down a little earlier than our original arrival time.
examples.zh: 机长说我们会比原定到达时间稍早「着陆」。

collocations: the plane will touch down soon

words.enDefinition: the time when a tour group is scheduled to set off

examples.en: We checked the tour departure time before deciding whether to stop for a coffee.
examples.zh: 决定要不要停下来喝杯咖啡前，我们先查了「导览团出发时间」。

examples.en: The note on my ticket showed a tour departure time just before lunchtime.
examples.zh: 我票上的备注显示，「导览团出发时间」在午饭前不久。

words.enDefinition: A desk providing travelers with information about local tours

examples.en: I asked at the tour desk whether the museum ran guided visits.
examples.zh: 我在「旅游咨询台」问博物馆有没有导览。

examples.en: The hostel's tour desk had a map of the riverside walks.
examples.zh: 旅舍的「旅游咨询台」有一张河畔步行路线图。

words.enDefinition: the length of time a tour takes from start to finish

examples.en: I checked the tour duration because we were meeting friends for dinner afterwards.
examples.zh: 我们约了之后和朋友吃晚饭，所以我查了「导览时长」。

examples.en: The leaflet listed the tour duration just under the picture of the old house.
examples.zh: 宣传单把「导览时长」列在老宅照片正下方。

words.enDefinition: headphones receiving the guide's voice during a group tour

examples.en: I put on the tour headset so I could hear the guide across the courtyard.
examples.zh: 为了隔着院子也能听到导游，我戴上了「导览接收耳机」。

examples.en: We returned each tour headset before leaving the last room of the house.
examples.zh: 离开老宅最后一个房间之前，我们归还了各自的「导览接收耳机」。

words.enDefinition: the language in which a tour is conducted

examples.en: I checked the tour language because two friends wanted to practice their English.
examples.zh: 有两个朋友想练英语，所以我查了「导览使用的语言」。

examples.en: The booking page showed the tour language just above the list of start times.
examples.zh: 预订页面在开始时间列表上方标出了「导览使用的语言」。

words.enDefinition: a business that organizes and runs tours for travelers

examples.en: I contacted the tour operator when the booking page showed two different start times.
examples.zh: 预订页面显示了两个不同的开始时间，我就联系了「旅游团承办方」。

examples.en: The tour operator emailed our group before moving the meeting point to the courtyard.
examples.zh: 「旅游团承办方」给我们小组发了邮件，随后把集合点挪到了院子里。

words.enDefinition: the places visited along the route of a tour

examples.en: We looked at the tour stops and chose the route with the old bridge.
examples.zh: 我们看了「导览途中停留的各站」，选了经过旧桥的路线。

examples.en: One of the tour stops was a tiny garden behind the main building.
examples.zh: 其中一个「导览停留点」是主楼后面的一座小花园。

words.enDefinition: a place or feature that people travel to visit

examples.en: The old mill became a tourist attraction after local volunteers opened it to visitors.
examples.zh: 本地志愿者把旧磨坊向公众开放后，它成了一个「旅游景点」。

examples.en: We picked one tourist attraction nearby because we only had the afternoon free.
examples.zh: 我们只有下午有空，就挑了附近的一个「旅游景点」。

words.enDefinition: an office offering destination information for travelers across an area

examples.en: The tourist information office suggested an indoor visit because the gardens were closed that afternoon.
examples.zh: 花园当天下午闭园，「旅游咨询处」推荐了一个室内景点。

examples.en: I got a town map from the tourist information office before finding my friends.
examples.zh: 去找朋友之前，我在「旅游咨询处」拿了一张小镇地图。

collocations: ask at the tourist information office

words.enDefinition: A service lending towels to guests for a charge

examples.en: The hostel mentioned towel rental on its list of optional services.
examples.zh: 旅舍在可选服务清单上列了「毛巾租用」。

examples.en: I asked whether the reception desk handled towel rental for visitors.
examples.zh: 我问前台是否为住客办理「毛巾租用」。

words.enDefinition: A waterside path once used for towing boats

examples.en: We followed the towpath along the canal until we reached the second bridge.
examples.zh: 我们沿着运河边的「旧纤道」走，直到第二座桥。

examples.en: The sign showed a connection from the towpath to the city garden.
examples.zh: 指示牌标出了从「运河边的旧纤道」通往城市花园的路线。

words.enDefinition: check where your checked bag is or what has happened to it

examples.en: I used the airline's app to track my bag while waiting at the transfer airport.
examples.zh: 在转机机场等候时，我用航空公司的应用「查看我的行李去向」。

examples.en: Could you show me how to track my bag from the baggage details screen?
examples.zh: 能教我怎么在行李详情页面「查看我的行李去向」吗？

collocations: use the app to track my bag
ask someone to track my bag
where can I track my bag?

words.enDefinition: A route separated from ordinary motor vehicle traffic

examples.en: The map showed a traffic-free route between the park and the university library.
examples.zh: 地图上标出了公园和学校图书馆之间的「无机动车路线」。

examples.en: We met where the traffic-free route leaves the riverside and enters the garden.
examples.zh: 我们在「无机动车路线」离开河边、进入花园的地方碰面。

collocations: a traffic-free route through the park

words.enDefinition: A railway employee overseeing passengers and duties aboard a train

examples.en: The train conductor explained which carriage had space for my bag.
examples.zh: 「列车长」说明了哪节车厢有地方放我的包。

examples.en: I asked the train conductor where to get off for the museum.
examples.zh: 我问「列车长」，去博物馆该在哪站下车。

collocations: a message from the train conductor

words.enDefinition: The arrangement and order of carriages forming a train service

examples.en: The train formation diagram showed which end had the quiet carriage.
examples.zh: 「列车编组」示意图显示安静车厢在哪一端。

examples.en: The board showed a different train formation from the previous service.
examples.zh: 显示屏上的「列车编组」和上一班列车的不同。

words.enDefinition: A message telling passengers they can enter their train now

examples.en: The screen showed "Train now boarding" while we picked up our bags.
examples.zh: 我们拿起行李时，屏幕显示「列车正在上客」。

examples.en: I heard "Train now boarding" for the express service just past the entrance.
examples.zh: 我刚过入口就听到快车「列车正在上客」的通知。

collocations: a sign saying train now boarding

words.enDefinition: A number identifying a particular scheduled passenger train service

examples.en: I checked the train number rather than the time on the display.
examples.zh: 我核对的是「列车车次」，没看显示屏上的时间。

examples.en: The train number on the announcement matched the one in my booking.
examples.zh: 广播报出的「列车车次」和我的订单一致。

words.enDefinition: An organization responsible for running a train service

examples.en: The train operator sent a message about our new departure time.
examples.zh: 「列车运营方」发了条消息，告知我们新的发车时间。

examples.en: I asked a member of station staff to identify the train operator.
examples.zh: 我请车站工作人员告诉我这趟车的「列车运营方」是谁。

collocations: a message from the train operator

words.enDefinition: an urban passenger vehicle running on rails, often along city streets

examples.en: We got the tram from the market stop to the university entrance.
examples.zh: 我们从市场站坐「有轨电车」到了学校入口。

examples.en: The tram slowed as it went through the crowded shopping street downtown.
examples.zh: 「有轨电车」经过市中心人多的商业街时减了速。

words.enDefinition: a place where an urban tram picks up or drops off passengers

examples.en: We met at the tram stop nearest the design studio after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我们在离设计工作室最近的「有轨电车站」碰面。

examples.en: The tram stop had a new map beside the ticket machine.
examples.zh: 「有轨电车站」的售票机旁有一张新地图。

words.enDefinition: an airport desk where staff help with changes between flights

examples.en: I went to the transfer desk because my onward flight had disappeared from the app.
examples.zh: 我的下一趟航班在应用里不见了，我就去了「转机服务柜台」。

examples.en: The agent at the transfer desk showed me where to check for my new gate.
examples.zh: 「转机服务柜台」的工作人员告诉我在哪儿查新的登机口。

collocations: an agent at the transfer desk

words.enDefinition: a fare that applies when a passenger changes between eligible services during a trip

examples.en: I checked the transfer fare before changing from the bus to the tram.
examples.zh: 我从公交换乘电车前查了「换乘车费」。

examples.en: The fare guide listed a transfer fare for this particular pair of routes.
examples.zh: 票价指南列出了这两条线路之间的「换乘车费」。

words.enDefinition: a major point where several different transport routes or modes meet

examples.en: The main transfer hub connects buses with two tram lines outside the station.
examples.zh: 主「交通换乘枢纽」在车站外把公交和两条有轨电车线路连在一起。

examples.en: The city moved the transfer hub closer to the central train station.
examples.zh: 市里把「交通换乘枢纽」搬得离中央火车站更近。

words.enDefinition: a location where travellers can change between routes or modes of transport

examples.en: The map marked the library as a transfer point between two bus routes.
examples.zh: 线路图把图书馆标为两条公交线路之间的「换乘点」。

examples.en: I waited at the transfer point just outside the entrance to the park.
examples.zh: 我在公园入口外的「换乘点」等车。

collocations: change buses at a transfer point

words.enDefinition: a small transport service carrying passengers between airport transfer points

examples.en: I took the transfer shuttle after checking which terminal my next flight would leave from.
examples.zh: 查清下一趟航班从哪座航站楼出发后，我坐了「机场转乘接驳车」。

examples.en: We waited for the transfer shuttle beside a sign showing the other terminal numbers.
examples.zh: 我们在写着其他航站楼编号的牌子旁等「机场转乘接驳车」。

words.enDefinition: the time period during which a connecting trip can be counted under a transfer fare rule

examples.en: I checked the transfer window before deciding whether to stop for coffee.
examples.zh: 我先看了「换乘有效时段」，再决定要不要停下买咖啡。

examples.en: The receipt displayed the end of my transfer window beside the first fare.
examples.zh: 收据在第一段车费旁边印了我的「换乘有效时段」何时结束。

words.enDefinition: an organization that runs or oversees public transportation services in an area

examples.en: The transit agency posted a map showing which bus stops had moved.
examples.zh: 「公共交通管理机构」发了一张图，标出哪些公交站搬到了别处。

examples.en: I checked the transit agency website after seeing a notice at the station.
examples.zh: 在车站看到通知后，我去查了「公共交通管理机构」的网站。

words.enDefinition: an airport area for passengers waiting to continue their journeys

examples.en: I found a quiet place in the transit area to finish reading my assignment.
examples.zh: 我在「转机候机区」找了个安静的地方，把作业要求看完。

examples.en: The café in the transit area was still open when we landed after midnight.
examples.zh: 我们过了午夜才着陆，「转机候机区」的咖啡馆还开着。

words.enDefinition: a map showing the routes, stops and connections in a public transport network

examples.en: The transit map near the entrance showed three ways to reach campus.
examples.zh: 入口附近的「公共交通线路图」标出了到学校的三种走法。

examples.en: I used the transit map to find a connection after the lecture.
examples.zh: 下课后，我看了「公共交通线路图」找换乘线路。

words.enDefinition: a passenger who passes through an airport on the way elsewhere

examples.en: As a transit passenger, I stayed at the airport until my second flight was called.
examples.zh: 作为「过境乘客」，我一直待在机场，直到广播通知第二趟航班。

examples.en: The transit passenger asked which signs led to the gate for her next flight.
examples.zh: 这位「过境乘客」问跟着哪些指示牌能走到下一趟航班的登机口。

words.enDefinition: An official document used to identify a traveler

examples.en: The form asked for the type of travel document I would be carrying.
examples.zh: 表单询问我会携带哪种「旅行证件」。

examples.en: I showed the agent the travel document I had named on the booking form.
examples.zh: 我向工作人员出示了预订表单上填写的「旅行证件」。

words.enDefinition: the period of time available for making a trip

examples.en: Our travel window was only three days between the end of exams and work.
examples.zh: 从考完试到上班之间，我们「可出游的时间段」只有三天。

examples.en: I chose a shorter visit because it fit within the travel window we had.
examples.zh: 我选了时间更短的游览，因为能安排在现有的「可出游时间段」内。

words.enDefinition: a small folding table for an aircraft passenger

examples.en: I lowered the tray table to look over my notes after the crew served drinks.
examples.zh: 乘务组送完饮料后，我放下了「座位折叠小桌板」，过了一遍笔记。

examples.en: My notebook slid across the tray table when the plane started to turn slightly.
examples.zh: 飞机稍微转弯时，我的笔记本在「座位折叠小桌板」上滑了一下。

collocations: put something on the tray table

words.enDefinition: the person arranging the details of a group's trip

examples.en: I asked the trip organizer what time we needed to be outside the museum.
examples.zh: 我问「出游组织者」，我们得几点到博物馆外面。

examples.en: The trip organizer kept a list of everyone who was joining us on Saturday.
examples.zh: 「出游组织者」记录了所有周六和我们一起出游的人的名字。

words.enDefinition: A guest room advertised as having space for three people

examples.en: The three of us shared a triple room during the weekend.
examples.zh: 那个周末，我们三个人住在一间「三人客房」。

examples.en: The triple room had two beds and a separate pull-out bed.
examples.zh: 那间「三人客房」里有两张床，还有一张独立的抽拉床。

collocations: a triple room for three guests

words.enDefinition: an electric bus that runs on roads and draws power from overhead wires

examples.en: Our trolleybus passed under a row of wires on the edge of town.
examples.zh: 我们的「无轨电车」在城边从一排电线下经过。

examples.en: The city map gave the trolleybus its own colour alongside regular bus routes.
examples.zh: 城市地图给「无轨电车」用了单独的颜色，与普通公交线路区分。

words.enDefinition: irregular air movement that makes an aircraft shake or bump

examples.en: We felt some turbulence over the hills, and my pen rolled across the table.
examples.zh: 飞过丘陵时有点「飞行颠簸」，我的笔顺着桌板滚了过去。

examples.en: The crew paused the drinks service when the plane began to encounter turbulence.
examples.zh: 飞机开始出现「飞行颠簸」时，乘务组暂停了饮料服务。

words.enDefinition: A sequence of directions for individual turns along a route

examples.en: The app offered turn-by-turn directions for the walk from campus to the market.
examples.zh: 应用为从学校走到市场的路程提供了「逐步导航指引」。

examples.en: I turned off the sound but kept the turn-by-turn directions on my screen.
examples.zh: 我关了声音，但屏幕上仍然保留了「逐步导航指引」。

words.enDefinition: To change direction and enter a particular route

examples.en: I watched for the sign before deciding where to turn onto the riverside path.
examples.zh: 我先留意指示牌，再决定从哪里「转入河边小路」。

examples.en: The map showed where to turn onto the lane leading to the public garden.
examples.zh: 地图标明从哪里「转入通往公共花园的小巷」。

words.enDefinition: a flashing light used to indicate that a vehicle is turning or changing lanes

examples.en: The driving instructor showed me which lever controlled the turn signal on that car.
examples.zh: 教练给我看了那辆车上哪根拨杆控制「车辆转向灯」。

examples.en: I noticed that the turn signal was still flashing after we parked by campus.
examples.zh: 在学校旁停好车后，我注意到「车辆转向灯」还在闪。

words.enDefinition: A guest room with two separate beds, typically singles

examples.en: My classmate and I booked a twin room for the conference.
examples.zh: 我和同学为参加会议订了一间「双床客房」。

examples.en: The twin room had one bed on either side of the window.
examples.zh: 「双床客房」的窗户两边各摆了一张床。

collocations: a twin room with two beds

words.enDefinition: A cycling track serving both directions

examples.en: The map showed a two-way cycle track beside the road leading to campus.
examples.zh: 地图在通往学校的路旁标出了一条「双向自行车道」。

examples.en: I asked where the two-way cycle track ended near the riverside park.
examples.zh: 我问河边公园附近的「双向自行车道」在哪里结束。

collocations: a sign for a two-way cycle track

words.enDefinition: luggage that nobody has collected after it was unloaded

examples.en: The staff took the unclaimed baggage off the belt after our flight finished unloading.
examples.zh: 我们航班的行李全部卸下后，工作人员把「无人领取的行李」从传送带上拿走了。

examples.en: The agent checked a list of unclaimed baggage when I described my missing suitcase.
examples.zh: 我描述没收到的箱子时，工作人员查了「无人领取的行李」清单。

words.enDefinition: A footway surface with bumps or level changes

examples.en: The route notes mentioned uneven pavement between the main road and the garden entrance.
examples.zh: 路线说明提到，主路和花园入口之间有一段「不平整的人行道」。

examples.en: I saw a warning about uneven pavement beside the campus construction fence.
examples.zh: 我在学校施工围栏旁看到提示「人行道不平整」的警示牌。

words.enDefinition: petrol produced without intentionally added lead compounds

examples.en: The label inside the fuel flap said the car took unleaded petrol.
examples.zh: 加油口盖里的标签写着，这辆车用「无铅汽油」。

examples.en: I saw unleaded petrol listed separately from diesel on the pump display.
examples.zh: 我看到加油机显示屏把「无铅汽油」和柴油分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a rental arrangement with no specified cap on the distance included in the rate

examples.en: The quote showed unlimited mileage next to the daily price for that car.
examples.zh: 那辆车的每日报价旁标了「不限行驶里程」。

examples.en: I asked whether unlimited mileage applied to the whole rental period after changing dates.
examples.zh: 改了日期后，我问整个租期是否都「不限行驶里程」。

words.enDefinition: To release a bicycle so it can be used

examples.en: The app showed where to tap to unlock a bike at that station.
examples.zh: 应用显示，在那个站点要点击哪里才能「解锁一辆单车」。

examples.en: Could you unlock a bike from this station using the same app as mine?
examples.zh: 你能用和我一样的应用，从这个站点「解锁一辆单车」吗？

collocations: use the app to unlock a bike
be able to unlock a bike

words.enDefinition: A charge for unlocking a rental bicycle

examples.en: I saw the unlock fee in the app before selecting a bike.
examples.zh: 我在选择单车之前，先看到了应用里的「开锁费」。

examples.en: The receipt showed the unlock fee on a separate line from other charges.
examples.zh: 收据把「开锁费」和其他费用分行列出了。

words.enDefinition: A path without a hard constructed surface

examples.en: The unpaved path was marked in a different colour on the garden map.
examples.zh: 花园地图用不同颜色标出了「未铺装小路」。

examples.en: I asked whether the unpaved path continued past the second bridge along the river.
examples.zh: 我问沿河的「未铺装小路」过了第二座桥还有没有。

collocations: an unpaved path through the garden

words.enDefinition: a place you stop at without arranging it beforehand

examples.en: We made an unplanned stop when we saw the sign for the riverside garden.
examples.zh: 看到通往河边花园的牌子时，我们「临时加了一站」。

examples.en: The itinerary left room for an unplanned stop if we found somewhere interesting.
examples.zh: 行程留了余地，遇到有意思的地方可以「临时加一站」。

words.enDefinition: Seating available without assigned places for the passengers using it

examples.en: The conductor explained that the rear carriage had unreserved seating.
examples.zh: 列车员说明后面的车厢是「不对号入座」。

examples.en: I checked whether our coach ticket said we had unreserved seating.
examples.zh: 我看了下我们的长途大巴票，上面有没有写「不对号入座」。

words.enDefinition: an amount charged for moving to a higher rental vehicle class

examples.en: The rental desk offered a larger car with a small upgrade charge.
examples.zh: 租车柜台提供了一辆更大的车，但需加一点「升级车型费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the upgrade charge was already included in the new quote.
examples.zh: 我问新的报价是不是已经包含「升级车型费」。

words.enDefinition: A section of a route that goes uphill

examples.en: The route preview marked an uphill stretch just before the park entrance.
examples.zh: 路线预览标出了公园入口前「一段上坡路」。

examples.en: We stopped at a bench after the long uphill stretch near the hall.
examples.zh: 走完大厅旁那「一长段上坡路」后，我们在长椅旁停了下来。

collocations: the start of the uphill stretch

words.enDefinition: A sleeping place positioned above another in a train compartment

examples.en: I found my name next to the upper berth in the compartment.
examples.zh: 我在包厢里看到「上铺」旁边写着我的名字。

examples.en: The conductor showed which number belonged to the upper berth on my ticket.
examples.zh: 列车员指出车票上的哪个号码对应「上铺」。

words.enDefinition: The bed positioned higher in a set of bunk beds

examples.en: My bed number was on the frame of the upper bunk.
examples.zh: 我的床号写在「上层床铺」的架子上。

examples.en: The hostel assigned me an upper bunk beside my friend's bed.
examples.zh: 旅舍给我安排了一个「上层床铺」，就在朋友的床旁边。

words.enDefinition: To refer to a recognizable place for orientation

examples.en: I decided to use a landmark rather than remember every street name on the route.
examples.zh: 我决定「用地标作参考」，省得记路线上的每个路名。

examples.en: Could you use a landmark to explain which park entrance you mean?
examples.zh: 你能「用地标作参考」，解释一下你指的是公园哪个入口吗？

collocations: use a landmark as a reference

words.enDefinition: whether particular types of vehicles are available for use at a requested place or time

examples.en: I checked vehicle availability before choosing which branch to collect the car from.
examples.zh: 我先查了「车辆供应情况」，再决定去哪家门店取车。

examples.en: The website updated vehicle availability after I changed the pickup date to Saturday.
examples.zh: 我把取车日期改到周六后，网站更新了「车辆供应情况」。

collocations: vehicle availability on a selected date

words.enDefinition: a document describing a vehicle's condition, often including existing marks or damage

examples.en: I compared the vehicle condition report with the photos taken at pickup.
examples.zh: 我把「车辆状况记录」和取车时拍的照片做了对照。

examples.en: The vehicle condition report showed a small mark near the passenger door.
examples.zh: 「车辆状况记录」显示，乘客侧车门附近有个小印痕。

words.enDefinition: a record of damage found on a vehicle, often with its location and description

examples.en: The agent handed me a vehicle damage report after taking photographs of the bumper.
examples.zh: 代理拍了保险杠照片之后，递给我一份「车辆损坏报告」。

examples.en: I checked whether the vehicle damage report showed the same mark as my photograph.
examples.zh: 我核对了「车辆损坏报告」记录的是不是照片里那处印痕。

words.enDefinition: the time or process of leaving a rented vehicle at an agreed location

examples.en: The map showed where vehicle drop-off was located inside the multi-storey car park.
examples.zh: 地图标出了多层停车楼里「还车」的地方。

examples.en: I checked the vehicle drop-off address before leaving for the station that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上去车站前，我先确认了「还车」地址。

words.enDefinition: the time or process of collecting a vehicle for use

examples.en: I confirmed the vehicle pickup before booking a train to the rental location.
examples.zh: 我先确认了「取车」安排，再订去租车点的火车票。

examples.en: The agent moved the vehicle pickup to a different branch near the station.
examples.zh: 代理把「取车」安排改到了车站附近另一家门店。

words.enDefinition: the official process or record linking a vehicle to the relevant registration authority

examples.en: The car-share app showed the vehicle registration details beside the number plate.
examples.zh: 共享汽车应用在车牌号旁显示了「车辆登记」信息。

examples.en: I checked the address on the vehicle registration record after moving to campus.
examples.zh: 搬到学校后，我核对了「车辆登记」记录上的地址。

words.zhGloss: 可同时接待的游客上限
words.enDefinition: the maximum number of visitors a place can accommodate at once
acceptedZhAnswers: 可同时接待的游客上限

examples.en: The room reached visitor capacity, and the staff asked us to wait in the courtyard.
examples.zh: 房间到了「可同时接待的游客上限」，工作人员请我们在院子里等。

examples.en: The guide mentioned visitor capacity before taking our small group into the upstairs room.
examples.zh: 带我们小组上楼进房间前，导游提到了「可同时接待的游客上限」。

words.enDefinition: a center providing information and services at or near an attraction

examples.en: The visitor center gave us a leaflet about the old buildings along the river.
examples.zh: 「游客中心」给了我们一张介绍河边老建筑的宣传单。

examples.en: I waited outside the visitor center until the rest of my project group arrived.
examples.zh: 我在「游客中心」外面等项目组其他人到齐。

collocations: a map from the visitor center

words.enDefinition: the entrance set aside for people coming to visit

examples.en: The visitor entrance is around the corner from the main offices of the historic house.
examples.zh: 「游客入口」就在那座老宅的主办公室拐个弯的地方。

examples.en: I waited at the visitor entrance until my friend came back with the tickets.
examples.zh: 我在「游客入口」等朋友拿着票回来。

words.enDefinition: amenities such as toilets or rest areas provided for visitors

examples.en: The leaflet marked visitor facilities near the entrance, including toilets and a covered seating area.
examples.zh: 宣传单标出了入口附近的「游客服务设施」，包括洗手间和有顶的座位区。

examples.en: We checked the visitor facilities before deciding where to take our afternoon break.
examples.zh: 决定下午在哪儿歇一会儿之前，我们查了查「游客服务设施」。

words.enDefinition: a short printed sheet with useful information for visitors

examples.en: I picked up a visitor leaflet about the house before walking around the garden.
examples.zh: 逛花园之前，我拿了份介绍老宅的「游客宣传折页」。

examples.en: The visitor leaflet showed where the tour would end and where we could sit.
examples.zh: 「游客宣传折页」标明了导览结束的地点，以及我们能坐哪儿。

words.enDefinition: a map showing places and facilities at a visitor attraction

examples.en: The visitor map showed which rooms were open and where the garden path began.
examples.zh: 「游客游览图」标出了开放的房间以及花园小路的起点。

examples.en: I kept the visitor map in my pocket so I could check the route later.
examples.zh: 我把「游客游览图」放进口袋，方便之后查看路线。

words.enDefinition: posted messages about arrangements or rules for visitors

examples.en: I checked the visitor notices before choosing which garden path to start on.
examples.zh: 选择从哪条花园小路开始逛前，我看了看「游客告示」。

examples.en: The visitor notices near the gate mentioned a change to the afternoon tour.
examples.zh: 门口附近的「游客告示」提到了下午导览的一项变化。

words.enDefinition: To stay until your group is invited to board

examples.en: The announcement asked you to wait for your group before approaching the gate.
examples.zh: 广播请大家「等候叫到自己的登机组」，再走向登机口。

examples.en: Do you have to wait for your group here or beside the other sign?
examples.zh: 你得在这里「等候叫到自己的登机组」，还是在另一块牌子旁等？

collocations: ask you to wait for your group
wait for your group at the gate
wait for your group to be called

words.enDefinition: A scheduled call from a hotel intended to wake a guest

examples.en: I requested a wake-up call before my early interview the next morning.
examples.zh: 第二天一早要面试，我请酒店安排了「客房叫醒电话」。

examples.en: The front desk confirmed the time of my wake-up call.
examples.zh: 前台确认了我的「客房叫醒电话」时间。

words.enDefinition: a check of a vehicle's exterior by walking around it and looking for damage

examples.en: The agent carried out a walk-around inspection before we left the rental lot.
examples.zh: 我们开出租车场之前，代理做了一次「绕车检查」。

examples.en: I joined the walk-around inspection to see which scratches were already recorded.
examples.zh: 我参加了「绕车检查」，看看哪些划痕已被记录。

words.enDefinition: To pass somewhere without stopping while on foot

examples.en: We needed to walk past the old café before reaching the museum's side door.
examples.zh: 我们得「步行经过」那家老咖啡馆，才能到博物馆侧门。

examples.en: Does the route make us walk past the garden before turning left near the bridge?
examples.zh: 这条路线是要我们先「走过」花园，再在桥边左转吗？

collocations: walk past a row of shops

words.enDefinition: A crossing signal displaying the walk phase

examples.en: The diagram showed a walking figure as an example of a walk signal.
examples.zh: 示意图用一个行走的小人作为「行人通行信号」的示例。

examples.en: I asked my classmate what the walk signal looked like at that crossing.
examples.zh: 我问同学，那个过街点的「行人通行信号」长什么样。

collocations: the walk signal at a crossing

words.enDefinition: tickets available at the venue to people without advance reservations

examples.en: We asked about walk-up tickets because we hadn't decided to visit until that morning.
examples.zh: 我们那天上午才决定去，就问了有没有「到场现买的门票」。

examples.en: A small sign at the entrance said walk-up tickets were available that afternoon.
examples.zh: 入口处一块小牌子写着，当天下午有「到场现买的门票」。

words.enDefinition: To walk while pushing the bicycle beside you

examples.en: The sign asked you to walk your bike along the narrow stretch beside the garden.
examples.zh: 牌子请大家经过花园旁狭窄的一段时「推着自行车走」。

examples.en: Do you need to walk your bike through the passage, according to that notice?
examples.zh: 按那张告示，过通道时需要「推着自行车走」吗？

collocations: ask you to walk your bike
walk your bike through the passage
walk your bike beside the gate

words.enDefinition: Instructions for reaching a place on foot

examples.en: I opened the walking directions before leaving the student residence for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 出学生宿舍去看展之前，我打开了「步行指引」。

examples.en: The walking directions led past the garden and through a narrow passage.
examples.zh: 「步行指引」让我经过花园，再穿过一条窄通道。

words.enDefinition: A map setting for journeys on foot

examples.en: I switched to walking mode after getting off the bus near campus.
examples.zh: 在学校附近下公交后，我切换到了「步行模式」。

examples.en: The app showed a shorter path through the gardens in walking mode.
examples.zh: 应用在「步行模式」下标出了一条穿过花园的更短路线。

words.enDefinition: A path planned for reaching somewhere on foot

examples.en: The walking route on the map started beside the university sports hall.
examples.zh: 地图上的「步行路线」从学校体育馆旁边出发。

examples.en: We chose a walking route through the park to see the new exhibition.
examples.zh: 我们选了一条穿过公园的「步行路线」去看新展览。

words.enDefinition: a tour in which visitors move between places on foot

examples.en: We joined a walking tour to see the streets we had missed the day before.
examples.zh: 我们参加了「步行游览」，去看看前一天漏逛的街道。

examples.en: The walking tour ended near the market, where we planned to have lunch afterwards.
examples.zh: 「步行游览」在市场附近结束，我们计划之后去那里吃午饭。

collocations: a walking tour of the old town

words.enDefinition: a delay caused by weather affecting travel

examples.en: The weather delay gave me another hour to finish my reading before leaving campus.
examples.zh: 「天气原因延误」让我离校前又多出一个小时，可以把要读的材料看完。

examples.en: The pilot announced a weather delay because a storm was passing near our destination.
examples.zh: 目的地附近有暴风雨经过，飞行员广播说会「因天气延误」。

collocations: a weather delay at the destination

words.enDefinition: likely to change according to the weather conditions

examples.en: The garden tour is weather-dependent, so we checked our messages before leaving campus.
examples.zh: 花园导览是「视天气而定的」，所以我们离校前看了一眼消息。

examples.en: Our booking described the tower visit as weather-dependent because part of it is outside.
examples.zh: 预订里说，塔楼参观是「视天气而定的」，因为有一部分在室外。

words.enDefinition: a short trip for a change of scene over a weekend

examples.en: We planned a weekend getaway after handing in the last assignment of the term.
examples.zh: 交完这学期最后一份作业后，我们计划来趟「周末短途度假」。

examples.en: The coast sounded ideal for a weekend getaway before the exam period began.
examples.zh: 考试周开始前，去海边「周末短途度假」听起来挺合适。

words.enDefinition: the schedule followed by a transport service on Saturdays and Sundays

examples.en: I checked the weekend timetable before agreeing to meet my classmates on Sunday.
examples.zh: 答应周日和同学见面前，我查了「周末时刻表」。

examples.en: The weekend timetable listed a later first departure than the weekday one.
examples.zh: 「周末时刻表」列出的首班发车时间比工作日更晚。

words.enDefinition: To measure how much your bag weighs

examples.en: The volunteer pointed out where you could weigh your bag before reaching the counter.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我们看，到柜台前可以在哪里「给行李称重」。

examples.en: Can you weigh your bag here or do you need to wait for the agent?
examples.zh: 你能在这里「给行李称重」吗，还是得等工作人员？

collocations: weigh your bag at the counter
ask you to weigh your bag
use a scale to weigh your bag

words.expression: what else can we visit nearby
words.lemma: what else can we visit nearby
words.zhGloss: 附近还有什么地方可以参观
words.enDefinition: asks which other attractions are close to the current location
acceptedZhAnswers: 附近还有什么地方可以参观
acceptedEnVariants: what else can we visit nearby

examples.en: What else can we visit nearby before we meet the others for lunch?
examples.zh: 和其他人碰面吃午饭前，「附近还有什么地方可以参观」？

examples.en: What else can we visit nearby now that the courtyard has closed for the afternoon?
examples.zh: 院子下午已经关了，「附近还有什么地方可以参观」？

collocations: what else can we visit nearby today?
after the museum, what else can we visit nearby?
what else can we visit nearby before lunch?

words.enDefinition: asks which place or feature is worth visiting before the others

examples.en: What should we see first if we only have one afternoon in the city?
examples.zh: 如果在这座城市只有一个下午，「我们应该先看什么」？

examples.en: What should we see first before the upstairs rooms close for the day?
examples.zh: 楼上的房间今天关闭前，「我们应该先看什么」？

collocations: what should we see first in the museum?
if we have an hour, what should we see first?
what should we see first around here?

words.enDefinition: a superficial scrape or mark on a wheel, often on the rim

examples.en: The vehicle report included a wheel scuff near the front of the car.
examples.zh: 车辆记录写了车前部有一处「车轮擦痕」。

examples.en: I pointed out the wheel scuff before the agent handed over the keys.
examples.zh: 代理交钥匙之前，我指出了那处「车轮擦痕」。

words.enDefinition: a designated area inside a vehicle where a passenger can travel in a wheelchair

examples.en: The bus had a wheelchair space beside the wider door near the driver.
examples.zh: 公交车靠近司机的宽门旁设有「车内轮椅乘客专区」。

examples.en: We left the wheelchair space clear when the other seats were full.
examples.zh: 其他座位坐满时，我们也让「车内轮椅乘客专区」保持空着。

words.enDefinition: A suitcase that can be rolled on wheels

examples.en: I pulled my wheeled suitcase along the concourse while my friend checked the gate.
examples.zh: 朋友查看登机口时，我沿着候机廊区拉着「带轮行李箱」走。

examples.en: The handle of my wheeled suitcase caught on the edge of the luggage trolley.
examples.zh: 我的「带轮行李箱」拉杆卡在行李推车边上。

words.expression: where can I report a missing bag
words.lemma: where can i report a missing bag
words.zhGloss: 没收到行李该去哪儿报备
words.enDefinition: asks where to notify the airline about a bag that has not arrived
acceptedZhAnswers: 没收到行李该去哪儿报备
acceptedEnVariants: where can I report a missing bag

examples.en: Where can I report a missing bag now that the carousel has stopped running?
examples.zh: 行李转盘已经停了，「没收到行李该去哪儿报备」？

examples.en: Where can I report a missing bag if the arrivals desk is already closed?
examples.zh: 如果到达区的服务台已经关了，「没收到行李该去哪儿报备」？

collocations: excuse me, where can I report a missing bag?
where can I report a missing bag at this airport?
now that the belt has stopped, where can I report a missing bag?

words.enDefinition: A question about where an item should go

examples.en: I asked, “Where should I put this?” while holding the tray beside the belt.
examples.zh: 我拿着托盘站在传送带旁，问：「这东西放哪里？」

examples.en: I asked, “Where should I put this bag?” when the officer pointed toward the table.
examples.zh: 安检员指向桌子时，我问：「这个包放哪里？」

words.expression: which belt is our baggage on
words.lemma: which belt is our baggage on
words.zhGloss: 我们的行李在哪个转盘
words.enDefinition: asks which carousel is receiving bags from your flight
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们的行李在哪个转盘
acceptedEnVariants: which belt is our baggage on

examples.en: Which belt is our baggage on now that two more flights have arrived here?
examples.zh: 现在这里又到了两趟航班，「我们的行李在哪个转盘」？

examples.en: The display has changed, so which belt is our baggage on for this flight?
examples.zh: 显示屏变了，「我们这班的行李在哪个转盘」？

collocations: which belt is our baggage on now?
excuse me, which belt is our baggage on?
the screen changed, which belt is our baggage on?

words.enDefinition: asks which group you have been assigned to join

examples.en: Which group am I in for the tour after we split up at the entrance?
examples.zh: 我们在入口分组后，「我分在哪一组」去参加导览？

examples.en: Which group am I in if my name is on the second booking list?
examples.zh: 如果我名字在第二张预订名单上，「我分在哪一组」？

collocations: excuse me, which group am I in?
which group am I in for the walk?
I can't see my name, which group am I in?

words.enDefinition: asks whether there will be enough time to board the next flight

examples.en: Will I make my connection if we arrive twenty minutes later than the original estimate?
examples.zh: 要是比原先预计的晚二十分钟到，「我还赶得上转机吗」？

examples.en: If I have to change terminals, will I make my connection with this arrival time?
examples.zh: 如果还得换航站楼，按这个时间到，「我还赶得上转机吗」？

collocations: will I make my connection at this rate?
will I make my connection if we land late?
given the delay, will I make my connection?

words.enDefinition: a cover used to block light from an aircraft window

examples.en: I raised the window shade to see the coast during the last hour of flight.
examples.zh: 航班最后一小时，我拉起「舷窗遮光板」，想看看海岸。

examples.en: My neighbour lowered the window shade while I was trying to read my notes.
examples.zh: 我在看笔记时，邻座拉下了「舷窗遮光板」。

words.enDefinition: a small damaged spot in the front window of a vehicle

examples.en: The agent marked a windshield chip near the corner of the glass.
examples.zh: 代理在记录中标了一处靠近玻璃角的「挡风玻璃小缺口」。

examples.en: I noticed the windshield chip while looking at the condition report photos.
examples.zh: 我看车辆状况记录的照片时，注意到了「挡风玻璃小缺口」。

words.enDefinition: movable blades that clear water or dirt from a vehicle's front window

examples.en: I turned on the windshield wipers as soon as the rain started on the highway.
examples.zh: 高速上一下雨，我就打开了「挡风玻璃雨刷」。

examples.en: The rental agent showed us how to turn on the windshield wipers.
examples.zh: 租车代理给我们演示了怎么开「挡风玻璃雨刷」。

words.zhGloss: 离某地很近且方便到达
words.enDefinition: close enough to get to without much effort
acceptedZhAnswers: 离某地很近且方便到达

examples.en: The garden is within easy reach of the town centre, so we went after lunch.
examples.zh: 这个花园「离市中心很近，过去也方便」，所以我们午饭后去了。

examples.en: We chose somewhere within easy reach of the museum for our afternoon break.
examples.zh: 我们选了个「离博物馆近又好到的地方」，下午去休息一下。

collocations: within easy reach of the town centre
within easy reach of several sights

words.enDefinition: an extra charge some rental companies apply to a driver below a specified age

examples.en: The quote displayed a young driver surcharge on a separate line at checkout.
examples.zh: 结账时，报价单另列了一项「年轻驾驶人附加费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the young driver surcharge shown applied to the whole booking.
examples.zh: 我问显示的「年轻驾驶人附加费」是否适用于整笔预订。

collocations: the amount of a young driver surcharge

words.enDefinition: Low-cost short-stay accommodation often offering shared sleeping rooms

examples.en: My classmates stayed at a youth hostel during the field trip.
examples.zh: 我们去实地考察时，同学们住在一家「青年旅舍」。

examples.en: The youth hostel listed its reception hours in the confirmation email.
examples.zh: 「青年旅舍」在确认邮件里写了前台开放时间。

collocations: a youth hostel near the station

words.enDefinition: A pedestrian crossing marked with wide white stripes

examples.en: The zebra crossing outside the British museum looked newly painted that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，英国那家博物馆外的「斑马线」看起来刚刷过。

examples.en: I found the café my friend meant beside the zebra crossing near campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校附近的「斑马线」旁找到了朋友说的咖啡馆。

collocations: a zebra crossing outside a building

words.enDefinition: the dividing line between two different fare zones in a transport network

examples.en: The map showed a zone boundary just beyond the stop nearest campus.
examples.zh: 地图显示，离学校最近的站再过去一点就是「票价区边界」。

examples.en: We checked the zone boundary before deciding which ticket to buy for the train.
examples.zh: 我们先查看了「票价区边界」，再决定买哪种火车票。

collocations: a station on a zone boundary

words.enDefinition: a price based on the fare zones covered by the passenger's trip

examples.en: The map helps travellers find the zone fare for a journey across town.
examples.zh: 这张图帮乘客查找横穿市区要付的「按区计费的车费」。

examples.en: I compared the zone fare for two routes to the museum.
examples.zh: 我比较了去博物馆的两条线路中「按区计费的车费」。

words.enDefinition: To enlarge the map to show more detail

examples.en: I had to zoom in on the map to see the smaller path.
examples.zh: 我得「放大地图」，才能看到那条较小的路。

examples.en: Could you zoom in on the map so we can read the street name?
examples.zh: 你能「放大地图」，让我们看清路名吗？

collocations: pinch to zoom in on the map
zoom in on the map for details
need to zoom in on the map
